static int vs_history_wait_for_store(void)
{
#ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_SDIO
  char source[32];
  bool mounted;
  unsigned int attempt;

  /* Same bound as vs_config.c's wait: automount can be delayed up to 60 s,
   * plus card-probe timeout.  Only called from vs_history_open(), which
   * runs at startup, never from the UI hot path. */

  for (attempt = 0; attempt < 700; attempt++)
    {
      if (bk7258_mmcsd_status(&mounted, source, sizeof(source)) == 0 &&
          mounted)
        {
          return 0;
        }

      usleep(100000);
    }

  return -ETIMEDOUT;
#else
  return -ENODEV;
#endif
}

static void vs_history_load_seed(void)
{
  unsigned int i;
  unsigned int n = (unsigned int)(sizeof(g_social_seed) /
                                  sizeof(g_social_seed[0]));

  for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
    {
      g_index[VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL][i] = g_social_seed[i];
    }

  g_count[VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL]    = n;
  g_next_seq[VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL] = n;

  mkdir(g_history_subdir[VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL], 0700);
  for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
    {
      char path[80];
      unsigned int seq;

      if (sscanf(g_social_seed[i].record_key, "R%08u", &seq) != 1)
        {
          continue;
        }

      snprintf(path, sizeof(path), VS_HISTORY_FMT_JSN,
               g_history_subdir[VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL], seq);

      /* Best-effort: if a real session already wrote this seq (unlikely,
       * since the seed only runs when no index existed at all) do not
       * clobber it.  This is sample data for a cold store, not a reset. */

      if (access(path, F_OK) != 0)
        {
          FILE *f = fopen(path, "w");

          if (f != NULL)
            {
              fputs(g_social_seed_body[i], f);
              fclose(f);
            }
        }
    }

  g_count[VS_HISTORY_KIND_CHAT]    = 0;
  g_next_seq[VS_HISTORY_KIND_CHAT] = 0;
}

/* Parse one index entry out of a cJSON object, tolerating missing or
 * mistyped fields so a partially corrupt INDEX.JSN loses only the entries
 * that are actually bad rather than failing the whole load. */

static bool vs_history_parse_entry(enum vs_history_kind_e kind, cJSON *obj,
                                   struct vs_history_index_s *out)
{
  cJSON *item;

  memset(out, 0, sizeof(*out));
  out->kind = kind;

  item = cJSON_GetObjectItem(obj, "record_key");
  if (item == NULL || !cJSON_IsString(item) || item->valuestring[0] == '\0')
    {
      return false;
    }

  snprintf(out->record_key, sizeof(out->record_key), "%s",
           item->valuestring);

  item = cJSON_GetObjectItem(obj, "date");
  if (item != NULL && cJSON_IsString(item))
    {
      snprintf(out->date, sizeof(out->date), "%s", item->valuestring);
    }

  item = cJSON_GetObjectItem(obj, "title");
  if (item != NULL && cJSON_IsString(item))
    {
      snprintf(out->title, sizeof(out->title), "%s", item->valuestring);
    }

  item = cJSON_GetObjectItem(obj, "summary");
  if (item != NULL && cJSON_IsString(item))
    {
      snprintf(out->summary, sizeof(out->summary), "%s", item->valuestring);
    }

  item = cJSON_GetObjectItem(obj, "calm");
  out->calm = (item != NULL && cJSON_IsNumber(item)) ?
              (uint8_t)item->valueint : 0;

  item = cJSON_GetObjectItem(obj, "happy");
  out->happy = (item != NULL && cJSON_IsNumber(item)) ?
               (uint8_t)item->valueint : 0;

  item = cJSON_GetObjectItem(obj, "tense");
  out->tense = (item != NULL && cJSON_IsNumber(item)) ?
               (uint8_t)item->valueint : 0;

  item = cJSON_GetObjectItem(obj, "incomplete");
  out->incomplete = item != NULL && cJSON_IsBool(item) && cJSON_IsTrue(item);
  return true;
}

static int vs_history_load_index(enum vs_history_kind_e kind)
{
  char path[80];
  unsigned char *raw;
  FILE *f;
  long sz;
  cJSON *root;
  int i;
  int n;

  snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/%s", g_history_subdir[kind],
           VS_HISTORY_INDEX_JSN);

  f = fopen(path, "r");
  if (f == NULL)
    {
      return -ENOENT;
    }

  if (fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END) != 0 || (sz = ftell(f)) < 0 ||
      fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET) != 0 || sz == 0 || sz > VS_HISTORY_RAW_MAX)
    {
      fclose(f);
      return -EBADMSG;
    }

  raw = malloc((size_t)sz + 1);
  if (raw == NULL)
    {
      fclose(f);
      return -ENOMEM;
    }

  n = (int)fread(raw, 1, (size_t)sz, f);
  fclose(f);
  raw[n] = '\0';

  root = cJSON_Parse((const char *)raw);
  free(raw);

  if (root == NULL || !cJSON_IsArray(root))
    {
      cJSON_Delete(root);
      return -EBADMSG;
    }

  g_count[kind]    = 0;
  g_next_seq[kind] = 0;

  for (i = 0; i < cJSON_GetArraySize(root) &&
       g_count[kind] < CONFIG_VS_HISTORY_MAX_RECORDS; i++)
    {
      cJSON *obj = cJSON_GetArrayItem(root, i);
      unsigned int seq;

      if (!cJSON_IsObject(obj))
        {
          continue;
        }

      /* A corrupt individual entry is skipped, not fatal to the load. */

      if (!vs_history_parse_entry(kind, obj, &g_index[kind][g_count[kind]]))
        {
          continue;
        }

      if (sscanf(g_index[kind][g_count[kind]].record_key, "R%08u", &seq)
          == 1 && seq + 1 > g_next_seq[kind])
        {
          g_next_seq[kind] = seq + 1;
        }

      g_count[kind]++;
    }

  cJSON_Delete(root);
  return 0;
}

static cJSON *vs_history_entry_to_json(const struct vs_history_index_s *e)
{
  cJSON *obj = cJSON_CreateObject();

  if (obj == NULL)
    {
      return NULL;
    }

  cJSON_AddStringToObject(obj, "record_key", e->record_key);
  cJSON_AddStringToObject(obj, "date", e->date);
  cJSON_AddStringToObject(obj, "title", e->title);
  cJSON_AddStringToObject(obj, "summary", e->summary);
  cJSON_AddNumberToObject(obj, "calm", e->calm);
  cJSON_AddNumberToObject(obj, "happy", e->happy);
  cJSON_AddNumberToObject(obj, "tense", e->tense);
  cJSON_AddBoolToObject(obj, "incomplete", e->incomplete);
  return obj;
}

/* Write `text` to `tmp`, fsync, close, rename onto `dest`, fsync the
 * directory.  Shared by the index save and the per-record body save. */

static int vs_history_atomic_write(const char *dir, const char *tmp,
                                   const char *dest, const char *text)
{
  size_t len = strlen(text);
  int fd;
  ssize_t written;

  fd = open(tmp, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0600);
  if (fd < 0)
    {
      return -errno;
    }

  written = write(fd, text, len);
  if (written < 0 || (size_t)written != len || fsync(fd) < 0)
    {
      int err = errno != 0 ? -errno : -EIO;

      close(fd);
      unlink(tmp);
      return err;
    }

  if (close(fd) < 0)
    {
      int err = -errno;

      unlink(tmp);
      return err;
    }

  if (rename(tmp, dest) < 0)
    {
      int err = -errno;

      unlink(tmp);
      return err;
    }

  /* Best-effort directory fsync so the rename itself survives a power
   * cut.  Not fatal if the platform's fs does not support it. */

  fd = open(dir, O_RDONLY);
  if (fd >= 0)
    {
      fsync(fd);
      close(fd);
    }

  return 0;
}

static int vs_history_save_index(enum vs_history_kind_e kind)
{
  cJSON *root;
  char *text;
  char tmp[80];
  char dest[80];
  unsigned int i;
  int ret;

  root = cJSON_CreateArray();
  if (root == NULL)
    {
      return -ENOMEM;
    }

  for (i = 0; i < g_count[kind]; i++)
    {
      cJSON *obj = vs_history_entry_to_json(&g_index[kind][i]);

      if (obj == NULL)
        {
          cJSON_Delete(root);
          return -ENOMEM;
        }

      cJSON_AddItemToArray(root, obj);
    }

  text = cJSON_PrintUnformatted(root);
  cJSON_Delete(root);
  if (text == NULL)
    {
      return -ENOMEM;
    }

  snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), "%s/%s", g_history_subdir[kind],
           VS_HISTORY_INDEX_TMP);
  snprintf(dest, sizeof(dest), "%s/%s", g_history_subdir[kind],
           VS_HISTORY_INDEX_JSN);

  ret = vs_history_atomic_write(g_history_subdir[kind], tmp, dest, text);
  free(text);
  return ret;
}

/* Remove the oldest entry (last position, g_count[kind]-1) to make room.
 * Best-effort on the disk side: an unlink failure still drops the
 * in-memory slot, because keeping an index entry alive just because its
 * body file would not delete is worse than a harmless orphaned file. */

static void vs_history_evict_oldest(enum vs_history_kind_e kind)
{
  unsigned int last = g_count[kind] - 1;
  unsigned int seq;
  char path[80];

  if (sscanf(g_index[kind][last].record_key, "R%08u", &seq) == 1)
    {
      snprintf(path, sizeof(path), VS_HISTORY_FMT_JSN,
               g_history_subdir[kind], seq);
      unlink(path);
    }

  g_count[kind]--;
}

int vs_history_open(void)
{
  int ret;
  int social_ret;
  int chat_ret;

  if (g_ready)
    {
      return 0;
    }

  ret = vs_history_wait_for_store();
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      printf("vs_history: store unavailable (%d), using seed data\n", ret);
      vs_history_load_seed();
      g_ready = true;
      return ret;
    }

  mkdir(VS_HISTORY_ROOT, 0700);
  mkdir(g_history_subdir[VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL], 0700);
  mkdir(g_history_subdir[VS_HISTORY_KIND_CHAT], 0700);

  social_ret = vs_history_load_index(VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL);
  if (social_ret < 0)
    {

             social_ret);
      vs_history_load_seed();
    }
  else
    {
      printf("vs_history: loaded %u social record(s)\n",
             g_count[VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL]);
    }

  chat_ret = vs_history_load_index(VS_HISTORY_KIND_CHAT);
  if (chat_ret < 0)
    {
      printf("vs_history: no usable chat index (%d), starting empty\n",
             chat_ret);
      g_count[VS_HISTORY_KIND_CHAT]    = 0;
      g_next_seq[VS_HISTORY_KIND_CHAT] = 0;
    }
  else
    {
      printf("vs_history: loaded %u chat record(s)\n",
             g_count[VS_HISTORY_KIND_CHAT]);
    }

  g_ready = true;
  return 0;
}

unsigned int vs_history_count(enum vs_history_kind_e kind)
{
  if (kind >= VS_HISTORY_KIND_COUNT)
    {
      return 0;
    }

  return g_count[kind];
}

int vs_history_get_index(enum vs_history_kind_e kind, unsigned int i,
                         struct vs_history_index_s *out)
{
  if (out == NULL || kind >= VS_HISTORY_KIND_COUNT || i >= g_count[kind])
    {
      return -EINVAL;
    }

  *out = g_index[kind][i];
  return 0;
}

int vs_history_read_full(enum vs_history_kind_e kind, const char *record_key,
                         char *buf, size_t len)
{
  char path[80];
  FILE *f;
  long sz;
  int n;

  if (record_key == NULL || buf == NULL || len == 0 ||
      kind >= VS_HISTORY_KIND_COUNT)
    {
      return -EINVAL;
    }

  snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/%s.JSN", g_history_subdir[kind],
           record_key);

  f = fopen(path, "r");
  if (f == NULL)
    {
      return -ENOENT;
    }

  if (fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END) != 0 || (sz = ftell(f)) < 0 ||
      fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET) != 0)
    {
      fclose(f);
      return -EIO;
    }

  if (sz >= (long)len)
    {
      sz = (long)len - 1;
    }

  n = (int)fread(buf, 1, (size_t)sz, f);
  fclose(f);
  buf[n] = '\0';
  return n;
}

int vs_history_append(enum vs_history_kind_e kind,
                      struct vs_history_index_s *index,
                      const char *full_json)
{
  char path[80];
  char tmp[80];
  unsigned int seq;
  int ret;

  if (index == NULL || kind >= VS_HISTORY_KIND_COUNT)
    {
      return -EINVAL;
    }

  if (!g_ready)
    {
      return -ENODEV;
    }

  if (g_count[kind] >= CONFIG_VS_HISTORY_MAX_RECORDS)
    {
      vs_history_evict_oldest(kind);
    }

  seq = g_next_seq[kind];
  index->kind = kind;
  snprintf(index->record_key, sizeof(index->record_key), "R%08u", seq);

  if (full_json != NULL)
    {
      snprintf(path, sizeof(path), VS_HISTORY_FMT_JSN,
               g_history_subdir[kind], seq);
      snprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), VS_HISTORY_FMT_TMP,
               g_history_subdir[kind], seq);

      ret = vs_history_atomic_write(g_history_subdir[kind], tmp, path,
                                    full_json);
      if (ret < 0)
        {
          return ret;
        }
    }

  /* Insert at the front: index 0 is always the newest, matching how
   * vs_app.c's KEY_NEXT/KEY_BACK walk this array and how the seed data is
   * ordered. */

  memmove(&g_index[kind][1], &g_index[kind][0],
          g_count[kind] * sizeof(g_index[kind][0]));
  g_index[kind][0] = *index;
  g_count[kind]++;
  g_next_seq[kind] = seq + 1;

  ret = vs_history_save_index(kind);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      /* The record body (if any) is already durable and simply will not be
       * listed until the next successful index save; do not lose the
       * in-memory entry over a transient write failure. */

      printf("vs_history: index save failed (%d), record %s kept in "
             "memory only\n", ret, index->record_key);
    }

  return 0;
}

void vs_history_close(void)
{
  unsigned int kind;

  g_ready = false;
  for (kind = 0; kind < VS_HISTORY_KIND_COUNT; kind++)
    {
      g_count[kind]    = 0;
      g_next_seq[kind] = 0;
    }
}

static void vs_render(struct vs_display_s *display,
                      struct vs_runtime_s *runtime)
{
  struct vs_ui_snapshot_s snapshot;

  vs_snapshot(runtime, &snapshot);
  (void)vs_display_render(display, &snapshot);
  if (runtime->response_pending_visible)
    {
      runtime->response_until_ms = vs_app_now_ms() + VS_RESPONSE_VISIBLE_MS;
      runtime->response_pending_visible = false;
    }
}

static void vs_expire_response(struct vs_runtime_s *runtime)
{
  if (runtime->response_until_ms != 0 &&
      (int32_t)(runtime->response_until_ms - vs_app_now_ms()) <= 0)
    {
      runtime->response_until_ms = 0;
      runtime->response_pending_visible = false;
    }
}

static void vs_set_response(struct vs_runtime_s *runtime, enum vs_key_e key,
                            const char *text)
{
  runtime->response_key = key;
  runtime->response_until_ms = vs_app_now_ms() + VS_RESPONSE_VISIBLE_MS;
  runtime->response_pending_visible = true;
  snprintf(runtime->response_text, sizeof(runtime->response_text), "%s", text);
}

static void vs_acknowledge(struct vs_runtime_s *runtime, enum vs_key_e key)
{
  struct vs_ui_snapshot_s snapshot;

  vs_snapshot(runtime, &snapshot);
  if (!snapshot.softkey[key].visible)
    return;

  vs_set_response(runtime, key, snapshot.softkey[key].text);
}

static void vs_set_error(struct vs_runtime_s *runtime, int error,
                         enum vs_page_e return_page, bool retryable);

static void vs_set_error_reason(struct vs_runtime_s *runtime, int error,
                                enum vs_page_e return_page, bool retryable,
                                const char *reason)
{
  vs_set_error(runtime, error, return_page, retryable);
  snprintf(runtime->error_reason, sizeof(runtime->error_reason), "%s (%d)",
           reason, runtime->error);
}

static void vs_switch_network(struct vs_display_s *display,
                              struct vs_runtime_s *runtime,
                              struct vs_network_s *network)
{
  enum vs_net_mode_e mode = runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_STA ?
                            VS_NET_AP : VS_NET_STA;
  int ret;

  runtime->progress = 100;
  runtime->page = VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING;
  ret = vs_start_network_worker(runtime, network, mode);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      runtime->error_target_mode = mode;
      vs_set_error(runtime, ret,
                   runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP ? VS_PAGE_SOFTAP :
                   runtime->history_blank ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
                                            VS_PAGE_HISTORY,
                   true);
    }
  else
    vs_render(display, runtime);
}

static void vs_set_error(struct vs_runtime_s *runtime, int error,
                         enum vs_page_e return_page, bool retryable)
{
  runtime->error = error != 0 ? error : -EIO;
  runtime->error_return_page = return_page;
  runtime->error_retryable = retryable;
  if (runtime->network.error == runtime->error &&
      runtime->network.error_reason[0] != '\0')
    snprintf(runtime->error_reason, sizeof(runtime->error_reason), "%s",
             runtime->network.error_reason);
  else
    snprintf(runtime->error_reason, sizeof(runtime->error_reason), "%s (%d)",
             vs_errno_reason(runtime->error), runtime->error);
  runtime->page = VS_PAGE_ERROR;
}

static void vs_handle_app_event(struct vs_runtime_s *runtime,
                                struct vs_network_s *network,
                                const struct vs_app_event_s *event)
{
  if (event->type < VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_READY &&
      (event->request_id == 0 ||
       event->request_id != runtime->active_request_id))
    {
      return;
    }

  switch (event->type)
    {
      case VS_APP_EVENT_PHOTO_READY:
        if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_PHOTO_CAPTURE)
          {
            if (event->text[0] == '\0')
              {
                vs_cancel_request(runtime);
                vs_set_error_reason(runtime, -EBADMSG, VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK,
                                    false, "拍照未返回照片");
              }
            else
              runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING;
          }
        break;

      case VS_APP_EVENT_PHOTO_FAILED:

          {
            vs_cancel_request(runtime);
            vs_set_error_reason(runtime, event->error, VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK,
                                false,
                                vs_assistant_error_reason(event->error));
          }
        break;

      case VS_APP_EVENT_VOICE_LISTENING_DONE:
        if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING)
          {
            runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_THINKING;
          }
        break;

      case VS_APP_EVENT_VOICE_REPLY:
        if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_THINKING)
          {
            if (event->text[0] == '\0')
              {
                vs_cancel_request(runtime);
                vs_set_error_reason(runtime, -EBADMSG,
                                    runtime->photo_context ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
                                                             VS_PAGE_HISTORY, false,
                                    "AI未返回回答");
              }
            else
              {
                snprintf(runtime->result_text, sizeof(runtime->result_text),
                         "%s", event->text);
                runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_SPEAKING;
              }
          }
        break;

      case VS_APP_EVENT_VOICE_FAILED:
        if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING ||
            runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_THINKING)
          {
            vs_cancel_request(runtime);
            vs_set_error_reason(runtime, event->error,
                                runtime->photo_context ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
                                                         VS_PAGE_HISTORY, false,
                                vs_assistant_error_reason(event->error));
          }
        break;

      case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_STARTED:
        if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_STARTING)
          runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
        break;

      case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_START_FAILED:
        if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_STARTING)
          {
            vs_cancel_request(runtime);
            vs_set_error_reason(runtime, event->error,
                                runtime->social_entry_return_page, false,
                                "社交会话启动失败");
          }
        break;

      case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_ALERT:
        if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING ||

            runtime->emotion = event->emotion;
            runtime->emotion_color = event->color;
            snprintf(runtime->alert_text, sizeof(runtime->alert_text), "%s",
                     event->text);
            runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ALERT;
          }
        break;

      case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_ALERT_CLEARED:
        if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ALERT ||
            runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED)
          {
            runtime->emotion = VS_EMOTION_NONE;
            runtime->emotion_color = 0;
            runtime->alert_text[0] = '\0';
            if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ALERT)
              runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
          }
        break;

      case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_PAUSED:
        if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSING)
          runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED;
        break;

      case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_RESUMED:
        if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RESUMING)
          runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
        break;

      case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_PAUSE_FAILED:
        if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSING ||
            runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RESUMING)
          vs_set_error_reason(runtime, event->error, VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING,
                              false, "社交会话操作失败");
        break;

      case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_RESULT:
        if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_FINALIZING)
          {
            if (event->text[0] == '\0')
              {
                vs_cancel_request(runtime);
                vs_set_error_reason(runtime, -EBADMSG, VS_PAGE_HISTORY, false,
                                    "社交摘要为空");
              }
            else
              {
                snprintf(runtime->result_text, sizeof(runtime->result_text),

      case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_FINALIZE_FAILED:
        if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_FINALIZING)
          {
            vs_cancel_request(runtime);
            vs_set_error_reason(runtime, event->error, VS_PAGE_HISTORY, false,
                                "社交记录整理失败");
          }
        break;

      case VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_READY:
        runtime->network_busy = false;
        if (network != NULL)
          (void)vs_network_get_status(network, &runtime->network);
        runtime->error = 0;
        runtime->error_retryable = false;
        runtime->wifi_retry_at_ms = 0;

              }
            printf("velasight: STA unavailable (%d), continuing offline\n",
                   event->error);
          }
        else
          {
            vs_set_error(runtime, event->error,
                         runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP ? VS_PAGE_SOFTAP :
                         runtime->history_blank ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
                                                  VS_PAGE_HISTORY,
                         network != NULL);
          }
        break;
    }
}

int vs_app_run(void)
{
  struct vs_display_s *display = NULL;
  struct vs_input_s *input = NULL;
  struct vs_network_s *network = NULL;
  struct vs_runtime_s runtime;
  struct vs_input_event_s event;
  struct vs_app_event_s app_event;
  int ret;

  memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
  memset(&runtime, 0, sizeof(runtime));
  runtime.page = VS_PAGE_PREPARING;
  runtime.view = VS_HISTORY_SUMMARY;
  runtime.history_blank = true;
  runtime.social_entry_return_page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK;
  runtime.network.mode = VS_NET_STA;
  runtime.network.state = VS_NET_DOWN;

  ret = vs_display_open(&display);
  if (ret < 0)
    return ret;
  vs_render(display, &runtime);
  ret = vs_input_open(&input);
  if (ret < 0)
    goto fail;

  vs_input_queue_reset();
  g_input_worker_state = input;
  ret = task_create("velasight_input", SCHED_PRIORITY_DEFAULT + 1, 2048,
                    vs_input_worker, NULL);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      g_input_worker_state = NULL;
      printf("velasight: input worker unavailable (%d)\n", ret);
      goto fail;
    }

  ret = vs_start_network_worker(&runtime, NULL, VS_NET_STA);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      runtime.error = ret;
      runtime.error_retryable = false;
      runtime.page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK;
      printf("velasight: network worker unavailable (%d), continuing "
             "offline\n", ret);
    }

  /* The preparation page is a display state, not a network gate. */
  runtime.page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK;
  runtime.progress = 0;
  runtime.network.wifi_issue = VS_WIFI_ISSUE_DISCONNECTED;
  vs_render(display, &runtime);

  bk7258_nand_seed_agent_config();
  runtime.api_ready = bk7258_ai_config_ready();
  vs_history_open();
  vs_voice_open();

  vs_render(display, &runtime);
  for (;;)
    {
      if (runtime.response_until_ms != 0)
        {
          uint32_t now = vs_app_now_ms();

          if ((int32_t)(runtime.response_until_ms - now) <= 0)
            {
              vs_expire_response(&runtime);
              vs_render(display, &runtime);
            }
        }

      /* Input feedback never blocks its action.  SHORT updates the business
       * state immediately and carries its visual overlay onto the resulting
       * page. */
      {
        unsigned int input_count = 0;

        while (input_count < VS_INPUT_EVENTS_PER_FRAME &&
               vs_input_queue_pop(&event))
          {
            vs_handle_event(display, &runtime, network, &event);
            input_count++;
          }

        if (input_count != 0)
          {
            vs_render(display, &runtime);
          }
      }

      /* Each app event may synchronously push one or both full panels.  Handle
       * one per pass so a burst cannot keep an already queued press waiting. */
      if (vs_app_pop_event(&app_event))
        {
          if (app_event.type == VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_READY ||
              app_event.type == VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_FAILED)
            network = vs_take_network_result();
          vs_handle_app_event(&runtime, network, &app_event);
          vs_render(display, &runtime);
        }

      if (network != NULL && !runtime.network_busy)
        {
          ret = vs_network_process_events(network);
          if (ret != 0)
            {
              (void)vs_network_get_status(network, &runtime.network);
              runtime.api_ready = bk7258_ai_config_ready();
              if (ret < 0)
                {
                  runtime.error_target_mode = VS_NET_STA;
                  vs_set_error(&runtime, ret, VS_PAGE_SOFTAP, false);
                }
              else
                {
                  vs_update_wifi_retry(&runtime);
                }
              vs_render(display, &runtime);
            }
        }

      if (!runtime.network_busy &&
          runtime.wifi_retry_at_ms != 0 &&
          (int32_t)(vs_app_now_ms() - runtime.wifi_retry_at_ms) >= 0)
        {
          runtime.wifi_retry_at_ms = 0;
          printf("velasight: retrying STA connection\n");
          ret = vs_start_network_worker(&runtime, network, VS_NET_STA);
          if (ret < 0)
            {
              runtime.wifi_retry_at_ms = vs_app_now_ms() + VS_WIFI_RETRY_MS;
            }
          vs_render(display, &runtime);
        }

      vs_display_tick(display);
      usleep(CONFIG_VS_INPUT_POLL_MS * 1000);
    }

fail:
  vs_voice_close();
  vs_history_close();
  vs_network_close(network);
  vs_input_close(input);
  vs_display_close(display);
  return ret;
}

    cJSON* text_part = cJSON_CreateObject();
    cJSON* img_part = cJSON_CreateObject();
    cJSON* img_url_obj = cJSON_CreateObject();
    cJSON* user_msg = cJSON_CreateObject();
    cJSON* messages = cJSON_CreateArray();
    cJSON* body = cJSON_CreateObject();
    char* data_uri = NULL;

        || !user_msg || !messages || !body) {
        cJSON_Delete(content_arr);
        cJSON_Delete(text_part);
        cJSON_Delete(img_part);
        cJSON_Delete(img_url_obj);
        cJSON_Delete(user_msg);
        cJSON_Delete(messages);
        cJSON_Delete(body);

    size_t b64_len = strlen(image_b64);
    size_t prefix_len = 5 + strlen(mime_type) + 8;
    size_t uri_len = prefix_len + b64_len + 1;
    data_uri = malloc(uri_len);

        cJSON_Delete(content_arr);
        cJSON_Delete(img_part);
        cJSON_Delete(img_url_obj);
        cJSON_Delete(user_msg);
        cJSON_Delete(messages);
        cJSON_Delete(body);
        snprintf(response_buf, buf_size, "Error: OOM building data URI");
        return ERROR;

    cJSON_AddStringToObject(img_url_obj, "url", data_uri);
    cJSON_AddItemToObject(img_part, "image_url", img_url_obj);
    cJSON_AddItemToArray(content_arr, img_part);

/* ── JSON string escape helper ────────────────────────────── */

static char* json_escape_string(const char* src)
{
    if (!src)
        return NULL;

    size_t src_len = strlen(src);
    size_t cap = src_len * 6 + 1;
    char* out = malloc(cap);
    if (!out)
        return NULL;

    char* w = out;
    for (const char* r = src; *r; r++) {
        unsigned char c = (unsigned char)*r;
        switch (c) {
        case '"':  *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = '"';  break;
        case '\\': *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = '\\'; break;
        case '\n': *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = 'n';  break;
        case '\r': *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = 'r';  break;
        case '\t': *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = 't';  break;
        case '\b': *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = 'b';  break;
        case '\f': *w++ = '\\'; *w++ = 'f';  break;
        default:
            if (c < 0x20) {
                w += sprintf(w, "\\u%04x", c);
            } else {
                *w++ = (char)c;
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    *w = '\0';
    return out;

    llm_snapshot_vision_config(model, sizeof(model),
        api_key, sizeof(api_key),
        llm_host, sizeof(llm_host));

    if (api_key[0] == '\0') {
        snprintf(response_buf, buf_size, "Error: No API key configured");
        return ERROR;
    }

    if (!mime_type || !mime_type[0])
        mime_type = "image/jpeg";

    if (!prompt || !prompt[0])
        prompt = AGENT_VISION_DEFAULT_PROMPT;

    char* escaped_prompt = json_escape_string(prompt);
    if (!escaped_prompt) {
        snprintf(response_buf, buf_size, "Error: OOM escaping prompt");
        return ERROR;
    }

    int max_tokens = AGENT_VISION_MAX_TOKENS;
    const char* tokens_key = is_openai_compat_host(llm_host)
        ? "max_completion_tokens"
        : "max_tokens";

    size_t b64_len = 0;
    mbedtls_base64_encode(NULL, 0, &b64_len, raw_image, raw_len);

    const char* hdr_fmt = "{\"model\":\"%s\",\"%s\":%d,\"messages\":"
                          "[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":["
                          "{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"%s\"},"
                          "{\"type\":\"image_url\",\"image_url\":"
                          "{\"url\":\"data:%s;base64,";
    const char* trailer = "\"}}]}]}";

    size_t hdr_max = strlen(hdr_fmt) + sizeof(model) + 32
        + strlen(tokens_key) + strlen(escaped_prompt)
        + strlen(mime_type) + 64;
    size_t total = hdr_max + b64_len + strlen(trailer) + 1;

    char* body = malloc(total);
    if (!body) {
        free(escaped_prompt);
        snprintf(response_buf, buf_size, "Error: OOM building vision request");
        return ERROR;
    }

    int off = snprintf(body, total, hdr_fmt,
        model_name_for_api(model, llm_host), tokens_key, max_tokens,
        escaped_prompt, mime_type);
    free(escaped_prompt);

    size_t written = 0;
    int rc = mbedtls_base64_encode(
        (unsigned char*)(body + off),
        total - (size_t)off - strlen(trailer) - 1,
        &written, raw_image, raw_len);
    if (rc != 0) {
        free(body);
        snprintf(response_buf, buf_size,
            "Error: base64 encode failed (%d)", rc);
        return ERROR;
    }
    off += (int)written;

    memcpy(body + off, trailer, strlen(trailer) + 1);

    syslog(LOG_INFO,
        "[%s] Vision raw API call (model: %s, body=%d bytes, "
        "image=%zu raw -> %zu b64)\n",
        TAG, model, off + (int)strlen(trailer), raw_len, written);

    resp_buf_t rb = { 0 };
    int status = 0;
    int err = llm_http_call(body, &rb, &status);
    free(body);

    if (err != OK) {
        resp_buf_free(&rb);
        snprintf(response_buf, buf_size, "Error: Vision HTTP request failed");
        return err;
    }

    if (status != 200) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "[%s] Vision raw API error HTTP %d: %.300s\n",
            TAG, status, rb.data ? rb.data : "");
        snprintf(response_buf, buf_size,
            "Vision API error (HTTP %d): %.200s",
            status, rb.data ? rb.data : "");
        resp_buf_free(&rb);
        return ERROR;
    }

    cJSON* root = cJSON_Parse(rb.data);
    resp_buf_free(&rb);

    if (!root) {
        snprintf(response_buf, buf_size,
            "Error: Failed to parse vision response");
        return ERROR;
    }

    extract_text(root, response_buf, buf_size);
    cJSON_Delete(root);

    if (response_buf[0] == '\0')
        snprintf(response_buf, buf_size, "No response from Vision API");
    else
        syslog(LOG_DEBUG, "[%s] Vision response: %d bytes\n", TAG,
            (int)strlen(response_buf));

    return OK;
}

#include "llm/llm_internal.h"
#include "llm/llm_parse.h"
#include "llm/llm_proxy.h"

#include "network/network_manager.h"
#endif

#include "cJSON.h"
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static const char* TAG = "llm";

static char s_api_key[128] = { 0 };
static char s_model[64] = AGENT_LLM_DEFAULT_MODEL;
static char s_llm_host[128] = AGENT_LLM_API_HOST;
static char s_llm_path[128] = AGENT_LLM_API_PATH;
static char s_llm_port[8] = "443"; /* "443" for HTTPS, "80" etc for HTTP */

/* Independent vision model config — empty means fall back to main LLM */
static char s_vision_model[64] = { 0 };
static char s_vision_host[128] = { 0 };
static char s_vision_api_key[128] = { 0 };

static pthread_mutex_t s_llm_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

/* Check if host uses OpenAI-compatible max_completion_tokens param */
bool is_openai_compat_host(const char* host)
{
    return strstr(host, "openai.com")
        || strstr(host, "openrouter.ai")
        || strstr(host, "xiaomimimo.com");
}


int resp_buf_init(resp_buf_t* rb, size_t initial_cap)
{
    rb->data = calloc(1, initial_cap);
    if (!rb->data)
        return ERROR;
    rb->len = 0;
    rb->cap = initial_cap;
    return OK;
}

int resp_buf_append(resp_buf_t* rb, const char* data, size_t len)
{
    while (rb->len + len >= rb->cap) {
        size_t new_cap = rb->cap * 2;
        if (new_cap > AGENT_LLM_MAX_RESP_SIZE) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "llm: resp_buf exceeded %d limit\n",
                AGENT_LLM_MAX_RESP_SIZE);
            return ERROR;
        }
        char* tmp = realloc(rb->data, new_cap);
        if (!tmp)
            return ERROR;
        rb->data = tmp;
        rb->cap = new_cap;
    }
    memcpy(rb->data + rb->len, data, len);
    rb->len += len;
    rb->data[rb->len] = '\0';
    return OK;
}

void resp_buf_free(resp_buf_t* rb)
{
    if (rb->data) {
        free(rb->data);
        rb->data = NULL;
    }
    rb->len = 0;
    rb->cap = 0;
}

/* ── Init ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

int llm_proxy_init(void)
{
    if (AGENT_SECRET_API_KEY[0])
        strncpy(s_api_key, AGENT_SECRET_API_KEY, sizeof(s_api_key) - 1);
    if (AGENT_SECRET_MODEL[0])
        strncpy(s_model, AGENT_SECRET_MODEL, sizeof(s_model) - 1);

    /* Endpoint from build-time secrets too.  Without this the key and model
     * can be compiled in but the host cannot, because AGENT_LLM_API_HOST is
     * an unconditional #define that agent_secrets.h cannot override -- so a
     * board configured entirely at build time still had nowhere to send the
     * request, and the only way to set a host was set_llm at runtime, which
     * is lost with /mnt on every power cycle.
     */

    if (AGENT_SECRET_LLM_HOST[0])
        strncpy(s_llm_host, AGENT_SECRET_LLM_HOST, sizeof(s_llm_host) - 1);
    if (AGENT_SECRET_LLM_PATH[0])
        strncpy(s_llm_path, AGENT_SECRET_LLM_PATH, sizeof(s_llm_path) - 1);

    char tmp[128] = { 0 };
    if (claw_config_get(AGENT_CFG_KEY_API_KEY, tmp, sizeof(tmp)) == OK && tmp[0])
        strncpy(s_api_key, tmp, sizeof(s_api_key) - 1);
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof(tmp));
    if (claw_config_get(AGENT_CFG_KEY_MODEL, tmp, sizeof(tmp)) == OK && tmp[0])
        strncpy(s_model, tmp, sizeof(s_model) - 1);

    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof(tmp));
    if (claw_config_get(AGENT_CFG_KEY_LLM_HOST, tmp, sizeof(tmp)) == OK && tmp[0])
        strncpy(s_llm_host, tmp, sizeof(s_llm_host) - 1);
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof(tmp));
    if (claw_config_get(AGENT_CFG_KEY_LLM_PATH, tmp, sizeof(tmp)) == OK && tmp[0])
        strncpy(s_llm_path, tmp, sizeof(s_llm_path) - 1);
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof(tmp));
    if (claw_config_get("llm_port", tmp, sizeof(tmp)) == OK && tmp[0])
        strncpy(s_llm_port, tmp, sizeof(s_llm_port) - 1);

    /* Load optional vision model config — empty falls back to main LLM */
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof(tmp));
    if (claw_config_get(AGENT_CFG_KEY_VISION_MODEL, tmp, sizeof(tmp)) == OK && tmp[0])
        strncpy(s_vision_model, tmp, sizeof(s_vision_model) - 1);
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof(tmp));
    if (claw_config_get(AGENT_CFG_KEY_VISION_HOST, tmp, sizeof(tmp)) == OK && tmp[0])
        strncpy(s_vision_host, tmp, sizeof(s_vision_host) - 1);
    memset(tmp, 0, sizeof(tmp));
    if (claw_config_get(AGENT_CFG_KEY_VISION_API_KEY, tmp, sizeof(tmp)) == OK && tmp[0])
        strncpy(s_vision_api_key, tmp, sizeof(s_vision_api_key) - 1);

    if (s_api_key[0])
        syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] LLM proxy initialized (model: %s, host: %s)\n", TAG,
            s_model, s_llm_host);
    else
        syslog(LOG_WARNING, "[%s] No API key. Use CLI: set_llm <preset> <key>\n", TAG);

#ifndef __APP_VELASIGHT_INCLUDE_VS_MEDIA_H
#define __APP_VELASIGHT_INCLUDE_VS_MEDIA_H

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

/* One still frame captured from /dev/video0.  data is heap or PSRAM
 * allocated depending on from_psram; callers must always release it through
 * vs_media_frame_release() rather than free()/bk7258_psram_free() directly,
 * so the allocator choice stays an implementation detail of vs_media.c.
 */

struct vs_media_frame_s
{
  unsigned char *data;
  size_t         len;
  uint16_t       width;
  uint16_t       height;
  bool           from_psram;
};

/* Capture exactly one JPEG frame and close /dev/video0 before returning.
 * Blocking, roughly 300 ms.  width/height must match one of the sensor's
 * fixed modes (480x480, 640x480, 864x480); anything else fails fast with
 * -EINVAL instead of reaching the driver.
 *
 * Returns 0 and fills *frame, or a negative errno:
 *   -EINVAL    unsupported geometry or bad argument
 *   -ENODEV    /dev/video0 could not be opened
 *   -ETIMEDOUT no frame within the capture window
 *   -EBADMSG   a frame arrived but is not a well-formed JPEG
 *   -ENOMEM    no buffer available for the frame
 *   (other)    the underlying ioctl's errno
 */

int  vs_media_capture_jpeg(struct vs_media_frame_s *frame,
                           uint16_t width, uint16_t height);

/* Release a frame produced by vs_media_capture_jpeg().  Safe to call with a
 * zeroed or already-released frame. */

void vs_media_frame_release(struct vs_media_frame_s *frame);

#endif /* __APP_VELASIGHT_INCLUDE_VS_MEDIA_H */

		Upper bound, in bytes, on how much of the running conversation

		replayed into the next prompt.  When appending the latest turn
		would cross CONFIG_VS_VOICE_CONTEXT_COMPACT_PERCENT of this
		budget, the conversation so far is compacted to a short summary
		via one extra model call before the next turn is sent, and the
		verbatim turns are discarded in favor of that summary.

	int "VelaSight idle assistant context compaction threshold (percent)"
	default 80
	range 50 95
	depends on LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_264_VELASIGHT
	---help---
		Percentage of CONFIG_VS_VOICE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES at which the
		running conversation is compacted (see above).  The product
		requirement this implements is stated in terms of the model's
		own maximum context (mimo-v2.5 advertises a 1M-token window);
		CONFIG_VS_VOICE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES is deliberately a much smaller,
		locally-enforced budget, because this device's own conversation
		length in one sitting never approaches a million tokens and a
		budget sized to it would make local RAM the only limit that
		exists in practice.  See vs_voice.c's chat-context module for the
		full reasoning.

一、必须修复（阻断）

1. API 已断裂，CHAT 也尚未真正接入。
- `include/vs_history.h:107-109` 将 `vs_history_read_full` 改成四参数 `(kind, record_key, buf, len)`，但 `vs_voice.c:480` 仍以旧的三参数形式调用。这在有原型可见的 C 编译中会报参数类型/数量错误；该调用来自 SOCIAL 历史询问，应至少显式传 `VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL`。
- `vs_app.c:1147-1158` 的 `count/get_index` 调用已经按 SOCIAL 更新，调用点本身一致。
- 全仓没有任何 `vs_history_append()` 调用。`vs_voice.c:162-217` 只新增了 `g_conv` 数据结构，注释提到的 `vs_voice_conv_persist/reset` 并不存在；CHAT 不会生成任何记录。Kconfig 的静默结束、上下文压缩等描述因此也不是已实现行为。
- `vs_history_open()` 的返回值在 `vs_app.c:1438-1440` 被忽略。存储初始化失败后应用仍继续，无法区分“只有内存 seed”与“可持久化”。

2. 满容量淘汰破坏了模块自己声称的掉电不变量，且失败无回滚。
- `vs_history.c:695-697` 在写新正文之前调用 `vs_history_evict_oldest()`；该函数在 `536-552` 立即删除旧正文并减少内存计数，而磁盘上的旧 `INDEX.JSN` 尚未更新。
- 此时若断电，旧索引仍引用已删除正文；若新正文写入在 `704-715` 失败，函数返回错误，但旧记录已经从内存和磁盘正文中丢失；若索引保存失败，状态更糟。
- `vs_history_save_index()` 失败后，`728-739` 只打印日志，最终仍返回 0；调用者会把未持久化记录当成成功，重启后记录消失。`g_count/g_next_seq` 和 caller 的 `index->record_key/kind` 也没有回滚。
- 正确提交顺序应为：串行化 writer；先原子落新正文；在临时副本中构造“新记录 + 去掉最老项”的索引；原子提交新索引；提交成功后再更新内存并删除旧正文。这样断电前保留完整旧状态，断电后最多留下旧正文孤儿，而不会留下索引悬挂。索引提交失败必须返回负 errno，并保持旧内存/旧正文/旧索引不变。

3. seed 没有真正持久化索引，seed 正文自身也不具备承诺的原子性。
- `vs_history_load_seed()` 在 `227-274` 只复制内存索引，并以 `fopen/fputs/fclose` best-effort 写三个正文（`264-267`）；不检查写入结果，不 `fsync`，不用临时文件重命名。
- 整个 seed 路径没有调用 `vs_history_save_index()`；该函数只在普通 append 的 `728` 被调用。因此首次启动后 `social/INDEX.JSN` 不存在，下一次启动会再次 seed，Web 若依赖索引也无法列出示例。答案是：当前 seed **没有真正持久化 index**。
- 修复时应在目录创建成功后，先用 `vs_history_atomic_write()` 落全部 seed 正文，再原子保存 SOCIAL 索引；任一步失败应上报，不能宣称成功。还要处理“无索引但已有同名正文”的孤儿，否则 seed 元数据可能错误绑定到先前 append 失败留下的真实正文。

4. `open()` 把缺失、损坏、OOM 和 I/O 错误混成“首次启动”，有覆盖真实历史的风险。
- `vs_history_load_index()` 的 `fopen` 失败在 `342-347` 一律返回 `-ENOENT`，没有返回真实 `-errno`；`vs_history_open()` 在 `581-603` 又把 SOCIAL 的任意负值都变成 seed、CHAT 的任意负值都变成空表。有效但过大、损坏、内存不足或介质 I/O 错误都可能被误判为新盘，后续 append 会用 seed/空表覆盖原索引并孤立真实正文。
- 只应在确认 `-ENOENT` 时 seed/建空表；`-EBADMSG/-ENOMEM/-EIO` 应保留原文件、返回错误或进入明确的只读恢复状态。所有 `mkdir`（`576-579`）也必须接受 `EEXIST`、传播其他错误。
- 存储等待失败时，`568-574` 仍设置 `g_ready=true`，使 append 继续尝试一个不存在的存储。应至少拆分“可浏览内存 seed”和“持久存储可写”两个状态。该实现也与头文件 `75-79` 所称“失败后两表为零”不一致。

{"content":"/* record_key is a short, stable identifier ("R00000001") used both as the
 * on-disk record file's stem and as the handle vs_voice.c freezes at the
 * moment a question is asked, so a later page change cannot make the
 * question answer a different record than the one shown on screen.
 */

#define VS_HISTORY_KEY_MAX 16

/* Two independent kinds of record share this module's index/file/atomic-
 * write machinery, but live in separate directories and separate in-memory
 * tables so that browsing one can never show, count or evict the other:
 *
 *   SOCIAL   one completed social-assist session (emotion timeline, audio
 *            timeline, TTS/text minutes -- the fields the cloud protocol in
 *            docs' "OpenVela比赛云端技术方案" calls back with on session
 *            close).  Written by the social-assist pipeline; this change
 *            does not add a producer for it, only the storage shape and a
 *            way to seed sample data for the UI/Web preview.
 *
 *   CHAT     one finished idle-assistant conversation (one or more
 *            question/answer turns run back to back without the user
 *            leaving the voice pages).  Written by vs_voice.c when a
 *            conversation ends (silence timeout or an explicit exit).
 *
 * Both are record_key-addressable, both get an index entry with a short
 * summary for the on-device list, and both get a full JSON body for the
 * model prompt (CHAT) or the Web download (either).  A single record_key
 * namespace is not shared between kinds -- "R00000003" in SOCIAL and
 * "R00000003" in CHAT are unrelated files in different directories -- so
 * kind must always travel with the key.
 */

enum vs_history_kind_e
{
  VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL = 0,
  VS_HISTORY_KIND_CHAT,
  VS_HISTORY_KIND_COUNT
};

struct vs_history_index_s
{
  enum vs_history_kind_e kind;
  char     record_key[VS_HISTORY_KEY_MAX];
  char     date[VS_TEXT_SHORT];
  char     title[VS_TEXT_SHORT];
  char     summary[VS_TEXT_LONG];
  uint8_t  calm;
  uint8_t  happy;
  uint8_t  tense;
  bool     incomplete;
};

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: vs_history_open
 *
 * Description:
 *   Wait for the SD-NAND store, load both kinds' indexes into memory, and
 *   seed the SOCIAL table with built-in demo records the very first time no
 *   store exists yet so the UI and the Web preview keep showing something
 *   meaningful before any real session has been written.  The CHAT table is
 *   never seeded with demo data: an idle-assistant history with fabricated
 *   turns in it would be actively misleading to reread as prompt context.
 *   Blocking: SD-NAND automount can take tens of seconds.  Call once at
 *   startup, never from the UI hot path.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   0 on success (including "seeded fresh"), or a negative errno.  A
 *   failure here still leaves both in-memory indexes at zero records rather
 *   than leaving the caller without a usable vs_history_count().
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

int vs_history_open(void);

/* Number of records currently known for one kind.  In-memory only, never
 * blocks, safe to call from vs_snapshot(). */

unsigned int vs_history_count(enum vs_history_kind_e kind);

/* Copy index fields for record i of one kind (0-based, 0 is the newest).
 * In-memory only, never blocks.  Returns 0, or -EINVAL if i is out of
 * range. */

int vs_history_get_index(enum vs_history_kind_e kind, unsigned int i,
                         struct vs_history_index_s *out);

/* Read the stored full record for record_key as a NUL-terminated JSON
 * object string.  For CHAT this is {"turns":[...],"record_key":"..."} (see
 * vs_voice.c's chat-context module); for SOCIAL this is the shape the
 * cloud/AI pipeline's session-close callback produces (audioTimeline,
 * emotionTimeline, ttsMinutes, txtMinutes -- see docs' cloud API plan).
 * Opens a file: call only from a worker thread, never from the UI hot path.
 *
 * Returns the number of bytes written (excluding the NUL), or a negative
 * errno.  -ENOENT means record_key is not on disk for that kind (stale key,
 * or the store was cleared). */

int vs_history_read_full(enum vs_history_kind_e kind, const char *record_key,
                         char *buf, size_t len);

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: vs_history_append
 *
 * Description:
 *   Add one record of the given kind.  index->record_key is generated and
 *   filled in on return; any value the caller put there is ignored.
 *   full_json, when non-NULL, is stored verbatim as the full record body
 *   alongside the index fields (it must already be a valid, NUL-terminated
 *   JSON object fragment with no trailing content); NULL stores only the
 *   index fields.
 *
 *   Writes go through a temp-file-then-rename sequence with fsync so a
 *   power loss mid-write leaves either the old state or the new one, never
 *   a half-written file.  Call only from a worker thread.
 *
 *   When the in-memory index for this kind is already at
 *   CONFIG_VS_HISTORY_MAX_RECORDS, the oldest record (both its index entry
 *   and its on-disk body file) is evicted first to make room -- this is a
 *   bounded ring, not a hard cap that starts refusing new records; a
 *   product meant to keep running for months cannot do otherwise.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   0 on success, or a negative errno.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

int vs_history_append(enum vs_history_kind_e kind,
                      struct vs_history_index_s *index,
                      const char *full_json);

void vs_history_close(void);

#endif /* __APP_VELASIGHT_INCLUDE_VS_HISTORY_H */
"}

		requirement this implements is stated in terms of the model's
		own maximum context (mimo-v2.5 advertises a 1M-token window);
		CONFIG_VS_VOICE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES is deliberately a much smaller,
		locally-enforced budget, because this device's own conversation
		length in one sitting never approaches a million tokens and a
		budget sized to it would make local RAM the only limit that
		exists in practice.  See vs_voice.c's chat-context module for the

<![CDATA[
结论：目标可实现，但不能只在现有 HTML 中加三个按钮。现成的两个关键基础是：HTTP listener 已绑定 `0.0.0.0`，所以只要服务仍在运行，它天然能从 AP 地址和 STA DHCP 地址访问；SOCIAL 已有“内存索引 + 单条 JSON 文件”的存储形态。真正缺口是：当前服务只在 AP 启动、AP→STA 前主动停止且 STA 成功后不重启；HTTP 路由和响应均为固定小缓冲；历史 API 不能安全地被 listener 线程并发调用或流式读取；而且当前 SOCIAL 只有 seed 数据，没有真实生产者。

一、现有模块与调用链

1. `app/provisioning_web` 的生产代码职责完整且分层清楚：
- `include/velasight_provisioning.h:25-94,99-134` 定义凭据、启动参数、保存后回调以及 `start/stop/load` 公共 API。服务明确不控制 Wi-Fi、DHCP 或 AP/STA 角色。
- `vp_form.c`/`vp_form.h:15-78` 负责 form-urlencoded 解码及 SSID、密码、MiMo key、Volcengine 字段校验；最多 16 个字段，未知字段忽略，重复已知字段拒绝。
- `vp_store.c`/`vp_store.h:35-151` 负责 818 字节 v3 凭据记录、CRC、临时文件、fsync/rename 恢复。这部分只影响配置写入，与历史 JSON 不共用存储格式。
- `vp_http.c:103-330` 是严格但非常窄的请求解析器；`vp_http.c:333-543` 生成整页 HTML 响应。
- `vp_server.c:25-73,622-793` 是全局单实例 socket/pthread 生命周期；`vp_server.c:107-599` 读请求、处理一个 client、写响应及保存后回调。
- `provisioning_web_main.c:1-158,262-390` 是前台 NSH 命令及板端 loopback selftest。它保持命令不返回，因为 NuttX task 退出会终止其 pthread 组。

2. VelaSight 的真实调用链是：
- `vs_app.c:245-313` 在 detached network worker 中调用 `vs_network_open()` 和 `vs_network_request_mode()`；VelaSight 主任务持续存在，因此 listener pthread 仍属于长驻任务组。
- 启动默认请求 STA：`vs_app.c:1386-1441`。值得注意的是 network worker 在 `vs_history_open()` 之前启动，未来若在 STA-ready 时立即开放历史接口，可能先于历史初始化完成。
- AP 路径在 `vs_network_apply_ap()` 中完成 ifdown/up、AP associate、设置 `192.168.10.1/24`、启动 DHCP，然后才调用 `velasight_provisioning_start()`：`vs_network.c:403-524`。
- AP→STA 时，`vs_network_request_mode()` 先 stop listener、join，消费已经完成的保存事件，再停 DHCP 和关联 STA：`vs_network.c:590-664`。
- STA 成功只设置 `sta_ipv4_ready` 和状态，不启动 Web：`vs_network.c:286-400`。因此当前 STA 局域网无法访问。
- 保存回调只在 listener 线程中置 `provision_event`；主循环经 `vs_network_process_events()` 加载新配置并调用 `bk7258_nand_seed_agent_config()`：`vs_network.c:242-281,665-739`。保存后不会自动断开当前 STA；新 Wi-Fi 凭据要等下一次显式 STA apply，API key 类配置则会重新 seed。

二、现有 server 生命周期、socket 和线程模型

- 单实例：`g_server`、`g_request`、`g_response` 都是进程全局静态对象；第二次 start 返回 `-EALREADY`，见 `vp_server.c:41-73,622-730`。
- start 创建 stop pipe、`AF_INET/SOCK_STREAM` socket，设置 `SO_REUSEADDR`，绑定 `INADDR_ANY:<port>`，`listen(..., 2)`，再启动 8 KiB listener pthread。没有 `SO_BINDTODEVICE`、没有 IPv6，也没有只限 AP 地址的约束。因此“同一局域网可访问”的 socket 条件已经满足；欠缺的是 STA 生命周期与向用户展示实际 DHCP IPv4。当前 STA 状态只写字符串 `"STA READY"`，见 `vs_network.c:391-399`。
- listener 用 `poll(listenfd, stoprd)`，一次 `accept` 后在同一线程同步读、处理、写、close；没有每连接线程或 worker pool，见 `vp_server.c:416-599`。浏览器并发连接由 backlog 暂存，但一个慢下载会阻塞所有配置提交和其他历史请求。
- client 设置 2 秒收发 socket timeout和 1 秒 linger；close 前清除 `clientfd`，close 后才触发保存回调，保证应用切 Wi-Fi 不会截断成功页：`vp_server.c:500-570`。
- stop 通过 pipe 立即打断 accept/request poll；若 client 活跃则把 linger 改成 0，非 listener 线程调用时 join。若保存回调在 listener 自己调用 stop，则只置 stopping，避免 self-join：`vp_server.c:731-793`。
- one-shot 成功保存后线程自行结束为 FINISHED，后续 start/stop 会 reap：`vp_server.c:560-620`。

AP 与 STA 切换建议采用“停止后重启”，而不是赌 listener socket 能跨 `ifdown` 保持：
1. 任意角色切换（AP→STA、STA→AP、STA retry）前先 `velasight_provisioning_stop()`；这样活动 client 被中断、线程已 join、保存回调不再竞争。
2. stop 后消费最后一个保存事件；AP→STA 必须在关联前加载新 SSID/密码。
3. 执行 ifdown/up、角色配置和地址获取。
4. AP 在静态地址和 DHCP server 成功后重启；STA 在 association 和 `netlib_obtain_ipv4addr()` 成功后重启。`SO_REUSEADDR` 已支持快速重绑。
5. 切换失败时保持 `provision_running=false`；回到 AP 成功时再启动。当前若未来让 STA 也运行 listener，却不修改 STA→AP 路径，`vs_network_apply_ap()` 会再次 start 并得到 `-EALREADY`，所以两向切换都必须统一处理。
6. `vs_network_process_events()` 的保存失败分支当前无条件把状态设为 `VS_NET_AP_READY`（`vs_network.c:724-729`）；STA 开放保存后必须改成保留当前 STA 状态。

理论上 `INADDR_ANY` listener 可一直存在并在新地址上接收，但 NuttX 对接口撤销期间的 listening PCB/活动 TCP 行为在此仓库没有测试，且活动 HTTP 响应必然会断。stop/restart 是可验证、故障边界清楚的方案，中间的不可访问窗口与 radio 本身的断网窗口重合。

三、HTTP 解析与响应限制

- 当前仅支持 `GET /`、`GET /index.html` 和 `POST /save`；GET query 被直接剥掉且不保存，其他方法 405、其他路径 404：`vp_http.c:103-217`。要做分页、record key 和 download，必须扩展 action/route，而不只是改 `vp_handle()`。
- 请求头上限 2048、body 上限 1024、整体请求静态缓冲 3073 字节；完整响应静态缓冲 4096 字节：`vp_http.h:20-29`、`vp_server.c:68-73`。
- POST 必须有数字 `Content-Length` 和 form-urlencoded；任何 `Transfer-Encoding`（包括 chunked）拒绝，body 为空拒绝：`vp_http.c:219-330`。解析器不保存 Host、Origin、Authorization，也无 Cookie/CSRF 概念。
- 所有现有响应先完整构造在栈上 2048 字节 body，再包装进 4096 字节 `g_response`，统一 `text/html`、`Content-Length`、`Cache-Control: no-store`、`Connection: close`：`vp_http.c:384-543`。这无法承载任意大小 JSON 文件。
- `vp_write_all()` 已正确处理 partial send、EINTR，以及 NuttX 的 ENOMEM/EAGAIN/ENOBUFS，并可由 stop pipe 中断，因而可复用于逐块流式发送：`vp_server.c:107-160`。
- README 的“读超时 5 秒”已与代码漂移：代码只累计 poll 空闲时间到 1500 ms，socket timeout 是 2 秒，见 `vp_server.c:32-38,176-270` 与 `README.md:130-132`。而且该 1500 ms 不是绝对 deadline：客户端每少于 200 ms 发送一点数据时，`waited` 不增长，可一直拖到头/body 字节上限。
- 明文 HTTP、无认证；AP 时风险被 WPA2 热点范围部分约束，STA 常驻后，同 LAN 任意主机都可读取私密 SOCIAL 内容并覆盖 Wi-Fi/API/语音凭据。若这是生产功能，至少应有设备屏幕显示的访问 PIN/会话认证和 CSRF token；否则“同 LAN 可调整配置”会把当前安全边界显著扩大。

四、SOCIAL 历史的现状与阻塞问题

- 存储位置与形态在 `vs_history.c:81-196`：SOCIAL index 位于 `/mnt/sdnand/ai_agent/history/social/INDEX.JSN`，单条正文为 `R%08u.JSN`；内存 index 最新在 0，容量由 `CONFIG_VS_HISTORY_MAX_RECORDS`（默认 64）限制。

五、建议的 HTTP API 与页面结构

建议保持现有配置入口兼容，同时增加同源、分页、懒加载 API：

- `GET /api/history/social?offset=0&limit=10`：返回 `{total,offset,items:[...]}`，只含 index 字段。限制 `limit`（例如 16），否则 64 × 最长字段很容易超过 4 KiB。
- `GET /api/history/social/R00000001`：返回原始正文，`Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`，供预览；列表 metadata 由上一接口提供。
- `GET /api/history/social/R00000001/download`：发送同一原始文件，增加 `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="R00000001.JSN"`。
- provider 未安装或 history 尚未 ready 返回 503；非法 key 返回 400；不在 SOCIAL index/正文已丢失返回 404；I/O 错误返回 500。只接受严格 `^R[0-9]{8}$`，并在锁内确认 index membership 后打开文件。

配置 API 必须解决现有“空值歧义”：当前页面不回填密码，但 `vp_form_parse()` 把空/缺失 password 解释为开放网络；因此用户在 STA 只想改 MiMo key 时，提交空密码会把已存 WPA2 Wi-Fi 覆盖成 open。三个 API/voice secret 空值则被 server解释为“保留旧值”，导致又无法显式清除。建议给配置提交定义显式动作，例如 `wifi_password_action=keep|replace|open`，每个可选 secret 提供 `keep|replace|clear`，或改为结构化 `/api/config` PATCH。GET 配置只能返回 SSID/security 与 `*_configured` 布尔值，绝不能返回 secret。若要求立即应用新 Wi-Fi，保存回调后由 app 主线程安排 stop/reassociate；不能在 HTTP 响应完成前切网。

六、流式发送文件的具体做法

不要扩大 `VP_HTTP_RESPONSE_MAX` 来容纳正文。应当：
1. history provider 在验证 kind/key 和 index membership 后 `open()`，同时 `fstat()` 得到稳定 fd 和长度；不要先返回路径再二次打开。
2. 用小缓冲生成 HTTP header，写入 `Content-Length`、JSON content type、no-store、nosniff、Connection close；download 路由再加固定格式的 Content-Disposition。
3. 用 1 KiB～2 KiB scratch buffer 循环 `read(fd, chunk, sizeof chunk)`，处理 EINTR/short read，每块调用现有 `vp_write_all()`。
4. 每块之间检查 stop pipe/`vp_stopping()`；读到 EOF 时校验累计字节等于 fstat 长度。发生 client disconnect 只结束该响应，不影响历史文件。
5. 对正文设合理最大值和 send 总 deadline。当前 `vs_history_append()` 对 `full_json` 没有大小上限，单线程 server 若下载超大文件会长时间饿死 `/save`。

必须使“触发阈值”取本地 context 预算、实际 prompt 可用预算（扣除 system/source/JSON 转义开销）两者最小值，或同步调整默认配置并改为动态 context 存储。`MAX_TURNS` 按其文档是整段会话硬上限，达到时应正常持久化结束，不能覆盖旧 turn。

三、当前依赖 API 的阻断问题

1. `voice_vad` 实际不存在
- `vs_voice.c:103` 包含 `<voice/voice_vad.h>`，并在 `704`、`740-743` 使用 `voice_vad_init/process`。
- 但 manifest 指向的实际 `packages/ai_agent/include/voice` 只有 audio_capture/audio_playback/voice_asr/voice_tts，`src/voice` 也没有 voice_vad 源文件；`voice_channel.c` 本身是 PTT 状态机，没有 VAD。因而当前 include 和符号无法由该 package 提供。
- 选择必须明确：同步到确实提供该 API 的 ai_agent 版本；或在 VelaSight 内实现本地 VAD/语音起始检测。考虑 `vs_voice.c:9-29` 明确说明公共 ai_agent 不应被本项目修改，推荐产品内实现，而不是悄悄改公共 package。

2. `audio_capture_abort()` 同样不存在
- 调用位于 `vs_voice.c:1078`、`1100`，但当前 `packages/ai_agent/include/voice/audio_capture.h:25-43` 只声明 open/start/read/close，`src/voice/audio_capture.c:43-181` 也没有 abort 实现。
- 不可从 UI 线程直接 `audio_capture_close()`：worker 可能正阻塞在 read，close 又释放 handle，会产生 use-after-free。若不升级底层 API，可只设置锁保护的 stop/end flag，让 worker 在下一个音频 chunk 后退出（音频流正常时延迟很短）；若必须即时唤醒，就需正式增加并保证跨线程安全的底层 abort API，而不是保留一个不存在的调用。

3. history 调用已经过期
- `vs_voice.c:480` 仍调用旧式 `vs_history_read_full(record_key, raw, cap)`；当前声明是 `vs_history_read_full(kind, record_key, buf, len)` (`include/vs_history.h:107-109`、`vs_history.c:634-674`)。RECORD 路径必须传 `VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL`。这是独立于多轮功能的当前编译错误。

4. 为什么仍不应改回 voice_channel
- `packages/ai_agent/src/voice/voice_channel.c:604-744` 的 start 是 PTT；`746-848` 的普通 stop 完成 ASR 后把文字推入 message_bus；`850-931` 的 stop_with_text 才同步返回文本，且空 ASR 仍可返回 0；它没有 VAD/静音会话语义。
- TTS handle 是 `s_voice` 私有字段，虽 `voice_channel_start()` 会停止活动 TTS并等待关闭，但 VelaSight 无法直接取得它。当前直接驱动底层 primitives 的架构理由仍成立，只是必须先解决缺失的 VAD/abort 契约。

四、建议的目标状态机（一个 worker 管完整会话）

`IDLE → [PHOTO_CAPTURE once] → LISTEN_INITIAL → THINKING → COMMIT_TURN → SPEAKING → LISTEN_FOLLOWUP → THINKING ...`

终止边统一为：
`FOLLOWUP_SILENCE | USER_EXIT | MAX_TURNS | FATAL_ERROR | SHUTDOWN → PERSISTING → DONE`。

关键规则：
1. `vs_voice_start()` 只创建一次 worker；`busy=true` 和同一 request_id 保持到整段会话结束。不要每轮重建线程或 request_id。
2. RECORD source context 在 worker 开始时读取一次；PHOTO JPEG 抓取一次并保留到整个会话结束，每次视觉调用重传，最后统一 release。
3. 每轮模型 JSON 验证成功后，先把 `{question, answer}` 原子地追加到“持久化历史”，再发 `VOICE_REPLY`、再 TTS。这是历史 commit point。取消发生在 reply/TTS 之后也不会丢本轮。
4. TTS 完全关闭后，先检查 `end_requested`；仅在未结束时发“再次聆听”事件并打开下一轮 capture。单 worker 顺序执行可避免共享 codec 上 TTS close 与 capture open 的竞态。
5. follow-up 录音需要单独的“尚未检测到语音”计时：在 `CONFIG_VS_VOICE_SILENCE_TIMEOUT_MS` 内未出现 speech-start，abort ASR 流并正常结束/持久化；检测到语音后才切换到正常 utterance VAD 和 `RECORD_MAX_MS`。静音不是 `VOICE_FAILED/-ENODATA`。
6. worker 完成 JSON/索引持久化并 reset `g_conv` 后，先清 `busy/stage`，最后发送带原 request_id 的 `VOICE_CONVERSATION_DONE`。UI 收到它才清 active_request_id 并回历史页，避免下一次启动撞上尚未退出的 worker。

- `91-108`：解决不存在的 voice_vad/abort 依赖；若采用本地 VAD，改 include 与实现来源。

/****************************************************************************
 * app/velasight/vs_history.c
 *
 * SD-NAND backed history for two independent record kinds:
 *
 *   SOCIAL   completed social-assist sessions.  Fields mirror what the
 *            cloud/AI pipeline hands back when a session closes (see
 *            docs' "OpenVela比赛云端技术方案": emotionColor/emotionDetail/
 *            confidence per utterance and per snapshot, audioTimeline,
 *            emotionTimeline, ttsMinutes, txtMinutes).  This file adds the
 *            storage shape and, until a real producer exists, sample data
 *            so the on-device UI and the Web preview/download have
 *            something to show; it does not implement social-assist
 *            recognition itself.
 *
 *   CHAT     finished idle-assistant conversations (vs_voice.c).  A
 *            conversation is one or more question/answer turns run back to
 *            back without the user leaving the voice pages; it is written
 *            once, when the conversation ends.
 *
 * Both kinds share the same on-disk shape and the same in-memory
 * machinery, kept as two side-by-side tables (indexed by
 * enum vs_history_kind_e) rather than two copies of this file, so a
 * mistake in the write path gets fixed once for both instead of drifting.
 * Layout, two parallel directories:
 *
 *   /mnt/sdnand/ai_agent/history/social/INDEX.JSN   SOCIAL index (one array)
 *   /mnt/sdnand/ai_agent/history/social/R%08u.JSN    one SOCIAL session body
 *   /mnt/sdnand/ai_agent/history/chat/INDEX.JSN      CHAT index (one array)
 *   /mnt/sdnand/ai_agent/history/chat/R%08u.JSN      one CHAT conversation
 *
 * record_key sequence numbers are per-kind: SOCIAL's R00000000 and CHAT's
 * R00000000 are unrelated files in different directories.  Kind must
 * always travel with the key -- see vs_history.h's header comment.
 *
 * INDEX.JSN holds the full index rather than one line per record (contrast
 * app/conv/conv_store.c's pipe-delimited INDEX.TXT): the index here is
 * small (bounded record count, short fields) and callers want structured
 * fields including a leading record_key, so a single cJSON round trip on
 * open/append is simpler than a line-oriented format and does not need a
 * second parser.
 *
 * Write ordering mirrors app/provisioning_web/vp_store.c: temp file, fwrite,
 * fflush+fsync, close, rename over the destination, then fsync the
 * directory.  The record body is written and renamed into place *before*
 * the index is updated, so a crash between the two leaves an index that
 * does not yet mention the new record (invisible, harmless) rather than an
 * index entry whose record file does not exist (a read that fails).
 *
 * Capacity is a bounded ring, not a hard cap that starts refusing new
 * records: once a kind's in-memory index is full, vs_history_append()
 * evicts the oldest entry (index and on-disk body) before inserting the
 * new one.  A product meant to keep running for months cannot do

/****************************************************************************
 * app/velasight/vs_voice.c
 *
 * Idle voice assistant: one worker thread per round that turns a Power
 * short press into "listen, recognize, ask the model, speak the answer".
 *
 * Why this does not call voice_channel_start/stop/stop_with_text/speak
 * -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 * packages/ai_agent is a public repository this project must not modify
 * (see board/.../bk7258_agent_config.c's own comment on the same
 * constraint).  voice_channel.c's state machine has two properties that
 * conflict with this product and cannot be worked around from outside it:
 *
 *   1. When its VAD fires -- the normal, most common way a user finishes
 *      speaking -- the recording thread calls voice_channel_stop() (not
 *      stop_with_text()), which pushes the recognized text onto
 *      message_bus's inbound queue instead of returning it.  Nothing in
 *      this product runs agent_loop to drain that queue, so the most common
 *      path would silently lose every answer.
 *
 *   2. voice_channel_speak()'s playback handle (s_voice.tts_pb) is a file
 *      static with no accessor, so nothing outside voice_channel.c can stop
 *      a playback in progress.
 *
 * Both problems disappear by going one layer down.  voice_asr.h,
 * voice_tts.h, voice_vad.h, audio_capture.h and audio_playback.h are
 * self-contained, state-machine-free primitives that voice_channel.c itself
 * is built from; this file drives them directly, so every intermediate
 * result (recognized text, model answer, TTS chunk) stays in this file's
 * own hands, cancellable and un-routed through anything this product does
 * not run.  volc_asr_register()/volc_tts_register() -- the two calls
 * voice_channel_init() makes before anything else -- are called here for
 * the same reason: to activate the Volcengine backends without pulling in
 * the state machine wrapped around them.
 *
 * Why vs_voice_open() re-seeds the LLM credential on every boot
 * -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 * llm_chat()/llm_chat_vision_raw() read a static s_api_key in llm_proxy.c
 * that is only populated by llm_proxy_init() (from config_store's on-disk
 * JSON) or by a later llm_set_all()/llm_router_apply() call.  Nothing in
 * this product runs ai_agent's own agent_loop or NSH commands, so nothing
 * would ever call llm_router_apply() to move a router-slot credential into
 * llm_proxy's live state.  Rather than depend on that chain, this file
 * reads the credential Web provisioning already wrote
 * (velasight_provisioning_load(), the same record board's
 * bk7258_nand_seed_agent_config() mirrors into ai_agent's config file) and
 * calls llm_set_all() directly, once, at startup.  This also sidesteps
 * whether ai_agent's own config.json survived the SD-NAND's FAT
 * configuration: llm_set_all() updates live memory regardless of whether
 * its own file write succeeds.
 *
 * The Volcengine ASR/TTS credentials provisioning also collects (app_id and
 * token, see velasight_prov_credentials_s) take a different path on
 * purpose: volc_asr.c and volc_tts_ws.c re-read the config store on every
 * call (they have no cached, in-memory state to update the way llm_proxy.c
 * does), so vs_voice_seed_volc_credentials() writes config_store directly
 * with claw_config_set() instead of reaching for an llm_set_all()-style
 * shortcut that does not exist for them.  This does depend on
 * config_store's own file surviving the SD-NAND's FAT configuration --
 * unlike the LLM path, there is no fallback if it does not.
 *
 * Threading model
 * -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 * At most one round is ever in flight: vs_voice_start() takes a busy flag
 * and returns -EBUSY otherwise, so there is exactly one worker thread or
 * none.  A mutex-protected struct holds that worker's in-progress resource
 * handles (capture device, playback device) so vs_voice_cancel(),
 * vs_voice_stop_recording() and vs_voice_stop_speaking() -- all called from
 * the main UI thread -- can interrupt them from the outside using the
 * cross-thread-safe primitives those headers already document
 * (audio_capture_abort(), audio_playback_stop()).  ASR/LLM/TTS network
 * calls are synchronous with no such primitive; cancelling during one of
 * those steps only stops this file from acting on the result once the call
 * returns, exactly as documented for llm_chat_vision_raw() elsewhere in
 * this codebase's plan.

#include "voice/voice_vad.h"

#include <limits.h>

#define VAD_CALIBRATION_FRAMES 5
#define VAD_MIN_THRESHOLD       500u
#define VAD_SPEECH_THRESHOLD    2000u
#define VAD_THRESHOLD_MULTIPLIER 3u
#define VAD_TAIL_SILENCE_MS     800u
#define VAD_MAX_RECORDING_MS    30000u

static uint32_t voice_vad_level(const int16_t *samples, size_t count)
{
    uint64_t sum = 0;
    size_t i;

    for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
      {
        int32_t sample = samples[i];
        sum += (uint32_t)(sample < 0 ? -(int64_t)sample : sample);
      }

    return (uint32_t)(sum / count);
}

void voice_vad_init(voice_vad_t *vad, uint32_t sample_rate)
{
    if (vad == NULL)
      {
        return;
      }

    vad->sample_rate = sample_rate != 0 ? sample_rate : 16000;
    vad->elapsed_ms = 0;
    vad->silence_ms = 0;
    vad->noise_floor = 0;
    vad->calibration_frames = 0;
    vad->speech_started = false;
}

bool voice_vad_process(voice_vad_t *vad, const int16_t *samples,
                       size_t sample_count)
{
    uint32_t frame_ms;
    uint32_t level;
    uint32_t threshold;

    if (vad == NULL || samples == NULL || sample_count == 0 ||
        vad->sample_rate == 0)
      {
        return false;
      }

    frame_ms = (uint32_t)((sample_count * 1000u) / vad->sample_rate);
    if (frame_ms == 0)
      {
        frame_ms = 1;
      }

    vad->elapsed_ms += frame_ms;
    level = voice_vad_level(samples, sample_count);

    if (!vad->speech_started &&
        vad->calibration_frames < VAD_CALIBRATION_FRAMES)
      {
        if (vad->noise_floor == 0)
          {
            vad->noise_floor = level;
          }
        else
          {
            vad->noise_floor =
              (vad->noise_floor * 3u + level) / 4u;
          }

        vad->calibration_frames++;
        if (level >= VAD_SPEECH_THRESHOLD)
          {
            vad->speech_started = true;
          }
      }

    threshold = vad->noise_floor * VAD_THRESHOLD_MULTIPLIER;
    if (threshold < VAD_MIN_THRESHOLD)
      {
        threshold = VAD_MIN_THRESHOLD;
      }

    if (level >= threshold)
      {
        vad->speech_started = true;
        vad->silence_ms = 0;
      }
    else if (vad->speech_started)
      {
        vad->silence_ms += frame_ms;
      }

    return vad->elapsed_ms >= VAD_MAX_RECORDING_MS ||
           (vad->speech_started && vad->silence_ms >= VAD_TAIL_SILENCE_MS);
}

int audio_capture_abort(audio_capture_t* cap)
{
    if (!cap) {
        return -EINVAL;
    }

    switch (cap->backend) {
    case AUDIO_CAPTURE_BACKEND_ALSA:
#ifdef CONFIG_AI_AGENT_AUDIO_ALSA_DIRECT
        if (cap->handle.pcm && cap->started) {
            int ret = snd_vela_pcm_drop(cap->handle.pcm);
            cap->started = 0;
            return ret;
        }
        return 0;
#else
        return -ENOTSUP;
#endif

    case AUDIO_CAPTURE_BACKEND_MEDIA_RECORDER:
        if (cap->handle.recorder) {
#ifdef CONFIG_MEDIA_GRAPH
            media_recorder_close_socket(cap->handle.recorder);
#endif
            return media_recorder_stop(cap->handle.recorder);
        }
        return 0;

    default:
        return -EINVAL;
    }
}

void audio_capture_close(audio_capture_t* cap)
{
    if (!cap) {
        return;
    }

    switch (cap->backend) {
    case AUDIO_CAPTURE_BACKEND_ALSA:
#ifdef CONFIG_AI_AGENT_AUDIO_ALSA_DIRECT
        if (cap->handle.pcm) {
            if (cap->started) {
                snd_vela_pcm_drop(cap->handle.pcm);
            }
            snd_vela_pcm_close(cap->handle.pcm);
            cap->handle.pcm = NULL;
        }
        free(cap->scratch);
        cap->scratch = NULL;
        cap->scratch_size = 0;
#endif
        break;

    case AUDIO_CAPTURE_BACKEND_MEDIA_RECORDER:
        if (cap->handle.recorder) {
            media_recorder_stop(cap->handle.recorder);
            usleep(50 * 1000);
            media_recorder_close(cap->handle.recorder);
            cap->handle.recorder = NULL;
        }
        break;

    default:
        break;
    }

    if (s_active_capture == cap) {
        s_active_capture = NULL;
    }

    free(cap);
    syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] closed\n", TAG);
}

{
  struct vs_app_event_s event;

 * is deliberately independent of CONFIG_VS_VOICE_RESP_MAX_BYTES (the raw
 * model response buffer, which also carries JSON syntax and other fields):
 * sizing the spoken-answer copy off the raw buffer's own, much larger cap
 * would put a 32 KiB array on a worker thread stack for no benefit. */

#define VS_VOICE_ANSWER_MAX 4096

/* Volcengine credential path: this product has no provisioning entry for
 * it yet (only the MiMo key travels through Web provisioning), so a round
 * fails fast and visibly with -ENOKEY rather than silently hanging in a
 * recording state nothing will ever finish. */

enum vs_voice_stage_e
{
  VS_VOICE_STAGE_IDLE = 0,
  VS_VOICE_STAGE_PHOTO,
  VS_VOICE_STAGE_RECORDING,
  VS_VOICE_STAGE_THINKING,
  VS_VOICE_STAGE_SPEAKING
};

struct vs_voice_ctx_s
{
  char record_key[VS_HISTORY_KEY_MAX];
  char title[VS_VOICE_TITLE_MAX];
  char summary[VS_VOICE_SUMMARY_MAX];
  char date[VS_TEXT_SHORT];
  char body[VS_VOICE_BODY_MAX];

};

/* One question/answer turn kept verbatim in RAM while a conversation is in
 * flight.  Sized generously enough for a real spoken answer (the system
 * prompt already asks the model to keep "answer" under ~150 Chinese
 * characters) without wasting the many KiB VS_VOICE_ANSWER_MAX allows for
 * the raw per-call buffer -- turns[] lives for the whole conversation, that
 * buffer only for one call. */

#define VS_VOICE_TURN_Q_MAX VS_VOICE_QUESTION_MAX
#define VS_VOICE_TURN_A_MAX 768

{

static uint32_t vs_voice_now_ms(void)
{
  struct timespec ts;

  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
  return (uint32_t)(ts.tv_sec * 1000u + ts.tv_nsec / 1000000u);
}

static bool vs_voice_is_cancelled(void)
{
  bool cancelled;

  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_voice.lock);
  cancelled = g_voice.cancelled;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_voice.lock);
  return cancelled;
}

static void vs_voice_set_stage(enum vs_voice_stage_e stage)
{
  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_voice.lock);
  g_voice.stage = stage;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_voice.lock);
}

/* Post an event, retrying while the queue is full, but abandoning the
 * retry the moment the round is cancelled -- otherwise a cancelled worker
 * could sit spinning on a full queue instead of unwinding. */

static void vs_voice_post(enum vs_app_event_e type, uint32_t request_id,
                          int error, const char *text)
{
  struct vs_app_event_s event;

  memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
  event.type       = type;
  event.request_id = request_id;
  event.error      = error;
  if (text != NULL)
    {
      snprintf(event.text, sizeof(event.text), "%s", text);
    }

  while (vs_app_post_event(&event) == -EAGAIN)
    {
      if (vs_voice_is_cancelled())
        {
          return;
        }

      usleep(10000);
    }
}

/* Largest prefix of a NUL-terminated UTF-8 string that fits in max_bytes
 * (not counting the terminator) without splitting a multi-byte sequence.
 * Continuation bytes are 10xxxxxx; back up over them to find where the
 * current code point's lead byte starts. */

static void vs_voice_utf8_truncate(char *s, size_t max_bytes)
{
  size_t len = strlen(s);
  size_t cut;

  if (len <= max_bytes)
    {
      return;
    }

  cut = max_bytes;
  while (cut > 0 && ((unsigned char)s[cut] & 0xc0) == 0x80)
    {
      cut--;
    }

  s[cut] = '\0';
}

/* Builds the JSON messages array llm_chat() expects: one user message
 * whose content is the whitelisted record context followed by the
 * question.  Returns the number of bytes written, or a negative errno. */

static int vs_voice_build_record_messages(const struct vs_voice_ctx_s *ctx,
                                          const char *question,
                                          char *out, size_t out_cap)
{
  cJSON *array;
  cJSON *msg;
  char *content;
  char *text;
  int content_len;
  int ret = -ENOMEM;

  content = malloc(CONFIG_VS_VOICE_PROMPT_MAX_BYTES);
  if (content == NULL)
    {
      return -ENOMEM;
    }

  content_len = snprintf(content, CONFIG_VS_VOICE_PROMPT_MAX_BYTES,
                         "[CONTEXT]\n"
                         "record_id: %s\n"
                         "date: %s\n"
                         "title: %s\n"
                         "summary: %s\n"
                         "body: %s\n"
                         "content_truncated: %s\n"
                         "[USER QUESTION]\n%s",
                         ctx->record_key, ctx->date, ctx->title, ctx->summary,
                         ctx->body, ctx->content_truncated ? "true" : "false",
                         question);

  if (content_len < 0 ||
      content_len >= CONFIG_VS_VOICE_PROMPT_MAX_BYTES)
    {
      free(content);
      return -EMSGSIZE;
    }

  array = cJSON_CreateArray();
  msg   = cJSON_CreateObject();
  if (array == NULL || msg == NULL)
    {
      cJSON_Delete(array);
      cJSON_Delete(msg);
      free(content);
      return -ENOMEM;
    }

  cJSON_AddStringToObject(msg, "role", "user");
  cJSON_AddStringToObject(msg, "content", content);
  cJSON_AddItemToArray(array, msg);
  free(content);

  text = cJSON_PrintUnformatted(array);
  cJSON_Delete(array);
  if (text == NULL)
    {
      return -ENOMEM;
    }

  ret = snprintf(out, out_cap, "%s", text);
  free(text);

  if (ret < 0 || (size_t)ret >= out_cap)
    {
      return -EMSGSIZE;
    }

  return ret;
}

  item = cJSON_GetObjectItem(root, "display_text");
  display_src = (item != NULL && cJSON_IsString(item)) ?

      display_src == NULL || display_src[0] == '\0')

  snprintf(answer_out, answer_cap, "%s", answer_src);
  snprintf(display_text, display_cap, "%s", display_src);

  item = cJSON_GetObjectItem(root, "should_speak");

  if (!vs_voice_utf8_valid(answer_out) || !vs_voice_utf8_valid(display_text))

}

                                size_t answer_cap, bool *should_speak)
{
  cJSON *root;
  cJSON *item;
  const char *display_src;
  const char *answer_src;

  root = cJSON_Parse(raw);
  if (root == NULL || !cJSON_IsObject(root))
    {
      cJSON_Delete(root);
      return -EBADMSG;
    }

  item = cJSON_GetObjectItem(root, "answer");
  answer_src = (item != NULL && cJSON_IsString(item)) ?
               item->valuestring : NULL;

  item = cJSON_GetObjectItem(root, "display_text");
  display_src = (item != NULL && cJSON_IsString(item)) ?
                item->valuestring : answer_src;

  if (answer_src == NULL || answer_src[0] == '\0' ||
      display_src == NULL || display_src[0] == '\0')
    {
      cJSON_Delete(root);
      return -EBADMSG;
    }

  snprintf(answer_out, answer_cap, "%s", answer_src);
  snprintf(display_text, display_cap, "%s", display_src);

  item = cJSON_GetObjectItem(root, "should_speak");
  *should_speak = item == NULL || !cJSON_IsBool(item) || cJSON_IsTrue(item);

  cJSON_Delete(root);

  if (!vs_voice_utf8_valid(answer_out) || !vs_voice_utf8_valid(display_text))
    {
      return -EILSEQ;
    }

  return 0;
}

struct vs_voice_tts_ctx_s
{
  audio_playback_t *pb;
};

static void vs_voice_tts_chunk(const unsigned char *pcm_data, size_t pcm_len,
                               int is_last, void *user_data)
{
  struct vs_voice_tts_ctx_s *tts = user_data;

  (void)is_last;
  if (pcm_data != NULL && pcm_len > 0 && tts->pb != NULL)
    {
      /* A return of -ECANCELED here means vs_voice_stop_speaking() already
       * stopped this handle; nothing more to do with this or later chunks,
       * but the underlying stream call is left to finish or fail on its
       * own since it has no exposed abort. */

      (void)audio_playback_write(tts->pb, pcm_data, pcm_len);
    }
}

static void vs_voice_speak(const char *answer)
{
  struct vs_voice_tts_ctx_s tts;

  if (vs_voice_is_cancelled())
    {
      return;
    }

  tts.pb = audio_playback_open(AGENT_AUDIO_PLAYBACK_DEV,
                               AGENT_TTS_WS_SAMPLE_RATE, AGENT_VOICE_CHANNELS,
                               AGENT_VOICE_BITS);
  if (tts.pb == NULL)
    {
      printf("vs_voice: playback device unavailable\n");
      return;
    }

  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_voice.lock);
  g_voice.pb = tts.pb;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_voice.lock);

  vs_voice_set_stage(VS_VOICE_STAGE_SPEAKING);
  (void)volc_tts_ws_synthesize_stream(answer, vs_voice_tts_chunk, &tts);

  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_voice.lock);
  g_voice.pb = NULL;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_voice.lock);
  audio_playback_close(tts.pb);
