/****************************************************************************
 * app/provisioning_web/vp_http.h
 *
 * The smallest HTTP surface that can serve one form and accept one submit.
 * Everything it does not recognise is refused with a status rather than
 * tolerated: this listener sits on an open SoftAP, so "be liberal in what you
 * accept" buys nothing and costs attack surface.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 ****************************************************************************/

#ifndef __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_VP_HTTP_H
#define __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_VP_HTTP_H

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

/* Request headers and body caps.  A provisioning form needs a few hundred
 * bytes; anything larger is a mistake or a probe.
 */

#define VP_HTTP_MAX_HEADERS 2048
#define VP_HTTP_MAX_BODY    1024

/* Enough for the form page plus the largest status page. */

#define VP_HTTP_RESPONSE_MAX 4096

enum vp_http_action_e
{
  VP_HTTP_ACTION_PAGE = 0, /* GET / -- serve the form */
  VP_HTTP_ACTION_SAVE,     /* POST /save -- body is a form submit */
  VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT    /* answer with .status and close */
};

struct vp_http_request_s
{
  enum vp_http_action_e action;
  int                   status;         /* Only meaningful when REJECT */
  size_t                header_len;     /* Includes the blank line */
  size_t                content_length; /* 0 unless SAVE */
};

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: vp_http_parse
 *
 * Description:
 *   Parse whatever has arrived so far.  Returns -EAGAIN while the headers are
 *   incomplete and 0 once a decision has been made, with action saying what
 *   to do.  Rejections carry the status to answer with:
 *
 *     405  a method other than GET or POST
 *     404  an unknown path
 *     411  POST without Content-Length
 *     413  a body over VP_HTTP_MAX_BODY
 *     415  a submit that is not form-urlencoded
 *     431  headers over VP_HTTP_MAX_HEADERS
 *     400  anything malformed, including chunked bodies
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

int vp_http_parse(const char *buf, size_t len,
                  struct vp_http_request_s *req);

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: vp_html_escape
 *
 * Description:
 *   Escape &, <, >, " and ' for insertion into element text or an attribute.
 *   Returns the escaped length or -E2BIG.  The SSID comes from the network,
 *   so it is untrusted even though it is short.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

int vp_html_escape(const char *in, char *out, size_t outlen);

/* Response builders.  Each returns the number of bytes written, or 0 when the
 * buffer is too small.  No password is ever part of a response body, which
 * the host tests assert directly rather than trust.
 */

size_t vp_http_form_page(char *buf, size_t buflen, const char *notice);

size_t vp_http_form_page_with_ssid(char *buf, size_t buflen,
                                   const char *notice,
                                   const char *current_ssid);

size_t vp_http_saved_page(char *buf, size_t buflen, const char *ssid,
                          uint32_t generation, bool open_network);

size_t vp_http_status_page(char *buf, size_t buflen, int status,
                           const char *message);

#endif /* __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_VP_HTTP_H */

</content>
</file>

/****************************************************************************
 * app/provisioning_web/tests/test_vp_http.c
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 ****************************************************************************/

#include <errno.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "vp_http.h"

static int g_checks;
static int g_failures;

#define CHECK(cond, what)                                       \
  do                                                            \
    {                                                           \
      g_checks++;                                                \
      if (!(cond))                                              \
        {                                                       \
          g_failures++;                                         \
          printf("FAIL %s:%d %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, what);   \
        }                                                       \
    }                                                           \
  while (0)

static int parse(const char *request, struct vp_http_request_s *req)
{
  return vp_http_parse(request, strlen(request), req);
}

static void test_dispatch(void)
{
  struct vp_http_request_s req;

  CHECK(parse("GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_PAGE, "GET / serves the form");
  CHECK(parse("GET /index.html HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_PAGE, "GET /index.html serves the form");
  CHECK(parse("GET /?x=1 HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_PAGE, "a query string is ignored");

  CHECK(parse("GET /secret HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 404,
        "an unknown path is 404");
  CHECK(parse("GET /../etc/passwd HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 404,
        "there is no file mapping to traverse");

  CHECK(parse("DELETE / HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 405,
        "an unsupported method is 405");

  CHECK(parse("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
              "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
              "Content-Length: 27\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_SAVE && req.content_length == 27,
        "a well formed submit is accepted");

  CHECK(parse("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
              "content-type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8"
              "\r\nCONTENT-LENGTH: 5\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_SAVE && req.content_length == 5,
        "header names are case insensitive and parameters are allowed");

  CHECK(parse("POST /elsewhere HTTP/1.1\r\nContent-Length: 5\r\n\r\n", &req)
        == 0 && req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 404,
        "a POST to an unknown path is 404");
}

static void test_limits(void)
{
  struct vp_http_request_s req;
  char big[VP_HTTP_MAX_HEADERS + 256];
  size_t used;

  CHECK(parse("GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n", &req) == -EAGAIN,
        "incomplete headers ask for more");
  CHECK(parse("GE", &req) == -EAGAIN, "a partial request line asks for more");

  CHECK(parse("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
              "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n\r\n", &req)
        == 0 && req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 411,
        "a submit without Content-Length is 411");

  CHECK(parse("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
              "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
              "Content-Length: 99999\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 413,
        "an oversized body is 413");

  CHECK(parse("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
              "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
              "Content-Length: abc\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 400,
        "a non-numeric Content-Length is 400");

  CHECK(parse("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
              "Content-Type: text/plain\r\n"
              "Content-Length: 5\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 415,
        "a non-form content type is 415");

  CHECK(parse("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
              "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
              "Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 400,
        "a chunked body is refused, not half-read");

  CHECK(parse("GET\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 400,
        "a request line without a path is 400");

  used = (size_t)snprintf(big, sizeof(big), "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nX: ");
  memset(big + used, 'a', VP_HTTP_MAX_HEADERS + 32);
  big[used + VP_HTTP_MAX_HEADERS + 32] = '\0';
  CHECK(parse(big, &req) == 0 && req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT &&
        req.status == 431, "headers past the cap are 431, not buffered");
}

static void test_header_len(void)
{
  static const char request[] =
    "POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
    "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
    "Content-Length: 4\r\n\r\nssid";
  struct vp_http_request_s req;

  CHECK(vp_http_parse(request, sizeof(request) - 1, &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_SAVE &&
        req.header_len == sizeof(request) - 1 - 4,
        "header_len points at the first body byte");
}

static void test_escape(void)
{
  char out[64];

  CHECK(vp_html_escape("plain", out, sizeof(out)) == 5 &&
        strcmp(out, "plain") == 0, "plain text is unchanged");
  CHECK(vp_html_escape("<b>&\"'", out, sizeof(out)) > 0 &&
        strcmp(out, "<b>&"'") == 0,
        "every markup character is escaped");
  CHECK(vp_html_escape("<<<<<<<<<<", out, 16) == -E2BIG,
        "escaping refuses to overflow");
}

static void test_pages(void)
{
  char buf[VP_HTTP_RESPONSE_MAX];
  size_t len;

  len = vp_http_form_page(buf, sizeof(buf), NULL);
  CHECK(len > 0 && len < sizeof(buf), "the form page is generated");

  /* Adding the two Volcengine fields pushed the form past one IOB
   * (1514 bytes); vp_write_all() loops until every byte is sent, so a
   * response spanning two TCP segments is a minor efficiency cost on a
   * SoftAP link, not a correctness issue.  The bound here still exists so
   * a future addition that meaningfully bloats the page (a stray debug
   * dump, an accidentally duplicated block) gets caught instead of silently
   * growing forever. */

  CHECK(len < 2200, "the form response stays within a couple of IOBs");
  CHECK(strncmp(buf, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n", 17) == 0,
        "the form page carries a 200 status line");
  CHECK(strstr(buf, "Content-Length: ") != NULL,
        "the form page declares its length");
  CHECK(strstr(buf, "name=\"ssid\"") != NULL &&
        strstr(buf, "name=\"password\"") != NULL &&
        strstr(buf, "name=\"mimo_apikey\"") != NULL &&
        strstr(buf, "name=\"volc_appid\"") != NULL &&
        strstr(buf, "name=\"volc_token\"") != NULL,
        "the form has Wi-Fi, MiMo and Volcengine inputs");
  CHECK(strstr(buf, "action=\"/save\"") != NULL &&
        strstr(buf, "method=\"post\"") != NULL,
        "the form posts to /save");
  CHECK(strstr(buf, "type=\"password\"") != NULL,
        "the passphrase field is masked in the browser");

  len = vp_http_form_page(buf, sizeof(buf), "密码长度不合法");
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(buf, "密码长度不合法") != NULL,
        "a notice is rendered on the form page");

  len = vp_http_saved_page(buf, sizeof(buf), "AIPC", 3, false);
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(buf, "AIPC") != NULL &&
         strstr(buf, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK") != NULL,
        "the saved form shows the SSID");
  CHECK(strstr(buf, "class=\"ok\">已保存") != NULL,
        "the saved form shows a green success notice");
  CHECK(strstr(buf, "name=\"password\"") != NULL &&
        strstr(buf, "href=\"/\"") == NULL,
        "saving stays on the input form without a return link");
  CHECK(len < 2200, "the saved response stays within a couple of IOBs");

  len = vp_http_saved_page(buf, sizeof(buf), "<script>", 1, true);
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(buf, "<script>") == NULL &&
        strstr(buf, "<script>") != NULL,
        "an SSID cannot inject markup into the success page");

  len = vp_http_status_page(buf, sizeof(buf), 413, "too large");
  CHECK(len > 0 && strncmp(buf, "HTTP/1.1 413 ", 13) == 0,
        "a status page uses the requested status");
  CHECK(vp_http_status_page(buf, 8, 400, "bad") == 0,
        "a status page refuses a buffer it cannot fill");
}

static void test_password_never_echoed(void)
{
  static const char secret[] = "VelaSecret2026";
  char buf[VP_HTTP_RESPONSE_MAX];
  size_t len;

  /* The password only ever reaches the page builders as part of an SSID by
   * mistake, so the assertion is blunt on purpose: no builder output may
   * contain it.
   */

  len = vp_http_saved_page(buf, sizeof(buf), "AIPC", 1, false);
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(buf, secret) == NULL,
        "the success page contains no passphrase");

  len = vp_http_form_page(buf, sizeof(buf), NULL);
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(buf, secret) == NULL &&
        strstr(buf, "value=\"") == NULL,
        "the form page pre-fills nothing");

  len = vp_http_status_page(buf, sizeof(buf), 400, "invalid credentials");
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(buf, secret) == NULL,
        "an error page contains no passphrase");
}

int main(void)
{
  test_dispatch();
  test_limits();
  test_header_len();
  test_escape();
  test_pages();
  test_password_never_echoed();

  printf("%s: %d checks, %d failures\n",
         g_failures == 0 ? "PASS" : "FAIL", g_checks, g_failures);
  return g_failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * app/provisioning_web/tests/test_vp_server.c
 *
 * The listener over loopback.  This is the part that would otherwise only be
 * testable with a phone, a SoftAP switch and a re-flash, so it is worth the
 * sockets: the ordering guarantee (response first, callback second) and
 * one-shot mode are exactly the behaviours an application depends on.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 ****************************************************************************/

#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "velasight_provisioning.h"
#include "vp_store.h"

static int g_checks;
static int g_failures;

#define CHECK(cond, what)                                       \
  do                                                            \
    {                                                           \
      g_checks++;                                                \
      if (!(cond))                                              \
        {                                                       \
          g_failures++;                                         \
          printf("FAIL %s:%d %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, what);   \
        }                                                       \
    }                                                           \
  while (0)

static char g_dir[] = "/tmp/vp_server_testXXXXXX";
static char g_path[256];
static uint16_t g_port = 18080;

/* The callback records what it saw and, more importantly, whether the socket
 * had already been closed when it ran.
 */

static pthread_mutex_t g_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static int g_cb_calls;
static int g_cb_status;
static uint32_t g_cb_generation;

static void on_saved(int status, uint32_t generation, void *arg)
{
  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
  g_cb_calls++;
  g_cb_status = status;
  g_cb_generation = generation;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);

  if (arg != NULL)
    {
      *(bool *)arg = true;
    }
}

static int cb_calls(void)
{
  int calls;

  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
  calls = g_cb_calls;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
  return calls;
}

static void reset_callback(void)
{
  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
  g_cb_calls = 0;
  g_cb_status = -1;
  g_cb_generation = 0;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

/****************************************************************************
 * A blunt HTTP client: send a request, read until the peer closes.  The close
 * matters -- the service must not leave the connection open after answering,
 * because the application is about to take the network away.
 ****************************************************************************/

static int http_exchange(const char *request, char *reply, size_t replylen)
{
  struct sockaddr_in addr;
  struct timeval tv;
  size_t total = 0;
  int fd;

  fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
  if (fd < 0)
    {
      return -errno;
    }

  tv.tv_sec  = 5;
  tv.tv_usec = 0;
  setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
  setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));

  memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(addr));
  addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
  addr.sin_port   = htons(g_port);
  addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);

  if (connect(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(addr)) < 0)
    {
      int error = -errno;
      close(fd);
      return error;
    }

  if (write(fd, request, strlen(request)) < 0)
    {
      int error = -errno;
      close(fd);
      return error;
    }

  for (; ; )
    {
      ssize_t n = read(fd, reply + total, replylen - 1 - total);

      if (n < 0)
        {
          int error = -errno;
          close(fd);
          return error;
        }

      if (n == 0)
        {
          break;
        }

      total += (size_t)n;
      if (total >= replylen - 1)
        {
          break;
        }
    }

  close(fd);
  reply[total] = '\0';
  return (int)total;
}

static int start_on_free_port(const struct velasight_prov_config_s *base)
{
  struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg = *base;
  int attempt;
  int ret = -1;

  for (attempt = 0; attempt < 32; attempt++)
    {
      cfg.port = g_port;
      ret = velasight_provisioning_start(&cfg);
      if (ret == 0)
        {
          return 0;
        }

      g_port = (uint16_t)(g_port + 1);
    }

  return ret;
}

static void test_lifecycle(void)
{
  struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;

  memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
  cfg.store_path = g_path;
  cfg.on_saved   = on_saved;

  CHECK(!velasight_provisioning_is_running(),
        "nothing is running before start");
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_stop() == -EALREADY,
        "stopping an idle service reports -EALREADY");

  CHECK(start_on_free_port(&cfg) == 0, "the service starts");
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_is_running(), "the service reports running");
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_start(&cfg) == -EALREADY,
        "a second start is refused instead of leaking a listener");
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_stop() == 0, "the service stops");
  CHECK(!velasight_provisioning_is_running(), "the service is idle again");
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_stop() == -EALREADY,
        "a second stop reports -EALREADY");
}

static void test_stop_interrupts_client(void)
{
  struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
  struct sockaddr_in addr;
  struct timespec start;
  struct timespec end;
  long elapsed_ms;
  int fd;

  memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
  cfg.store_path = g_path;
  CHECK(start_on_free_port(&cfg) == 0,
        "the service starts for an interrupted client");

  fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
  CHECK(fd >= 0, "the stalled client socket opens");
  if (fd < 0)
    {
      (void)velasight_provisioning_stop();
      return;
    }

  memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(addr));
  addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
  addr.sin_port = htons(g_port);
  addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
  CHECK(connect(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(addr)) == 0,
        "the stalled client connects");
  CHECK(write(fd, "POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n", 21) == 21,
        "the stalled client sends an incomplete request");
  usleep(50000);

  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &start);
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_stop() == 0,
        "stop interrupts an active client");
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &end);
  elapsed_ms = (end.tv_sec - start.tv_sec) * 1000L +
               (end.tv_nsec - start.tv_nsec) / 1000000L;
  CHECK(elapsed_ms < 500,
        "stop does not wait for the client request timeout");
  close(fd);
}

static void test_connection_burst_and_stop(void)
{
  struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
  struct timespec start;
  struct timespec end;
  char reply[8192];
  long elapsed_ms;
  int request;

  memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
  cfg.store_path = g_path;
  CHECK(start_on_free_port(&cfg) == 0,
        "the service starts for a browser connection burst");

  for (request = 0; request < 24; request++)
    {
      int len = http_exchange(
          "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 192.168.10.1\r\n"
          "Connection: close\r\n\r\n", reply, sizeof(reply));

      CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK") != NULL,
            "every short browser connection receives the form");
    }

  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &start);
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_stop() == 0,
        "the service stops after the connection burst");
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &end);
  elapsed_ms = (end.tv_sec - start.tv_sec) * 1000L +
               (end.tv_nsec - start.tv_nsec) / 1000000L;
  CHECK(elapsed_ms < 500,
        "connection cleanup cannot hold the network switch worker");
}

static void test_get_and_save(void)
{
  struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
  struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
  volatile bool saw_callback = false;
  char reply[8192];

  memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));

  cfg.on_saved   = on_saved;
  cfg.cb_arg     = (void *)&saw_callback;

  reset_callback();
  CHECK(start_on_free_port(&cfg) == 0, "the service starts for a submit");

  len = http_exchange("GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 192.168.10.1\r\n"
                      "Connection: close\r\n\r\n", reply, sizeof(reply));
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK") != NULL &&
        strstr(reply, "name=\"ssid\"") != NULL,
        "GET / returns the form and the peer closes");
  CHECK(cb_calls() == 0, "serving the page does not fire the callback");

  len = http_exchange("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 192.168.10.1\r\n"
                      "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
                      "Content-Length: 30\r\n\r\n"
                      "ssid=AIPC&password=testpass123", reply, sizeof(reply));
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK") != NULL,
        "a valid submit is accepted");
  CHECK(strstr(reply, "AIPC") != NULL,

  CHECK(strstr(reply, "testpass123") == NULL,

static void test_repeated_password_save_cycles(void)
{
  struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
  struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
  char path[sizeof(g_path) + 16];
  char reply[8192];
  int cycle;

  snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s.cycles", g_path);
  unlink(path);
  memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
  cfg.store_path = path;
  cfg.on_saved = on_saved;

  for (cycle = 0; cycle < 4; cycle++)
    {
      int wait;
      int len;

      reset_callback();
      CHECK(start_on_free_port(&cfg) == 0,
            "the service restarts for a password save cycle");
      len = http_exchange(
          "POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
          "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
          "Content-Length: 35\r\n\r\n"
          "ssid=CycleNet&password=cyclepass123", reply, sizeof(reply));
      CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK") != NULL,
            "the password save cycle returns success");
      for (wait = 0; wait < 200 && cb_calls() == 0; wait++)
        {
          usleep(10000);
        }

      CHECK(cb_calls() == 1 && g_cb_status == 0,
            "the password save cycle reports persistence success");
      CHECK(velasight_provisioning_stop() == 0,
            "the service stops after a password save cycle");
    }

        strcmp(cred.ssid, "CycleNet") == 0 &&
        strcmp(cred.password, "cyclepass123") == 0 &&

        "repeated password saves retain the latest valid record");

}

static void test_rejections(void)
{
  struct velasight_prov_credentials_s before;
  struct velasight_prov_credentials_s after;
  struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
  char reply[8192];
  int len;

  memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
  cfg.store_path = g_path;
  cfg.on_saved   = on_saved;

  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_load_from(g_path, &before) == 0,
        "a stored record exists before the rejection tests");

  reset_callback();
  CHECK(start_on_free_port(&cfg) == 0, "the service starts for rejections");

  len = http_exchange("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
                      "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
                      "Content-Length: 22\r\n\r\n"
                      "ssid=AIPC&password=abc", reply, sizeof(reply));
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 400") != NULL,
        "a 3-byte passphrase is refused with 400");

  len = http_exchange("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
                      "Content-Type: text/plain\r\n"
                      "Content-Length: 4\r\n\r\nssid", reply, sizeof(reply));
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 415") != NULL,
        "a wrong content type is refused with 415");

  len = http_exchange("GET /nope HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n", reply, sizeof(reply));
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 404") != NULL,
        "an unknown path is refused with 404");

  len = http_exchange("PUT / HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n", reply, sizeof(reply));
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 405") != NULL,
        "an unsupported method is refused with 405");

  CHECK(cb_calls() == 0, "no rejection fires the saved callback");
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_load_from(g_path, &after) == 0 &&
        after.generation == before.generation &&
        strcmp(after.ssid, before.ssid) == 0,
        "a rejected submit leaves the stored record untouched");
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_is_running(),
        "rejections do not stop the service");
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_stop() == 0, "the service stops");
}

static void test_one_shot(void)
{
  struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
  char reply[8192];
  int len;

  memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
  cfg.store_path = g_path;
  cfg.on_saved   = on_saved;
  cfg.one_shot   = true;

  reset_callback();
  CHECK(start_on_free_port(&cfg) == 0, "the one-shot service starts");

  len = http_exchange("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
                      "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
                      "Content-Length: 32\r\n\r\n"
                      "ssid=OneShot&password=passphrase", reply,
                      sizeof(reply));
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK") != NULL,
        "the one-shot submit is accepted and answered");

  for (len = 0; len < 300 && velasight_provisioning_is_running(); len++)
    {
      usleep(10000);
    }

  CHECK(!velasight_provisioning_is_running(),
        "one-shot mode stops itself after a save");
  CHECK(cb_calls() == 1, "one-shot mode still notifies the application");
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_stop() == -EALREADY,
        "stopping an already finished one-shot service is not an error");
}

static void test_store_failure_is_reported(void)
{
  struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
  char reply[8192];
  int len;

  /* An unwritable store is what SD-NAND being unmounted looks like from here.
   * The submit must fail loudly rather than answer 200 and lose the input.
   */

  memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
  cfg.store_path = "/tmp/vp_no_such_dir/x/y/rec.bin";
  cfg.on_saved   = on_saved;

  reset_callback();
  CHECK(start_on_free_port(&cfg) == 0,
        "the service starts even with an unusable store");

  len = http_exchange("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
                      "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
                      "Content-Length: 31\r\n\r\n"
                      "ssid=AIPC&password=passphrase12", reply,
                      sizeof(reply));
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 500") != NULL,
        "a failed write answers 500");

  for (len = 0; len < 200 && cb_calls() == 0; len++)
    {
      usleep(10000);
    }

  CHECK(cb_calls() == 1 && g_cb_status < 0,
        "the application is told the save failed");
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_stop() == 0, "the service stops");
}

static void cleanup(void)
{
  char path[sizeof(g_path) + 8];

  snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s.tmp", g_path);
  unlink(path);
  unlink(g_path);
  rmdir(g_dir);
}

int main(void)
{
  int status;

  if (mkdtemp(g_dir) == NULL)
    {
      printf("FAIL cannot create a temporary directory\n");
      return 1;
    }

  snprintf(g_path, sizeof(g_path), "%s/wifi-provision.bin", g_dir);

  test_lifecycle();
  test_stop_interrupts_client();
  test_connection_burst_and_stop();
  test_get_and_save();
  test_repeated_password_save_cycles();
  test_rejections();
  test_one_shot();
  test_store_failure_is_reported();
  cleanup();

  status = g_failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
  printf("%s: %d checks, %d failures\n",
         status == 0 ? "PASS" : "FAIL", g_checks, g_failures);
  return status;
}

############################################################################
# app/provisioning_web/tests/Makefile
#
# The provisioning logic compiled for the host and run under the sanitizers.
# vp_form.c, vp_store.c and vp_http.c carry no NuttX includes precisely so
# this can happen: a rejected passphrase length or a corrupt record is a
# millisecond here, and a re-flash plus a phone plus a SoftAP switch there.
# vp_server.c only needs POSIX sockets, so even the accept loop, the callback
# ordering and one-shot mode are covered without hardware.
#
#   make          build and run everything
#   make form     URL decoding and credential validation
#   make store    the record format and the atomic replacement
#   make http     the request surface, escaping and the pages
#   make server   the listener over loopback, end to end
#   make clean
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
############################################################################

CC      ?= gcc
CFLAGS  += -std=c11 -O1 -g -I. -I.. -I../include

CFLAGS  += -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion
CFLAGS  += -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer

HDRS    := ../vp_form.h ../vp_store.h ../vp_http.h \

.PHONY: all run form store http server clean

all: run

test_vp_form: test_vp_form.c ../vp_form.c $(HDRS)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $@ test_vp_form.c ../vp_form.c $(LDFLAGS)

test_vp_store: test_vp_store.c ../vp_store.c ../vp_form.c $(HDRS)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $@ test_vp_store.c ../vp_store.c ../vp_form.c \
	      $(LDFLAGS)

test_vp_http: test_vp_http.c ../vp_http.c $(HDRS)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $@ test_vp_http.c ../vp_http.c $(LDFLAGS)

test_vp_server: test_vp_server.c ../vp_server.c ../vp_http.c ../vp_form.c \
	../vp_store.c $(HDRS)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $@ test_vp_server.c ../vp_server.c ../vp_http.c \
	      ../vp_form.c ../vp_store.c $(LDFLAGS)

form: test_vp_form

store: test_vp_store
	./test_vp_store

http: test_vp_http
	./test_vp_http

server: test_vp_server
	./test_vp_server

run: form store http server

clean:

int vs_network_request_mode(struct vs_network_s *network,
                            enum vs_net_mode_e mode)
{
  int ret;

  if (network == NULL)
    return -EINVAL;

  network->status.error = 0;
  network->status.error_reason[0] = '\0';
  network->status.state = VS_NET_SWITCHING;

  if (network->mode == VS_NET_AP && mode == VS_NET_STA)
    {
      ret = vs_network_stop_provisioning(network);
      if (ret < 0)
        {
          snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
                   sizeof(network->status.error_reason),
                   "AP provisioning stop (%d)", ret);
          network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
          network->status.error = ret;
          return ret;
        }

      /* stop() joins the listener, so no callback can race with this consume.
       * Apply a completed save even when manual exit won the UI race; discard
       * a failed save because the user explicitly chose to leave AP.
       */
      ret = vs_network_consume_saved(network, true);
      if (ret < 0 && ret != -ENOENT)
        {
          snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
                   sizeof(network->status.error_reason),
                   "保存WiFi配置 (%d)", ret);
          network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
          network->status.error = ret;
          return ret;
        }
    }

  ret = vs_network_stop_dhcp(network);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
               sizeof(network->status.error_reason), "DHCP停止 (%d)", ret);
      network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
      network->status.error = ret;
      return ret;
    }

  /* AP resources are gone before STA association begins.  If association or
   * DHCP then fails, the next network toggle must be able to enter AP again.
   */
  if (mode == VS_NET_STA)
    {
      network->mode = VS_NET_STA;
      network->status.mode = VS_NET_STA;
    }

  ret = mode == VS_NET_AP ? vs_network_apply_ap(network) :
                             vs_network_apply_sta(network);
    if (ret < 0)
      {
        if (network->status.error_reason[0] == '\0')
          snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
                   sizeof(network->status.error_reason),
                   "网络切换 (%d)", ret);
        network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
      network->status.error = ret;
    }

  return ret;
}

int vs_network_process_events(struct vs_network_s *network)
{
  bool ap_client_event;
  bool sta_connected;
  bool sta_ipv4_ready;
  bool wifi_event;
  uint8_t ap_client_count;
  bool changed = false;
  int disconnect_reason;
  int ret;

  if (network == NULL)
    return 0;

  pthread_mutex_lock(&network->event_lock);
  wifi_event = network->wifi_event;
  sta_connected = network->sta_connected;
  sta_ipv4_ready = network->sta_ipv4_ready;
  disconnect_reason = network->sta_disconnect_reason;
  network->wifi_event = false;
  ap_client_event = network->ap_client_event;
  ap_client_count = network->ap_client_count;
  network->ap_client_event = false;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&network->event_lock);

  if (network->mode == VS_NET_STA && wifi_event)
    {
      if (sta_connected)
        {
          network->status.state = sta_ipv4_ready ? VS_NET_STA_READY :
                                                   VS_NET_DOWN;
          network->status.wifi_issue = sta_ipv4_ready ?
                                       VS_WIFI_ISSUE_NONE :
                                       VS_WIFI_ISSUE_DISCONNECTED;
          if (sta_ipv4_ready)
            {
              network->status.error = 0;
              network->status.error_reason[0] = '\0';
            }
          changed = true;
        }
      else
        {
          network->status.state = VS_NET_DOWN;
          network->status.wifi_issue =
              disconnect_reason == (int)BK7258_WIFI_REASON_NO_AP_FOUND ?
              VS_WIFI_ISSUE_SSID_NOT_FOUND :
              disconnect_reason == (int)BK7258_WIFI_REASON_WRONG_PASSWORD ?
              VS_WIFI_ISSUE_PASSWORD : VS_WIFI_ISSUE_DISCONNECTED;
          changed = true;
        }
    }

  if (network->mode == VS_NET_AP && ap_client_event)
    {
      network->status.ap_client_count = ap_client_count;
      changed = true;
    }

  ret = vs_network_consume_saved(network, false);
  if (ret == -ENOENT)
    return changed ? 1 : 0;

  if (ret < 0)
    {
      network->status.error = ret;
      network->status.state = VS_NET_AP_READY;
      return ret;
    }

  /* Keep AP and the provisioning listener alive after a save.  The saved STA
   * credentials are applied only when the user explicitly exits AP mode. */
  return 1;
}

int vs_network_get_status(struct vs_network_s *network,
                          struct vs_net_status_s *status)
{
  if (network == NULL || status == NULL)
    return -EINVAL;

  *status = network->status;
  return 0;
}

void vs_network_close(struct vs_network_s *network)
{
  if (network == NULL)
    return;

  bk7258_wifi_unregister_event_callback(vs_network_wifi_event, network);

                        struct vs_ui_snapshot_s *snapshot)

  snapshot->progress = runtime->progress;

  snapshot->response_key = runtime->response_key;

                         runtime->network.state == VS_NET_AP_READY;
  snapshot->battery_present = false;
  /* UI snapshots are a latency-sensitive hot path.  Never read SD-NAND here;
   * persistent state must be loaded by startup or background event handling. */
  snapshot->api_ready = runtime->api_ready;
  snprintf(snapshot->error_reason, sizeof(snapshot->error_reason), "%s",
           runtime->error_reason);
  snapshot->emotion_color = runtime->emotion_color != 0 ?
                            runtime->emotion_color :
                            runtime->emotion == VS_EMOTION_TENSE ? 0xe85d5d :
                            runtime->emotion == VS_EMOTION_CONFUSED ? 0xe3ad4b :
                            runtime->emotion == VS_EMOTION_HAPPY ? 0x48c78e :
                            0xe8eef2;

  switch (runtime->page)
    {
      case VS_PAGE_PREPARING:
        snprintf(snapshot->content_title, sizeof(snapshot->content_title),
                 "正在准备");

        snprintf(snapshot->status_meta, sizeof(snapshot->status_meta), "请稍等");
        snapshot->progress_kind = VS_PROGRESS_WAIT;
        break;

      case VS_PAGE_HISTORY:
        snprintf(snapshot->content_title, sizeof(snapshot->content_title),
                 "%s", have_current ? current.title : "");
        snprintf(snapshot->content_body, sizeof(snapshot->content_body),
                 "%s", have_current ? current.summary : "");
        snprintf(snapshot->content_meta, sizeof(snapshot->content_meta),
                 "%s", have_current ? current.date : "");
        snprintf(snapshot->status_title, sizeof(snapshot->status_title), "历史");
        snprintf(snapshot->status_value, sizeof(snapshot->status_value),
                 "%02u/%02u", runtime->index + 1,
                 vs_history_count(VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL));
        snprintf(snapshot->status_meta, sizeof(snapshot->status_meta), "已保存");
        vs_key_set(snapshot, VS_KEY_CONFIRM, "询问");
        vs_key_set(snapshot, VS_KEY_BACK, "上一条");
        vs_key_set(snapshot, VS_KEY_NEXT, "下一条");
        break;

      case VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK:
        snprintf(snapshot->content_title, sizeof(snapshot->content_title),
                 "拍照提问");
        snprintf(snapshot->content_body, sizeof(snapshot->content_body),
                 "拍一张照片\n然后直接问我");
        snapshot->content_meta[0] = '\0';
        snprintf(snapshot->status_title, sizeof(snapshot->status_title), "AI");
        snprintf(snapshot->status_value, sizeof(snapshot->status_value),
                 "照片问答");
        snprintf(snapshot->status_meta, sizeof(snapshot->status_meta), "准备好");
        vs_key_set(snapshot, VS_KEY_CONFIRM, "拍照提问");
        vs_key_set(snapshot, VS_KEY_BACK, "上一条");
        vs_key_set(snapshot, VS_KEY_NEXT, "下一条");

  static const char alphabet[] =

  const size_t alphabet_len = sizeof(alphabet) - 1;
  uint8_t byte;
  size_t index = 0;
  int fd;
  ssize_t n;

  if (password == NULL || size < 9)
    return -EINVAL;

  fd = open("/dev/urandom", O_RDONLY);
  if (fd < 0)
    return -errno;

  while (index < 8)
    {
      n = read(fd, &byte, sizeof(byte));
      if (n != (ssize_t)sizeof(byte))
        {
          int ret = n < 0 ? -errno : -EIO;
          close(fd);
          return ret;
        }

      /* Reject the incomplete final bucket to avoid modulo bias. */
      if (byte >= (uint8_t)(256u - (256u % alphabet_len)))
        continue;

      password[index++] = alphabet[byte % alphabet_len];
    }

  password[8] = '\0';
  close(fd);

/* "Really up" is IFF_RUNNING plus an address that is not NuttX's default
 * static 10.0.0.2 -- see docs/WiFi使用说明.md.  Neither ping (this network
 * blocks ICMP) nor the agent's own "Network connected: yes" (true even with
 * the interface down) can be used for this.
 */

static void wt_wifi_state(struct wt_sb_s *sb)
{
  struct in_addr addr;
  struct in_addr mask;
  struct in_addr gw;
  char essid[36];
  uint8_t flags = 0;
  bool running;

  memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(addr));
  memset(&mask, 0, sizeof(mask));
  memset(&gw, 0, sizeof(gw));
  essid[0] = '\0';

  netlib_getifstatus(WT_IFNAME, &flags);
  netlib_get_ipv4addr(WT_IFNAME, &addr);
  netlib_get_ipv4netmask(WT_IFNAME, &mask);
  netlib_get_dripv4addr(WT_IFNAME, &gw);
  netlib_getessid(WT_IFNAME, essid, sizeof(essid));

  running = (flags & IFF_RUNNING) != 0 &&
            addr.s_addr != htonl(0x0a000002);

  wt_sb_addf(sb, "{\"running\":%s,\"flags\":%u,\"ssid\":\"",
             running ? "true" : "false", (unsigned int)flags);
  wt_sb_addesc(sb, essid);
  wt_sb_addf(sb, "\",\"ip\":\"%s\"", inet_ntoa(addr));
  wt_sb_addf(sb, ",\"netmask\":\"%s\"", inet_ntoa(mask));
  wt_sb_addf(sb, ",\"gw\":\"%s\"}", inet_ntoa(gw));
}

static char *wt_cmd_wifi_status(void)
{
  struct wt_sb_s sb;

  if (!wt_sb_init(&sb, 256))
    {
      return NULL;
    }

  wt_sb_addstr(&sb, "{\"ok\":true,\"data\":");
  wt_wifi_state(&sb);
  wt_sb_addstr(&sb, "}");

<file name="build_and_flash.sh" language="plaintext" >
<content>
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)
CONTEST_ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd -P)
SDK_ROOT="$CONTEST_ROOT/bk_avdk_smp"
OPENVELA_ROOT="$CONTEST_ROOT/contest"
AP_CONFIG="vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/ai_agent"
AP_OUT="$OPENVELA_ROOT/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_ai_agent"
PACKAGE="$SDK_ROOT/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin"
AP_BIN="$AP_OUT/nuttx.bin"
AP_INPUT="$SDK_ROOT/build/openvela-ap.bin"
AP_PACKED="$SDK_ROOT/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin"
LOG_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/runtime"

PORT=${VELASIGHT_PORT:-/dev/ttyUSB0}
PORT_NUM=${VELASIGHT_PORT_NUM:-}
FLASH_BAUD=${VELASIGHT_FLASH_BAUD:-1500000}
CONSOLE_BAUD=${VELASIGHT_CONSOLE_BAUD:-115200}
BOOT_LOG_SECONDS=${VELASIGHT_BOOT_LOG_SECONDS:-25}
DO_FLASH=0

die()
{
  printf 'error: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

usage()
{
  printf '%s\n' \
    'usage: build_and_flash.sh [--flash] [-p port] [-n loader-port]' \
    '       [--boot-log-seconds seconds]' \
    'Builds ai_agent, regenerates the 4148K-aligned AP layout, packages all-app.bin,' \
    'and optionally flashes it with the shell-based autoflash workflow.'
}

while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --flash) DO_FLASH=1 ;;
    -p) shift; PORT=$1 ;;
    -n) shift; PORT_NUM=$1 ;;
    --boot-log-seconds) shift; BOOT_LOG_SECONDS=$1 ;;
    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) die "unknown argument: $1" ;;
  esac
  shift
done

command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 'podman is required'
command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 'sha256sum is required'
command -v cmp >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 'cmp is required'

cd "$OPENVELA_ROOT"
./build.sh "$AP_CONFIG" --cmake distclean
./build.sh "$AP_CONFIG" --cmake -j8

test -s "$AP_BIN" || die "missing AP binary: $AP_BIN"
grep -q '^CONFIG_LV_TXT_ENC_UTF8=y$' "$AP_OUT/.config" || die 'UTF-8 is disabled'
grep -q '^# CONFIG_LV_FONT_FMT_TXT_LARGE is not set$' "$AP_OUT/.config" || die 'large LVGL font format wastes flash'
grep -q '^CONFIG_VS_SHORT_PRESS_MAX_MS=500$' "$AP_OUT/.config" || die 'short-press limit is not 500 ms'
for app in KVDB_TOOL AGENT_CAMERA AUDIO_TEST CONV CAMERA_PREVIEW CTRLC_TEST \
           HELLO_SCREEN PERIPH_SELFTEST SOCIAL_CUE SDNAND_INIT WEB_TOOL; do
  grep -q "^CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_264_${app}=y$" \
    "$AP_OUT/.config" || die "restored app is not enabled: $app"
done
grep -q 'velasight_font_16_ui' "$AP_OUT/System.map" || die 'UI font is not linked'
grep -q '^ \* Bpp: 1$' "$SCRIPT_DIR/app/velasight/velasight_font_16_ui.c" || die 'UI font is not 1bpp'
grep -q -- '--no-prefilter' "$SCRIPT_DIR/app/velasight/velasight_font_16_ui.c" || die 'UI font is not the pixel-font build'
grep -q 'voice_vad_process' "$AP_OUT/System.map" || die 'VAD is not linked'
grep -q 'vs_voice_start' "$AP_OUT/System.map" || die 'idle voice assistant worker is not linked'
grep -q 'llm_chat_vision_raw' "$AP_OUT/System.map" || die 'vision model call is not linked'
if grep -qw 'velaclaw_ask' "$AP_OUT/System.map"; then
  die 'velaclaw_ask is linked (decision was to bypass it, see vs_voice.c)'
fi

AP_SIZE=$(stat -c%s -- "$AP_BIN")
AP_LIMIT=$((3904 * 1024))
[ "$AP_SIZE" -le "$AP_LIMIT" ] || die "AP binary exceeds MPU flash region: $AP_SIZE > $AP_LIMIT"

mkdir -p "$(dirname -- "$AP_INPUT")"
cp -- "$AP_BIN" "$AP_INPUT"

cd "$SDK_ROOT"
make -C projects/app_ab clean
podman run --rm --userns=keep-id \
  -v "$SDK_ROOT:/armino" \
  -w /armino \
  localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
  make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
  SDK_DIR=/armino \
  EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin

PARTITIONS="$SDK_ROOT/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/partitions.txt"
test -s "$PACKAGE" || die 'all-app.bin is missing'
test -s "$AP_PACKED" || die 'packed AP input is missing'
grep -q 'primary_ap_app.*4148K' "$PARTITIONS" || die 'AP partition is not 4148K'
cmp -s "$AP_BIN" "$AP_INPUT" || die 'external AP copy differs'
cmp -s "$AP_BIN" "$AP_PACKED" || die 'packed AP input differs'

IMAGE_SIZE=$(stat -c%s -- "$PACKAGE")
IMAGE_SHA=$(sha256sum -- "$PACKAGE" | cut -d' ' -f1)

if [ "$DO_FLASH" -eq 1 ]; then
  cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"
  FLASH_ARGS=(-b "$FLASH_BAUD" -B "$CONSOLE_BAUD" -p "$PORT")
  if [ -n "$PORT_NUM" ]; then
    FLASH_ARGS+=(-n "$PORT_NUM")
  fi
  AUTOFLASH_EXPECTED_SIZE="$IMAGE_SIZE" \
    ./autoflash.sh "${FLASH_ARGS[@]}"

  mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
  BOOT_LOG="$LOG_DIR/velasight-final-boot-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).log"
  stty -F "$PORT" "$CONSOLE_BAUD" cs8 -cstopb -parenb raw -echo -crtscts
  timeout --foreground "$BOOT_LOG_SECONDS" tee "$BOOT_LOG" < "$PORT" >/dev/null &
  CAPTURE_PID=$!
  sleep 0.5
  printf '\035' > "$PORT"
  sleep 0.05
  printf '.' > "$PORT"
  sleep 0.05
  printf '\r\n' > "$PORT"
  sleep 0.05
  printf 'reboot\r\n' > "$PORT"
  wait "$CAPTURE_PID" || true
  printf 'boot log: %s\n' "$BOOT_LOG"
  tr '\r' '\n' < "$BOOT_LOG" | tee "${BOOT_LOG%.log}.normalized.log"
fi

</content>
</file>

# SOCIAL/CHAT 双表、多轮语音与 AP/STA Web 历史

本次变更把历史持久化拆成独立的 SOCIAL/CHAT 索引与正文文件，为闲时语音加入连续多轮、后续 8 秒静音终止、语义压缩及 CHAT 落盘，并把同一配网/历史 HTTP 服务扩展到 STA。正常路径下，历史正文先提交、索引再原子替换、淘汰最后发生；Web 也只把 SOCIAL provider 接入，HTML 元数据转义、严格 key、JSON `nosniff` 和基于稳定 fd 的精确 `Content-Length` 处理是合理的。阻断点主要是新 STA 信任边界、保存后 live provider 不刷新，以及所谓“完整 turns”仍会被静默截断；升级迁移和几个并发/容量边界也需补齐。

Watch for: **confirmed** — STA 上任何可达客户端都能读取 SOCIAL 并改写 Wi-Fi/API 凭据；**confirmed** — 网页保存后 UI 可显示 API 就绪，但运行中的 MiMo/语音 provider 仍持有旧配置；**confirmed** — 合法但超过 767 字节的模型回答不会完整进入 CHAT；**confirmed** — 旧单目录历史升级后不会被新双表加载。

**Verdict**: NEEDS_CHANGES

## High-level view

历史层已经形成 SOCIAL/CHAT 独立目录、独立 key 空间和每类独立容量。打开正文时在锁内完成成员校验和 `open`，之后下载持有自己的 fd；append 的正文→索引→内存→淘汰顺序避免索引指向已删除正文，但新布局没有接管 `HEAD` 中的旧单目录数据。

语音 worker 在 TTS 后确实再次录音，后续未起声满 8 秒或手动结束都会保存已完成轮次，并在关闭时等待 detached worker 到达终态。压缩通过 `context_start` 只影响后续 prompt，持久化仍遍历 turns 数组；但数组里的 answer 在进入数组前已被裁成 767 字节，且压缩阈值没有按实际 JSON 序列化大小计算。

HTTP listener 在 AP 和 STA 都绑定 `INADDR_ANY`，SOCIAL 列表、预览和下载均走 provider，CHAT 没有路由。新增 STA 可达性也把无认证凭据写入和历史读取带到了常规 LAN；保存通知仍是单个 bool/status 槽，且消费成功后只重写磁盘配置，不更新已初始化 provider。

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

## STA 上的配网与历史共享同一个无认证信任边界（confirmed，高）

`vs_network_apply_sta()` 在取得地址后直接启动 provisioning（`app/velasight/vs_network.c:511`），server 绑定 `INADDR_ANY`（`app/provisioning_web/vp_server.c:972`）。公开头文件也明确承认该服务是 unauthenticated HTTP（`app/provisioning_web/include/velasight_provisioning.h:9-13`）。因此从同一 LAN 的另一台机器直接 `GET /history`、`GET /history/Rxxxxxxx` 或 `POST /save` 都不需要证明设备所有权；后者是标准 `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`，恶意网页可发起跨站简单请求并改写配置，即使浏览器因同源策略读不到响应。

这不是 HTML/JSON 转义问题：列表字段已转义，record key 也限制为 `R` 加七位数字，预览以 `application/json` 和 `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` 返回。风险来自新增网络边界本身。源码注释把可信 LAN 当作可选策略；在当前目标没有明确接受该策略时，应视为发布阻断。

## 保存成功与 provider 生效状态脱节（confirmed，高）

voice provider 只在 `vs_voice_open()` 中加载一次 provision record 并调用两组 seed 函数（`app/velasight/vs_voice.c:274-365`）。新 STA 页面保存后，`vs_network_consume_saved()` 仅更新 Wi-Fi 结构并调用 `bk7258_nand_seed_agent_config()`（`app/velasight/vs_network.c:375-402`）；该函数重写 ai_agent 配置文件，却不会更新 MiMo 的进程内 `s_api_key`，也没有走启动时的 Volcengine `claw_config_set()` 路径。

可复现路径是无凭据启动，连上 STA 后在网页填入 MiMo/Volcengine 凭据，再立即发起语音。持久文件和 `runtime.api_ready` 已显示新状态，但当前 provider 仍是启动时的空状态，直到重启才可能生效；轮换 key 时则继续使用旧 key。reload 必须与正在运行的 worker 协调，避免在一次 LLM/ASR/TTS 调用中途改写共享 provider 配置。

## turns 数组并不保存完整模型回答（confirmed，高）

模型 JSON 的 answer 先进入 4096 字节缓冲区，随后在 `app/velasight/vs_voice.c:1704` 被裁到 767 字节，才传给 `vs_voice_conv_append_turn()`；持久化虽然遍历所有 turn，但遍历的是已经裁剪的副本。让 mock provider 返回一个合法、UTF-8 正确且大于 767 字节的 answer 即可看到 CHAT JSON 缺少尾部。系统提示中的“尽量不超过 150 个汉字”不是协议级上限，不能支撑“完整 turns 保留”的保证。

## 双表格式会把旧 SOCIAL 历史留在旧目录（confirmed，高，升级场景）

`HEAD` 的索引和正文位于 `/mnt/sdnand/ai_agent/history/INDEX.JSN` 与 `R%08u.JSN`；新代码定义 `/history/social`、`/history/chat` 和 `R%07u`（`app/velasight/vs_history.c:52-73`）。启动只查新索引，`-ENOENT` 时 SOCIAL 直接走 seed、CHAT 建空表（`app/velasight/vs_history.c:873-878`）。旧文件不会被删除，但 UI 和 Web 都再也看不到它们，且展示的是示例记录，容易被误认为真实数据仍在。

## 压缩阈值与固定 prompt 缓冲区使用不同计量单位（confirmed，中）

`g_conv.context_bytes` 只累计原始字符串长度，`vs_voice_conv_needs_compact()` 也据此判断（`app/velasight/vs_voice.c:621,1246-1258`）。record 消息和 compact 消息随后由 cJSON 序列化（`:859-869`, `:1321`），引号、反斜杠和控制字符会扩张。默认 16 KiB prompt/约 9.8 KiB 阈值下，构造接近阈值且需要大量转义的 turns，可以让生成后的消息先超过 16 KiB，最终以 `-EMSGSIZE` 结束并持久化为 error，而不是先做语义压缩。

## 保存通知无法表示多个尚未消费的结果（confirmed，中）

listener 回调只写 `provision_status` 并置一个 bool（`app/velasight/vs_network.c:270-282`）；主循环消费时先清 bool，再读磁盘（`:375-402`）。这在原 AP 流程里已是脆弱机制，而新增持续可用的 STA 页面让多个保存可在主 UI 一次轮询前完成。用暂停主循环/慢 LCD 的测试桩，先完成一次成功保存，再让下一次存储失败，最终只会处理失败状态；第一次已经落盘的配置不会进入 `network->config`，之后切网仍可能使用旧值。

## fragment 级超时允许慢客户端长期独占 listener（likely，中）

每次 `vp_write_all()` 都创建局部 `waited = 0`（`app/provisioning_web/vp_server.c:110-160`）。历史列表会为 head、每个 entry 和 tail 分别调用它（`:438-456`），正文下载则每读取一个 response buffer 调一次（`:509-530`）。由于服务一次只处理一个连接，限速客户端只要间歇读取让每个 fragment 在自己的预算内完成，就能把后续配网页面和保存请求长时间挡在 accept 队列外。`Content-Length` 本身按冻结快照/`fstat` 大小计算正确，问题是发送期限没有覆盖完整响应。

`test_vp_http.c` 和 `test_vp_server.c` 验证了路由、XSS 转义、严格 key、附件头以及超过 4 KiB 的完整流式正文。当前 diff 没有为 `vs_history.c`、`vs_voice.c` 或 `vs_network.c` 增加对应测试，因此正文/索引故障注入、旧格式升级、worker close/终态、压缩后完整 turns 和保存 generation 竞争都没有自动回归保护。

static bool vs_voice_copy_utf8(char *out, size_t out_len, const char *in)
{
  size_t source_len;
  size_t copy_len;

  if (out == NULL || out_len == 0 || in == NULL)
    {
      return false;
    }

  source_len = strlen(in);
  copy_len = source_len < out_len - 1u ? source_len : out_len - 1u;
  if (copy_len < source_len)
    {
      while (copy_len > 0 &&
             ((unsigned char)in[copy_len] & 0xc0) == 0x80)
        {
          copy_len--;
        }
    }

  memcpy(out, in, copy_len);
  out[copy_len] = '\0';
  return copy_len == source_len;
}

static enum vs_wifi_issue_e vs_network_sta_issue(
    struct vs_network_s *network, enum vs_wifi_issue_e fallback)
{
  int reason;

  pthread_mutex_lock(&network->event_lock);
  reason = network->sta_disconnect_reason;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&network->event_lock);
  if (reason == (int)BK7258_WIFI_REASON_NO_AP_FOUND)
    {
      return VS_WIFI_ISSUE_SSID_NOT_FOUND;
    }
  if (reason == (int)BK7258_WIFI_REASON_WRONG_PASSWORD)
    {
      return VS_WIFI_ISSUE_PASSWORD;
    }

  return fallback;
}

static int vs_network_wait_sta_association(struct vs_network_s *network)
{
  struct timespec deadline;
  bool connected;
  int reason;
  int ret;

  clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &deadline);
  deadline.tv_sec += VS_STA_ASSOC_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000;
  deadline.tv_nsec += (VS_STA_ASSOC_TIMEOUT_MS % 1000) * 1000000L;
  if (deadline.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L)
    {
      deadline.tv_sec++;
      deadline.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L;
    }

  pthread_mutex_lock(&network->event_lock);
  while (!network->wifi_event)
    {
      ret = pthread_cond_timedwait(&network->wifi_cond,
                                   &network->event_lock, &deadline);
      if (ret != 0)
        {
          pthread_mutex_unlock(&network->event_lock);
          return ret == ETIMEDOUT ? -ETIMEDOUT : -ret;
        }
    }

  connected = network->sta_connected;
  reason = network->sta_disconnect_reason;
  network->wifi_event = false;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&network->event_lock);

  if (connected)
    {
      return 0;
    }

  if (reason == (int)BK7258_WIFI_REASON_NO_AP_FOUND)
    {
      network->status.wifi_issue = VS_WIFI_ISSUE_SSID_NOT_FOUND;
      return -ENETUNREACH;
    }

  if (reason == (int)BK7258_WIFI_REASON_WRONG_PASSWORD)
    {
      network->status.wifi_issue = VS_WIFI_ISSUE_PASSWORD;
      return -EACCES;
    }

  network->status.wifi_issue = VS_WIFI_ISSUE_DISCONNECTED;
  return -ENOTCONN;
}

   - **旧根目录始终只读，成功后也暂不删除或改名。**它是回滚副本。
   - 按新 key 将每个 body 写到 `social/Rxxxxxxx.TMP`，`fsync`、关闭、rename 为 `.JSN`，并同步 `social` 目录。
   - 所有 body 都就绪后，一次性调用当前索引写入路径生成完整候选 `social/INDEX.TMP`，原子 rename 为 `social/INDEX.JSN`。这个索引 rename 是唯一提交点；此前出现的新 body都只是不可见孤儿。
   - 索引提交成功后再调用 `vs_history_load_index_locked(SOCIAL)`重新验证并装入 RAM，不要提前修改 `g_index/g_count/g_next_seq`。
   - 任一步失败都返回错误、不得继续调用 `vs_history_seed_social_locked()`；只可尽力清理由本次创建的新目录 body，根旧索引/body绝不删除。断电遗留的新 body可在下次用同一确定性映射重写；由于没有新索引，它们不是已提交数据。
   - 成功后仍保留旧根文件。新索引优先使迁移不会重复；清理旧副本应是以后单独、可确认的维护动作，而不是首版迁移事务的一部分。

这套方案沿用当前 append 的“body first、index last”事务模型，不需要声称多个文件一起原子；权威切换只发生在单个 `INDEX.JSN` 的原子 rename。

五、可复用函数与精确插入点

可直接复用：
- `vs_history_read_all()`（311-339）：完整读取旧索引/body。
- `vs_history_body_path()`、`vs_history_index_path()`（254-270）：生成新 SOCIAL 目标路径。
- `vs_history_atomic_write()` 和 `vs_history_sync_dir()`（271-392）：body 的临时文件、fsync、rename、目录同步。
- `vs_history_entry_json()`、`vs_history_write_index_locked()`（461-532）：用当前八字段格式一次性提交新索引。
- `vs_history_normalize_entry()`（769-795）：在旧字段已经严格验证后设置 kind/新 key；不要依赖它的百分比钳制来掩盖坏源数据。
- `vs_history_load_index_locked()`（554-656）：提交后的最终校验和 RAM 安装。

不能原样复用：
- `vs_history_key_parse()`只接受新 8 字符 key；需增加严格的 legacy key parser。
- `vs_history_parse_entry()`内部立即调用新 key parser；应抽出公共字段解析，或增加 legacy wrapper，而不是放宽现有解析器。
- `vs_history_check_body_locked()`固定查 kind 子目录；旧 body 检查需指向根目录。
- `vs_history_append()`依赖 kind 已 ready，并且会逐条提交/修改 RAM，不适合一次性迁移。

精确代码位置：
- legacy 路径和 `R%08u` 常量放在当前 `vs_history.c:52-63` 的路径/序号宏旁。
- 迁移辅助函数放在 `vs_history_normalize_entry()`结束之后、`Public Functions`之前，即当前约 796 行处；此时所需静态辅助函数均已定义。
- 唯一调用点放在 `vs_history_open()`当前 872-878 行：`vs_history_load_index_locked(SOCIAL)`返回 `-ENOENT`后、调用 `vs_history_seed_social_locked()`之前。逻辑应是：迁移返回 0则重新 load；返回 `-ENOENT`才 seed；其他错误直接让 SOCIAL unavailable。不要放在 seed 之后，因为当前 seed 会立刻创建 `social/INDEX.JSN` 和 `R0000000..2.JSN`，既遮蔽旧库又造成重编号碰撞。

六、本次是否应实现

基于代码证据，建议**本次不实现自动迁移**：旧模块自加入起就没有 append 调用者，样例从未落盘；同时旧索引无 kind、body 可缺失且无强制 schema，自动分类/补 body 都需要产品层猜测，风险高于收益。可以把“实机发现根 `INDEX.JSN`”作为重新开启迁移工作的门槛。

但有一个发布时序警告：当前双表代码首次启动会立即持久化 SOCIAL 样例。若团队认为现场仍可能有仓库外旧数据，就必须在这版首次发布前加入上述迁移；一旦这版已运行并生成 `social/INDEX.JSN`，以后“仅在目标缺失时迁移”的安全触发条件便不再成立，只能设计显式合并/冲突处理。
]]>

ANSWER:
<![CDATA[
The uncommitted implementation has a coherent single-worker multi-turn lifecycle, but the three requested gaps are real: completed answers are silently reduced to 767 bytes, `context_bytes` measures pre-escaping text rather than the serialized JSON sent to the provider, and credentials are copied into live provider state only at `vs_voice_open()`, not after a successful provisioning save.

## 1. Current structs, ownership, and turn cleanup

At `app/velasight/vs_voice.c:120-263`:

- `VS_VOICE_QUESTION_MAX` is 512 and the per-call parsed answer buffer is 4096 bytes.
- A retained `vs_voice_turn_s` is much smaller: `question[512]` and `answer[768]` (`VS_VOICE_TURN_A_MAX`).
- `vs_voice_conversation_s` owns the retained `turns` array and optional heap `summary`; it tracks `turn_count`, `context_start`, `compaction_count`, and `context_bytes`.
- `g_conv` is deliberately lockless because only the one voice worker accesses it. `g_voice.busy`, protected by `g_voice.lock`, is the invariant preventing a second worker.
- `g_voice` contains the only voice mutex and condition variable plus lifecycle flags, stage, and published capture/playback handles.

`vs_voice_conv_start()` at `vs_voice.c:574-601` first calls `vs_voice_conv_reset()`, then allocates `CONFIG_VS_VOICE_MAX_TURNS` fixed-size turn slots. `vs_voice_conv_reset()` frees only `summary` and the one `turns` allocation and zeroes the whole conversation. This is sufficient only because question/answer strings are currently embedded in each slot.

`vs_voice_conv_append_turn()` at `vs_voice.c:603-624` copies into those fixed arrays with `vs_voice_copy_utf8()`, discards both boolean “fit” results, adds the lengths of the already-truncated copies plus 32 to `context_bytes`, and increments `turn_count`. Compacted turns are not removed: `context_start` only controls prompt replay, so all slots remain available to persistence until final cleanup.

The silent-loss path is actually two-stage (`vs_voice.c:938-983`, `1685-1711`):

1. `vs_voice_parse_reply()` uses unchecked `snprintf()` into the 4096-byte answer buffer, silently clipping a longer JSON `answer` to 4095 bytes.
2. The worker then explicitly calls `vs_voice_utf8_truncate(answer, 767)` before append/TTS/persistence.
3. Append performs another bounded copy and ignores whether it fit. The question slot happens to equal the current ASR destination size, but `voice_asr_stream_finish(..., 512)` has no saturation/truncation check in this file.

Thus TTS, subsequent context, and CHAT persistence are byte-consistent with one another, but consistently contain only the truncated answer, not the model’s full answer. Display text truncation is a separate, defensible UI limit; it need not constrain the retained answer.

`vs_voice_conv_persist()` (`vs_voice.c:1399-1498`) serializes every retained slot, including slots before `context_start`, into a CHAT record. It records compaction metadata and uses either the compacted summary or last retained answer for the index summary. It retries `vs_history_append()` once. The worker always resets `g_conv` afterward, including after persistence failure, so a twice-failed append loses the in-RAM conversation and produces `VOICE_FAILED`.

## 2. Exact context/80% compaction accounting

`vs_voice_conv_compact_threshold()` at `vs_voice.c:1210-1244` computes:

- model threshold: `1,000,000 tokens * 4 bytes/token * percent / 100`; at 80%, 3,200,000 bytes;
- local threshold: `CONFIG_VS_VOICE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES * percent / 100`; with the in-file 65,536 fallback, 52,428 bytes;
- prompt threshold: `(CONFIG_VS_VOICE_PROMPT_MAX_BYTES - 4096 reserve) * percent / 100` when the prompt is larger than the reserve;
- final threshold: the minimum of those three, then forcibly at least 2,048 bytes.

`vs_voice_conv_needs_compact()` (`1246-1257`) compares that threshold with `g_conv.context_bytes + incoming_bytes + strlen(summary)`, but only if at least one un-compacted turn exists. The worker supplies `incoming_bytes = strlen(question) + 512` (`1595-1600`). Each stored turn contributed `strlen(question) + strlen(answer) + 32` (`618-622`). These are heuristic raw-text bytes:

- JSON escaping is omitted. Quotes and backslashes need two serialized bytes; common control characters also need two; other bytes below 0x20 can become six-byte `\u00xx` sequences.
- The two role/message objects, commas, array framing, compaction labels/newlines, and exact current-question framing are replaced by the unexplained constants 32 and 512.
- Addition is not overflow-checked.
- `context_bytes` is not a RAM-ownership counter. After compaction it is reset to zero even though all compacted full turns remain allocated for persistence.

Consequently compaction can be requested too late: the later cJSON serialization or fixed prompt copy can return `-EMSGSIZE` before the raw-byte estimate reaches 80%. Conversely, the 4096 fixed reserve is only an estimate and differs between record and photo requests.

`vs_voice_conv_compact()` (`1259-1379`) builds one user message from the old summary and all turns from `context_start`, calls `llm_chat()` with the compacting system prompt, validates a nonempty UTF-8 summary shorter than 1201 bytes, replaces the old summary, advances `context_start` to `turn_count`, resets `context_bytes`, and increments `compaction_count`. The current question is only used to trigger compaction; it is intentionally not included in the summary.

## 3. Request prompt construction

For record context (`vs_voice.c:657-869`):

- `vs_voice_load_record_ctx()` snapshots whitelisted SOCIAL index fields, reads full JSON up to 128 KiB, extracts `txtMinutes` or fallback `body`, and intentionally bounds that reference body to 767 bytes while setting `content_truncated`.
- `vs_voice_build_record_messages()` makes a fixed 3072-byte reference containing record metadata plus optional compacted summary. It then constructs a cJSON messages array: reference as `user`, each turn from `context_start` as separate `user`/`assistant` messages, and the current question as the final `user` message. `llm_chat()` receives this array plus `VS_VOICE_SYSTEM_PROMPT` separately.

For photo context (`vs_voice.c:871-934`), the system prompt, retained-image marker, optional summary, live turns, and current question are concatenated into one text prompt with `[USER]`/`[ASSISTANT]` labels and passed with the same retained JPEG to `llm_chat_vision_raw()`.

Both builders return `-EMSGSIZE` rather than truncating the final prompt. However, `vs_voice_add_message()` does not check the return of the individual cJSON string-add operations, so an allocation failure can produce an incomplete object while the helper still returns success.

## 4. Worker flow, completion, and persistence ordering

`vs_voice_worker()` at `vs_voice.c:1504-1804` performs:

1. Allocate prompt/model/answer buffers and initialize `g_conv`.
2. Load record context or capture one photo retained for all turns.
3. For every turn: publish RECORDING stage, run ASR, distinguish follow-up silence from error, set THINKING, compact if estimated necessary, construct/call the appropriate model request, parse reply, append the turn, emit `VOICE_REPLY`, optionally run TTS, then continue unless the max-turn limit was reached.
4. On exit, persist if at least one turn exists, release the retained image and heap call buffers, reset all conversation storage, then emit one terminal event unless application shutdown is active.
5. Only after terminal-event posting does it acquire `g_voice.lock`, clear `busy` and control/handle fields, set IDLE, broadcast `idle_cond`, and unlock.

Terminal precedence is photo failure, then model/ASR/etc. `fatal_error`, then persistence failure, otherwise `VOICE_CONVERSATION_DONE`. Because `busy` stays true through terminal event delivery, neither `close()` nor a new start can overtake the old worker’s terminal event. A full app-event queue can keep the worker retrying indefinitely during normal operation; `close()` breaks that loop because posting checks `closing` each retry.

An answer is appended before TTS. Therefore a TTS failure or user stop during playback still preserves that completed question/answer in CHAT. An end request during an uninterruptible LLM call is checked after that call and before append, so that not-yet-delivered result is intentionally discarded.

## 5. End-conversation, close, and current lock ordering

Public semantics are documented in `app/velasight/include/vs_voice.h:47-82` and implemented at `vs_voice.c:1809-1977`:

- `vs_voice_start()` validates the request, takes `g_voice.lock`, rejects unopened/closing or busy state, sets `busy`, releases the lock, and creates a detached worker. Failure paths reacquire the lock, clear `busy`, and signal `idle_cond`.
- `vs_voice_end_conversation()` takes `g_voice.lock`, sets `end_requested`, and calls capture abort/playback stop for any published handle. It is nonblocking with respect to ASR/LLM/TTS network calls. `vs_voice_cancel()` is now an alias.
- `vs_voice_stop_recording()` similarly sets the per-utterance stop flag and aborts capture; the recording routine then finishes ASR normally. `vs_voice_begin_recording()` clears this flag for each new utterance.
- `vs_voice_close()` takes `g_voice.lock`, marks unopened/closing/end-requested, aborts active media, then waits on `idle_cond` while `busy`. `pthread_cond_wait()` releases the mutex while waiting, allowing the worker to acquire it and signal completion.

Current lock order is therefore `g_voice.lock -> audio capture/playback internal synchronization` in end/stop/close. Worker capture/playback and synchronous network work run without `g_voice.lock`; it holds the lock only to publish/clear handles or state. Event posting also occurs without the lock. This minimizes nesting, but invoking `audio_capture_abort()` and `audio_playback_stop()` while holding `g_voice.lock` assumes those APIs never synchronously re-enter voice code or wait for worker cleanup that itself needs `g_voice.lock`; violating that assumption would deadlock.

A separate startup race exists: `vs_voice_open()` sets `opened=true` and releases `g_voice.lock` before initializing packages and seeding credentials (`vs_voice.c:317-365`). The normal boot sequence may serialize this in practice, but the public state permits a concurrent `vs_voice_start()` to begin before initialization is complete.

## Current control and data flow

1. **Startup and initial STA attempt.** `vs_app_run()` starts a detached network worker. The worker opens `vs_network_s`, whose `vs_network_open()` calls `vs_config_load_wifi()`, then calls `vs_network_request_mode(..., VS_NET_STA)`. The configuration loader waits for SD-NAND only on its first invocation, loads the provisioning record when present, or uses Kconfig Wi-Fi defaults on `-ENOENT`.

2. **AP/STA transitions.** Every `vs_network_request_mode()` first marks the status switching, stops and joins the provisioning listener, consumes any pending save result, stops DHCP, and then applies AP or STA. AP setup resets `wlan0`, configures master mode and `192.168.10.1/24`, starts DHCP, then starts provisioning. STA setup resets `wlan0`, associates with `network->config`, waits up to 15 seconds for the Wi-Fi callback, retries DHCP three times, then starts provisioning only after a usable IPv4 address exists. Thus the wildcard HTTP listener runs on either a ready AP or a ready STA; provisioning itself never changes radio mode. A successful HTTP save deliberately leaves the current listener and link alive. New Wi-Fi credentials are used only on the next explicit switch or disconnected-STA retry.

3. **Save and callback delivery.** The HTTP server handles clients serially. For a valid POST it preserves omitted secret fields from the prior record, computes and stores a generation in the credential record, writes the success/error response, clears `clientfd`, closes the socket, and only then invokes `on_saved(status, generation, arg)`. A response-write failure after a completed store still produces a success callback. A persistence failure produces a negative callback after close; form-validation failures do not. On success, the callback generation is the record generation. On failure, the per-connection generation remains zero. The server's `g_server.generation` is only process/listener state and is reset to zero at every `velasight_provisioning_start()`; it is not the durable generation. The durable generation is the one in the record and callback.

4. **Application event polling.** `vs_app_run()` calls `vs_network_process_events()` only while `runtime.network_busy == false`. While a mode-switch/retry worker is active, provisioning callbacks can accumulate but the main loop does not consume them. The worker's stop/join prevents any further callback from that listener before it consumes the pending state, but it cannot recover callback outcomes already overwritten in `vs_network_s`. Normal polling also processes Wi-Fi disconnect/AP-client events and refreshes `runtime.api_ready` whenever `vs_network_process_events()` returns nonzero.

5. **Current save state.** `vs_network_s` has only `bool provision_event` and `int provision_status`. `vs_network_provision_saved()` explicitly discards `generation`, overwrites `provision_status`, and sets the bool. `vs_network_consume_saved()` takes that one slot under `event_lock`, clears the bool immediately, then checks status and only afterward calls `vs_config_load_wifi()`. On success it replaces `network->config` and calls `bk7258_nand_seed_agent_config()`.

S1 is valid and persisted, but never reaches `network->config`, never invokes the board mirror, and has no remaining pending marker. A later switch/retry therefore continues with the old in-memory Wi-Fi configuration.
- **Failure F, then success S:** S overwrites F. The newest persisted record is loaded, but the persistence-failure notification is silently lost.
- **Failure F1, then failure F2:** only F2 is observable. The current representation cannot retain one notification per failed POST.
- **Success S1, then success S2:** only one generic success remains. Loading normally obtains S2, so this usually converges correctly, but the code cannot identify which generation it loaded or safely acknowledge one generation while a newer callback races with the load.
- **Any success followed by a load error:** the bool is cleared at lines 384-387 before `vs_config_load_wifi()` runs. If that load returns `-EIO`, `-ETIMEDOUT`, etc., the error is reported once but the successful persisted generation is never retried.
- **Pending success followed by `-ENOENT`:** this is worse than an ordinary load error. `vs_config_load_wifi()` converts `-ENOENT` into Kconfig defaults and returns success, so the pending persisted success is acknowledged and defaults can replace the in-memory STA credentials. Even if `-ENOENT` were propagated, both current callers use `-ENOENT` to mean “there was no pending event,” so `request_mode()` would continue with old credentials. “No pending event” and “a confirmed success could not yet be read” need distinct return states.
- **Pending success followed by `-EBADMSG`:** `vs_config_load_wifi()` has an anomalous branch: it returns errors other than `-EBADMSG`, but silently falls through on `-EBADMSG`. Because the output was zeroed, it returns 0 with an empty STA SSID, the consumer clears the event and installs that invalid config, and the next STA application fails later as `STA配置 (-EBADMSG)`.
- **Switch-time loss:** `vs_network_request_mode()` stops/joins the listener and calls `vs_network_consume_saved(network, true)`. A final failure status discards an earlier success as described above. A lone failure is intentionally suppressed because the HTTP client already got the error, but success and failure are not independent, so suppressing the failure can currently suppress the success too.
- **Readiness/voice side effects when a worker consumes success:** the normal poll refreshes `runtime.api_ready`, but `VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_READY/FAILED` does not. A success consumed inside `request_mode()` can therefore leave the UI's API-ready bit stale. Also, `bk7258_nand_seed_agent_config()` writes the ai_agent JSON mirror; it is not a live credential reload.

## Voice credential behavior

`vs_voice_open()` is the only current live reload point. It loads the provisioning record once at startup, calls `llm_set_all()` for the MiMo key because the LLM proxy caches it in static live state, and calls `claw_config_set()` for Volcengine credentials because those backends reread config-store keys per call. Both seed helpers are private. A later provisioning save only triggers `bk7258_nand_seed_agent_config()` from the network consumer, which rewrites a file after `config_store_init()`/`llm_proxy_init()` have already run; it does not rerun either live seed helper. Consequently newly provisioned voice credentials are not guaranteed to be usable until restart.

The safest minimal runtime reload point is **at the start of each new conversation**, in `vs_voice_start()` after it has atomically verified `!g_voice.busy` and reserved `busy = true`, but before creating the worker. Refactor the load-and-seed block at `vs_voice.c:354-365` into a private helper used by both `vs_voice_open()` and `vs_voice_start()`. Do not hold `g_voice.lock` across SD-NAND reads, `llm_set_all()`, or `claw_config_set()`; reserve the idle voice state under the lock, release it, reload, and on reload failure clear `busy` under the lock before returning. This guarantees no voice worker is concurrently using the backends and avoids depending on unverified backend setter thread safety. Treat `-ENOENT` as the existing no-key behavior; propagate real read/corruption errors if desired. Reloading on every conversation is cheap and avoids generation-order comparisons; alternatively cache only generation equality, never numeric `>` ordering.

An eager call from `vs_network_consume_saved()` would be less safe: provisioning can happen during an active conversation, and the workspace does not contain `llm_proxy.c` or `config_store.c`, so setter synchronization could not be verified. If eager reload is required, it should be a voice-layer API that defers until `g_voice.busy` becomes false, not a direct network-to-backend call.

## Minimal generation-aware pending design

No provisioning-core change is needed; it already persists and delivers a generation. Make these focused application changes:

1. **Replace the two fields at `vs_network.c:42-43`** with independent state guarded by `event_lock`:
   ```c
   uint32_t provision_pending_generation; /* 0 means no unapplied success */
   uint32_t provision_applied_generation; /* diagnostic/current loaded gen */
   bool     provision_failure_pending;
   int      provision_failure_status;
   ```
   Generation zero is safe as the empty sentinel because successful records begin at 1. Do not decide “newer” with `>`: callback order is authoritative, while counter wrap/reinitialization makes numeric ordering unnecessary.

2. **Change `vs_network_provision_saved()` at `vs_network.c:270-282`.** Under `event_lock`, status 0 assigns the callback generation to `provision_pending_generation` and does not touch failure state. A negative status sets failure state and does not touch the pending success. A nominal success with generation 0 should be converted to a protocol/corruption failure. Because callbacks are serialized, assigning the success generation retains the latest persisted success, which is exactly what the single-record store can load. For current coalesced UI semantics, retain the first or latest outstanding failure in the separate failure slot. If the product requires one exact notification for every failed POST, this slot must instead be a bounded errno FIFO; generations cannot reconstruct failures because failed callbacks carry generation 0.

3. **Make config loads distinguish persisted records from defaults.** At `vs_config.c:42-98` and the declaration in `include/vs_config.h`, add an optional `uint32_t *loaded_generation`. Initialize it to 0, set it from `credentials.generation` only after a successful provisioning load, and return `-EBADMSG` rather than treating corruption as success. `vs_network_open()` may accept generation 0 as the legitimate first-boot-default case; pending-success consumption must not. This is the smallest way to preserve startup fallback while making a post-success reload strict.

4. **Replace `vs_network_consume_saved()` at `vs_network.c:375-402` with two logical operations:**
   - `reload_pending_success()`: snapshot the nonzero pending generation under `event_lock`, release the lock, run the potentially blocking config load, require a nonzero loaded generation, assign `network->config`, and perform non-locking mirror/reload side effects. Only after all required commit work succeeds should it reacquire `event_lock`, set `provision_applied_generation`, and clear `provision_pending_generation` **only if the currently pending generation equals the generation actually loaded**. If a newer callback arrived during I/O, the equality check fails and that newer success remains pending. On any load failure or generation-zero/default result, do not clear pending state.
   - `take_pending_failure()`: under `event_lock`, copy and clear only the failure slot. It must not inspect or clear success state.

   Give the success helper unambiguous returns such as 0 = no pending success, 1 = successfully loaded, negative = pending success could not be loaded. Do not reuse `-ENOENT` as both “none” and a failed strict load.

5. **Update both consumers.** At `vs_network.c:703-779`, after stop/join, reload pending success first; abort the transition if it cannot be loaded. Then explicitly discard/take a pending failure to preserve the existing `ignore_failure` policy without affecting success. At `vs_network.c:781-862`, attempt the success reload and independently take a failure. If both existed, apply the success but return the failure once so the UI still receives its notification; if success loading failed, leave it pending for the next poll. Combine a successful reload with Wi-Fi/AP-client changes into the existing positive “changed” result.

6. **Refresh caller-visible readiness after worker consumption.** At `vs_app.c:1088-1139`, refresh `runtime.api_ready` in both network-ready and network-failed completion paths, because either path may follow a successful record consumption. The existing refresh at `vs_app.c:1600-1622` remains correct for normal event-loop consumption.

## Locking rules

- `event_lock` owns callback-facing pending generation, applied generation, failure state, and existing Wi-Fi/AP event fields.
- Never hold `event_lock` while stopping/joining provisioning, reading SD-NAND, seeding board config, changing radio state, or reloading voice credentials. In particular, holding it across `velasight_provisioning_stop()` could deadlock if the listener is joining while its final callback is waiting for that lock.
- Snapshot under the lock, do blocking work unlocked, then use an equality-based compare-and-clear under the lock. A failed load performs no acknowledge operation.
- `network->config`, radio mode, and `status` remain owned by the main thread/network worker handoff. The caller already suppresses `vs_network_process_events()` while `network_busy`, so they do not need to move under `event_lock`.
- For voice, use `g_voice.lock` only to reserve/release idle/busy state; never hold it across persistent I/O or backend setter calls.

This design intentionally coalesces multiple successful callbacks to the latest durable record, keeps that success pending until a real persisted load succeeds, and keeps persistence-failure notification state independent so neither outcome can erase the other. No files were modified.

#include "voice/voice_asr.h"

#include <errno.h>

#include <string.h>
