static int vp_send_history_list(int fd)
{
  struct velasight_prov_history_entry_s *entries = NULL;
  unsigned int count = 0;
  unsigned int i;
  size_t body_length = 0;
  size_t len;
  uint64_t deadline_ms;
  int status;
  int ret;

  if (!vp_history_enabled())
    {
      return vp_send_status(fd, 404, "历史记录功能未启用。");
    }

  ret = vp_history_snapshot(&entries, &count);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      status = vp_history_error_status(ret);
      return vp_send_status(fd, status,
                            status == 503 ? "历史存储暂不可用。" :
                            status == 404 ? "历史记录不存在。" :
                                            "读取历史记录失败。");
    }

  len = vp_http_history_head_fragment(g_response, sizeof(g_response), count);
  if (len == 0)
    {
      free(entries);
      return vp_send_status(fd, 500, "生成历史页面失败。");
    }
  body_length = len;

  for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
    {
      len = vp_http_history_entry_fragment(g_response, sizeof(g_response),
                                           &entries[i]);
      if (len == 0 || body_length > SIZE_MAX - len)
        {
          free(entries);
          return vp_send_status(fd, 500, "历史索引格式无效。");
        }

      body_length += len;
    }

  len = vp_http_history_tail_fragment(g_response, sizeof(g_response));
  if (len == 0 || body_length > SIZE_MAX - len)
    {
      free(entries);
      return vp_send_status(fd, 500, "生成历史页面失败。");
    }
  body_length += len;

  len = vp_http_response_header(g_response, sizeof(g_response), 200,
                                "text/html; charset=utf-8", body_length,
                                NULL, NULL);
  if (len == 0)
    {
      free(entries);
      return -EOVERFLOW;
    }

  ret = vp_response_deadline(&deadline_ms);
  if (ret == 0)
    {
      ret = vp_write_all(fd, g_response, len, deadline_ms);
    }
  if (ret == 0)
    {
      len = vp_http_history_head_fragment(g_response, sizeof(g_response),
                                          count);
      ret = len == 0 ? -EOVERFLOW :
                       vp_write_all(fd, g_response, len, deadline_ms);
    }

  for (i = 0; ret == 0 && i < count; i++)
    {
      len = vp_http_history_entry_fragment(g_response, sizeof(g_response),
                                           &entries[i]);
      ret = len == 0 ? -EBADMSG :
                       vp_write_all(fd, g_response, len, deadline_ms);
    }

  if (ret == 0)
    {
      len = vp_http_history_tail_fragment(g_response, sizeof(g_response));
      ret = len == 0 ? -EOVERFLOW :
                       vp_write_all(fd, g_response, len, deadline_ms);
    }

  free(entries);
  return ret;
}

static int vp_send_history_file(int fd, const char *record_key,
                                bool download)
{
  size_t remaining;
  size_t size = 0;
  size_t len;
  uint64_t deadline_ms;
  int history_fd = -1;
  int status;
  int ret;

  if (!vp_history_enabled())
    {
      return vp_send_status(fd, 404, "历史记录功能未启用。");
    }

  ret = g_server.history.open(record_key, &history_fd, &size,
                              g_server.history.arg);
  if (ret < 0 || history_fd < 0)
    {
      if (history_fd >= 0)
        {
          close(history_fd);
        }

      if (ret >= 0)
        {
          ret = -EBADMSG;
        }
      status = vp_history_error_status(ret);
      return vp_send_status(fd, status,
                            status == 503 ? "历史存储暂不可用。" :
                            status == 404 ? "历史记录不存在。" :
                                            "打开历史记录失败。");
    }

  len = vp_http_response_header(
      g_response, sizeof(g_response), 200,
      download ? "application/json" : "application/json; charset=utf-8",
      size, download ? "attachment" : NULL,
      download ? record_key : NULL);
  if (len == 0)
    {
      close(history_fd);
      return -EOVERFLOW;
    }

  ret = vp_response_deadline(&deadline_ms);
  if (ret == 0)
    {
      ret = vp_write_all(fd, g_response, len, deadline_ms);
    }
  remaining = size;
  while (ret == 0 && remaining > 0)
    {
      size_t wanted = remaining < sizeof(g_response) ? remaining :
                                                       sizeof(g_response);
      ssize_t n = read(history_fd, g_response, wanted);

      if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR)
        {
          continue;
        }

      if (n <= 0)
        {
          ret = n < 0 ? -errno : -EIO;
          break;
        }

      ret = vp_write_all(fd, g_response, (size_t)n, deadline_ms);
      remaining -= (size_t)n;
    }

  close(history_fd);
  return ret;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: vp_handle
 *
 * Description:
 *   Serve one connection.  Sets *saved when credentials were persisted and
 *   *save_status to 0 or the negative errno of a failed save, so the caller can
 *   notify the application only after the socket is gone.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static void vp_handle(int fd, bool *saved, int *save_status,
                      uint32_t *generation)
{
  struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
  struct vp_http_request_s req;
  size_t len = 0;
  int ret;

  *saved = false;
  *save_status = 0;

  ret = vp_read_request(fd, &req);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      if (ret == -E2BIG)
        {
          len = vp_http_status_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), 431,
                                    "请求过大。");
        }
      else
        {
          /* Nothing usable arrived; answering a client that already gave up
           * is not worth a second syscall.
           */

          return;
        }
    }
  else if (req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_PAGE)
    {
       {
         struct velasight_prov_credentials_s current;
         const char *ssid = NULL;

         if (velasight_provisioning_load(&current) == 0)
           ssid = current.ssid;
         len = vp_http_form_page_with_ssid_history(
             g_response, sizeof(g_response), NULL, ssid,
             vp_history_enabled());
       }
    }
  else if (req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_HISTORY_LIST)
    {
      ret = vp_send_history_list(fd);
      if (ret < 0)
        {
          printf("provision_web: history list write failed: %d\n", ret);
        }
      return;
    }
  else if (req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_HISTORY_JSON ||
           req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_HISTORY_DOWNLOAD)
    {
      ret = vp_send_history_file(
          fd, req.record_key,
          req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_HISTORY_DOWNLOAD);
      if (ret < 0)
        {
          printf("provision_web: history file write failed: %d\n", ret);
        }
      return;
    }
  else if (req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT)
    {
      len = vp_http_status_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), req.status,
                               req.status == 404 ? "页面不存在。" :
                               req.status == 403 ? "不允许跨站提交。" :
                               req.status == 405 ? "不支持该请求方法。" :
                               req.status == 413 ? "提交内容过大。" :
                               req.status == 415 ? "提交格式不受支持。" :
                               req.status == 411 ? "缺少 Content-Length。" :
                                                   "请求无法解析。");
    }
  else
    {
      memset(&cred, 0, sizeof(cred));
      ret = vp_form_parse(g_request + req.header_len, req.content_length,
                          &cred);
      if (ret < 0)
        {
          /* No detail about which field failed and no echo of what was typed:
           * the notice has to be useful to the person at the phone without
           * repeating a passphrase back over an open network.
           */

           {
             struct velasight_prov_credentials_s current;
             const char *ssid = NULL;

             if (velasight_provisioning_load(&current) == 0)
               ssid = current.ssid;
             len = vp_http_form_page_with_ssid(
                 g_response, sizeof(g_response),
                 "SSID 需 1-32 字节，密码需留空或 8-63 字节，"
                 "API key 需为可打印字符，请检查后重试。", ssid);
           }
          if (len > 0)
            {
              /* Reuse the form page body but answer 400, so a client that
               * checks the status still learns the submit failed.
               */

              len = vp_http_status_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), 400,
                                        "SSID 需 1-32 字节，密码需留空或 "
                                        "8-63 字节。");
            }
        }
        else
          {
            struct velasight_prov_credentials_s previous;
            bool have_previous = velasight_provisioning_load(&previous) == 0;

            /* None of the three secret fields are pre-filled in HTML.  An
             * ordinary Wi-Fi-only resubmit must not erase any of them. */
            if (cred.api_key[0] == '\0' && have_previous)
              {
                snprintf(cred.api_key, sizeof(cred.api_key), "%s",
                         previous.api_key);
              }

            if (cred.volc_appid[0] == '\0' && have_previous)
              {
                snprintf(cred.volc_appid, sizeof(cred.volc_appid), "%s",
                         previous.volc_appid);
              }

            if (cred.volc_token[0] == '\0' && have_previous)
              {
                snprintf(cred.volc_token, sizeof(cred.volc_token), "%s",
                         previous.volc_token);
              }

            cred.generation = vp_store_next_generation(g_server.store_path);
          ret = vp_store_save(g_server.store_path, &cred);
          if (ret < 0)
            {
              *saved = false;
              *save_status = ret;
              len = vp_http_status_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), 500,
                                        "写入持久存储失败，凭据未保存。");
            }
          else
            {
              *saved = true;
              *save_status = 0;
              *generation = cred.generation;
              len = vp_http_saved_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response),
                                       cred.ssid, cred.generation,
                                       cred.open_network);
            }
        }
    }

  if (len > 0)
    {
      ret = vp_write_response(fd, g_response, len);
      if (ret < 0)
        {
          /* Transport failure does not undo a completed persistent save.
           * In particular, NuttX may return ENOMEM when TCP write buffers are
           * temporarily exhausted by repeated phone connections.  Report the
           * stored result to the application; only vp_store_save() decides
           * whether the credentials were saved.
           */

          printf("provision_web: response write failed: %d\n", ret);
        }
    }
}

static int parse(const char *request, struct vp_http_request_s *req)
{

}

static void test_dispatch(void)
{
  struct vp_http_request_s req;

  CHECK(parse("GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_PAGE, "GET / serves the form");

        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_PAGE, "GET /index.html serves the form");

        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_PAGE, "a query string is ignored");

        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_HISTORY_LIST,
        "GET /history serves the social-history list");

static void test_limits(void)
{
  struct vp_http_request_s req;
  char big[VP_HTTP_MAX_HEADERS + 256];
  size_t used;

  CHECK(parse("GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n", &req) == -EAGAIN,
        "incomplete headers ask for more");
  CHECK(parse("GE", &req) == -EAGAIN, "a partial request line asks for more");

  CHECK(parse("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
              "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n\r\n", &req)
        == 0 && req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 411,
        "a submit without Content-Length is 411");

  CHECK(parse("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
              "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
              "Content-Length: 99999\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 413,

  CHECK(parse("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
              "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
              "Content-Length: abc\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 400,

              "Content-Type: text/plain\r\n"
              "Content-Length: 5\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&
        req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT && req.status == 415,
        "a non-form content type is 415");

  CHECK(parse("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
              "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
              "Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&

  CHECK(parse("GET\r\n\r\n", &req) == 0 &&

        "a request line without a path is 400");

  used = (size_t)snprintf(big, sizeof(big), "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nX: ");

/* Apply the newest durable successful save.  The callback-facing generation
 * is acknowledged only after the record has been loaded and all live mirrors
 * have accepted the refresh.  An equal compare under event_lock preserves a
 * newer callback that may arrive while SD-NAND I/O is in progress.
 *
 * Returns 1 when a save was applied, 0 when none is pending, or a negative
 * errno while leaving the successful generation pending for a later retry.
 */

static int vs_network_reload_saved(struct vs_network_s *network)
{
  struct vs_wifi_config_s config;
  uint32_t pending_generation;
  uint32_t loaded_generation = 0;
  int ret;

  pthread_mutex_lock(&network->event_lock);
  pending_generation = network->provision_pending_generation;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&network->event_lock);
  if (pending_generation == 0)
    {
      return 0;
    }

  ret = vs_config_load_wifi(&config, &loaded_generation);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      return ret;
    }

  if (loaded_generation == 0)
    {
      return -EBADMSG;
    }

  network->config = config;
  bk7258_nand_seed_agent_config();
  ret = vs_voice_reload_credentials();
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      return ret;
    }

  pthread_mutex_lock(&network->event_lock);
  network->provision_applied_generation = loaded_generation;
  if (network->provision_pending_generation == loaded_generation)
    {
      network->provision_pending_generation = 0;
    }
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&network->event_lock);
  return 1;
}

static int vs_network_take_save_failure(struct vs_network_s *network)
{
  int status = 0;

  pthread_mutex_lock(&network->event_lock);
  if (network->provision_failure_pending)
    {
      status = network->provision_failure_status;
      network->provision_failure_pending = false;
    }
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&network->event_lock);
  return status;
}

static int vs_network_apply_sta(struct vs_network_s *network)
{
  struct wpa_wconfig_s wifi;
  struct in_addr address;
  unsigned int attempt;
  int ret;

  network->status.wifi_issue = VS_WIFI_ISSUE_DISCONNECTED;
  if (network->config.sta_ssid[0] == '\0')
    return vs_network_failed(network, "STA配置", -EBADMSG);

  pthread_mutex_lock(&network->event_lock);
  network->ignore_sta_disconnect = true;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&network->event_lock);
  ret = wapi_set_ifdown(network->sock, "wlan0");
  pthread_mutex_lock(&network->event_lock);
  network->ignore_sta_disconnect = false;
  network->wifi_event = false;
  network->sta_ipv4_ready = false;
  network->sta_disconnect_reason = 0;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&network->event_lock);
  if (ret < 0 && ret != -ENODEV && ret != -ETIMEDOUT)
    return vs_network_failed(network, "STA关闭接口", ret);
  if (ret == -ETIMEDOUT)
    printf("velasight: STA ifdown timed out; continuing interface reset\n");

  ret = wapi_set_ifup(network->sock, "wlan0");
  if (ret < 0)
     return vs_network_failed(network, "STA开启接口", ret);

  memset(&wifi, 0, sizeof(wifi));
  wifi.ifname = "wlan0";
  wifi.sta_mode = WAPI_MODE_MANAGED;
  if (!network->config.sta_open_network &&
      network->config.sta_password[0] != '\0')
    {
      wifi.auth_wpa = IW_AUTH_WPA_VERSION_WPA2;
      wifi.cipher_mode = IW_AUTH_CIPHER_CCMP;
      wifi.alg = WPA_ALG_CCMP;
    }
  wifi.ssid = network->config.sta_ssid;
  wifi.ssidlen = strlen(wifi.ssid);
  wifi.passphrase = network->config.sta_password;
  wifi.phraselen = strlen(wifi.passphrase);

  ret = wpa_driver_wext_associate(&wifi);
  if (ret < 0)
     return vs_network_failed(network, "STA连接", ret);

  ret = vs_network_wait_sta_association(network);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      (void)wapi_set_ifdown(network->sock, "wlan0");
      return vs_network_failed(network,
          network->status.wifi_issue == VS_WIFI_ISSUE_PASSWORD ?
          "WiFi密码错误" :
          network->status.wifi_issue == VS_WIFI_ISSUE_SSID_NOT_FOUND ?
          "SSID未扫描到" : "STA关联", ret);
    }

  ret = -ETIMEDOUT;
  for (attempt = 0; attempt < VS_DHCP_TRIES; attempt++)
    {
      ret = netlib_obtain_ipv4addr("wlan0");
      if (ret == 0)
        {
          break;
        }

      if (attempt + 1 < VS_DHCP_TRIES)
        {
          printf("velasight: STA DHCP attempt %u failed: %d, retrying\n",
                 attempt + 1, ret);
          usleep(VS_DHCP_RETRY_MS * 1000);
        }
    }

  if (ret < 0)
    {
      network->status.wifi_issue = vs_network_sta_issue(
          network, VS_WIFI_ISSUE_DISCONNECTED);
      (void)wapi_set_ifdown(network->sock, "wlan0");
      return vs_network_failed(network,
          network->status.wifi_issue == VS_WIFI_ISSUE_PASSWORD ?
          "WiFi密码错误" : "STA获取地址", ret);
    }

  memset(&address, 0, sizeof(address));
  ret = netlib_get_ipv4addr("wlan0", &address);
  if (ret < 0 || address.s_addr == htonl(INADDR_ANY))
    {
      if (ret >= 0)
        {
          ret = -EADDRNOTAVAIL;
        }
      (void)wapi_set_ifdown(network->sock, "wlan0");
      return vs_network_failed(network, "STA读取地址", ret);
    }

  if (inet_ntop(AF_INET, &address, network->status.address,
                sizeof(network->status.address)) == NULL)
    {
      ret = errno != 0 ? -errno : -EIO;
      (void)wapi_set_ifdown(network->sock, "wlan0");
      return vs_network_failed(network, "STA地址格式", ret);
    }

  ret = vs_network_start_provisioning(network);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      (void)wapi_set_ifdown(network->sock, "wlan0");
      return vs_network_failed(network, "STA配网服务", ret);
    }

  network->mode = VS_NET_STA;
  network->status.mode = VS_NET_STA;
  network->status.state = VS_NET_STA_READY;
  network->status.wifi_issue = VS_WIFI_ISSUE_NONE;
  pthread_mutex_lock(&network->event_lock);
  network->sta_ipv4_ready = true;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&network->event_lock);
  snprintf(network->status.ssid, sizeof(network->status.ssid), "%s",
           network->config.sta_ssid);
  network->status.password[0] = '\0';
  printf("velasight: STA ready, web http://%s/\n",
         network->status.address);
  return 0;
}

fail:
  (void)vs_network_stop_provisioning(network);

}

int vs_network_open(struct vs_network_s **network)
{
  struct vs_network_s *n;
  int ret;

  if (network == NULL)
    return -EINVAL;

  n = calloc(1, sizeof(*n));
  if (n == NULL)
    return -ENOMEM;

  ret = pthread_mutex_init(&n->event_lock, NULL);
  if (ret != 0)
    {
      free(n);
      return -ret;
    }

  ret = pthread_cond_init(&n->wifi_cond, NULL);
  if (ret != 0)
    {
      pthread_mutex_destroy(&n->event_lock);
      free(n);
      return -ret;
    }

  n->sock = wapi_make_socket();
  if (n->sock < 0)
    {
      ret = n->sock;
      pthread_cond_destroy(&n->wifi_cond);
      pthread_mutex_destroy(&n->event_lock);
      free(n);
      return ret;
    }

  ret = vs_config_load_wifi(&n->config, NULL);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      close(n->sock);
      pthread_cond_destroy(&n->wifi_cond);
      pthread_mutex_destroy(&n->event_lock);
      free(n);
      return ret;
    }

  n->mode = VS_NET_STA;
  n->status.mode = VS_NET_STA;
  n->status.state = VS_NET_DOWN;
  n->status.wifi_issue = VS_WIFI_ISSUE_DISCONNECTED;
  ret = bk7258_wifi_register_event_callback(vs_network_wifi_event, n);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      close(n->sock);
      pthread_cond_destroy(&n->wifi_cond);
      pthread_mutex_destroy(&n->event_lock);
      free(n);
      return ret;
    }
  *network = n;
  return 0;
}

int vs_network_request_mode(struct vs_network_s *network,
                            enum vs_net_mode_e mode)
{
  int ret;

  if (network == NULL)
    return -EINVAL;

  network->status.error = 0;
  network->status.error_reason[0] = '\0';
  network->status.state = VS_NET_SWITCHING;

  /* The wildcard listener is also active in STA mode.  Join it before any
   * wlan0 reset so no client or callback survives across an interface role
   * change; both AP and STA paths start a fresh listener after their address
   * is ready. */

  ret = vs_network_stop_provisioning(network);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
               sizeof(network->status.error_reason),
               "Web服务停止 (%d)", ret);
      network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
      network->status.error = ret;
      return ret;
    }

  /* stop() joins the listener, so no save callback can race this reload.
   * A failed HTTP save already returned an error to its client and does not
   * invalidate the current config.  A successful save remains pending until
   * its durable generation and live providers have both been refreshed. */

  ret = vs_network_reload_saved(network);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
               sizeof(network->status.error_reason),
               "加载已保存配置 (%d)", ret);
      network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
      network->status.error = ret;
      return ret;
    }

  /* The browser already received any persistence failure.  Discard only the
   * independent failure notification during a mode switch; never the pending
   * success generation above. */
  (void)vs_network_take_save_failure(network);

  ret = vs_network_stop_dhcp(network);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
               sizeof(network->status.error_reason), "DHCP停止 (%d)", ret);
      network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
      network->status.error = ret;
      return ret;
    }

  /* AP resources are gone before STA association begins.  If association or
   * DHCP then fails, the next network toggle must be able to enter AP again.
   */
  if (mode == VS_NET_STA)
    {
      network->mode = VS_NET_STA;
      network->status.mode = VS_NET_STA;
    }

  ret = mode == VS_NET_AP ? vs_network_apply_ap(network) :
                             vs_network_apply_sta(network);
    if (ret < 0)
      {
        if (network->status.error_reason[0] == '\0')
          snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
                   sizeof(network->status.error_reason),
                   "网络切换 (%d)", ret);
        network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
      network->status.error = ret;
    }

  return ret;
}

int vs_network_process_events(struct vs_network_s *network)
{
  bool ap_client_event;
  bool sta_connected;
  bool sta_ipv4_ready;
  bool wifi_event;
  uint8_t ap_client_count;
  bool changed = false;
  int disconnect_reason;
  int ret;

  if (network == NULL)
    return 0;

  pthread_mutex_lock(&network->event_lock);
  wifi_event = network->wifi_event;
  sta_connected = network->sta_connected;
  sta_ipv4_ready = network->sta_ipv4_ready;
  disconnect_reason = network->sta_disconnect_reason;
  network->wifi_event = false;
  ap_client_event = network->ap_client_event;
  ap_client_count = network->ap_client_count;
  network->ap_client_event = false;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&network->event_lock);

  if (network->mode == VS_NET_STA && wifi_event)
    {
      if (sta_connected)
        {
          network->status.state = sta_ipv4_ready ? VS_NET_STA_READY :
                                                   VS_NET_DOWN;
          network->status.wifi_issue = sta_ipv4_ready ?
                                       VS_WIFI_ISSUE_NONE :
                                       VS_WIFI_ISSUE_DISCONNECTED;
          if (sta_ipv4_ready)
            {
              network->status.error = 0;
              network->status.error_reason[0] = '\0';
            }
          changed = true;
        }
      else
        {
          network->status.state = VS_NET_DOWN;
          network->status.wifi_issue =
              disconnect_reason == (int)BK7258_WIFI_REASON_NO_AP_FOUND ?
              VS_WIFI_ISSUE_SSID_NOT_FOUND :
              disconnect_reason == (int)BK7258_WIFI_REASON_WRONG_PASSWORD ?
              VS_WIFI_ISSUE_PASSWORD : VS_WIFI_ISSUE_DISCONNECTED;
          changed = true;
        }
    }

  if (network->mode == VS_NET_AP && ap_client_event)
    {
      network->status.ap_client_count = ap_client_count;
      changed = true;
    }

  ret = vs_network_reload_saved(network);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      /* Do not acknowledge the generation on a transient load/provider
       * failure.  The current link stays alive and a later poll retries. */
      network->status.error = ret;
      snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
               sizeof(network->status.error_reason),
               "加载保存配置 (%d)", ret);
      return ret;
    }

  if (ret > 0)
    {
      changed = true;
      network->status.error = 0;
      network->status.error_reason[0] = '\0';
    }

  ret = vs_network_take_save_failure(network);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      /* Persistence errors belong to the Web operation, not the radio.  Keep
       * the real AP/STA/DOWN state instead of fabricating AP_READY while the
       * device may be connected as a station. */
      network->status.error = ret;
      snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
               sizeof(network->status.error_reason),
               "保存配置失败 (%d)", ret);
      return ret;
    }

  /* Keep the current listener and link alive after a save.  New Wi-Fi
   * credentials are used by the next explicit switch or disconnected-STA
   * retry; MiMo/Volcengine live credentials are already refreshed or queued. */
  return changed ? 1 : 0;
}

static void test_get_and_save(void)
{
  struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
  struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
  volatile bool saw_callback = false;
  char reply[8192];
  int len;

  memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
  cfg.store_path = g_path;
  cfg.on_saved   = on_saved;
  cfg.cb_arg     = (void *)&saw_callback;

  reset_callback();
  CHECK(start_on_free_port(&cfg) == 0, "the service starts for a submit");

  len = http_exchange("GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 192.168.10.1\r\n"
                      "Connection: close\r\n\r\n", reply, sizeof(reply));
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK") != NULL &&
        strstr(reply, "name=\"ssid\"") != NULL,
        "GET / returns the form and the peer closes");
  CHECK(cb_calls() == 0, "serving the page does not fire the callback");

  len = http_exchange("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 192.168.10.1\r\n"
                      "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
                      "Content-Length: 30\r\n\r\n"
                      "ssid=AIPC&password=testpass123", reply, sizeof(reply));
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK") != NULL,
        "a valid submit is accepted");
  CHECK(strstr(reply, "AIPC") != NULL,
        "the success page names the network that was saved");
  CHECK(strstr(reply, "testpass123") == NULL,
        "the success page does not echo the passphrase");

  /* The response arrived and the socket closed before the callback ran; the
   * flag was set by the callback, so seeing it now proves the order rather
   * than merely that both happened.
   */

  for (len = 0; len < 200 && cb_calls() == 0; len++)
    {
      usleep(10000);
    }

  CHECK(cb_calls() == 1, "the callback fired exactly once");
  CHECK(saw_callback, "the callback ran after the response was delivered");
  CHECK(g_cb_status == 0, "the callback reported success");
  CHECK(g_cb_generation == 1, "the callback carried generation 1");
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_generation() == 1,
        "the service exposes the same generation");

  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_load_from(g_path, &cred) == 0 &&
        strcmp(cred.ssid, "AIPC") == 0 &&
        strcmp(cred.password, "testpass123") == 0 && cred.generation == 1,
        "the credentials are on disk and readable");

  /* Still listening: the default is to stay up until the application stops
   * it, and a second submit replaces the first with a new generation.
   */

  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_is_running(),
        "the service keeps running after a save by default");

  len = http_exchange("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\n"
                      "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"
                      "Content-Length: 22\r\n\r\n"
                      "ssid=OpenNet&password=", reply, sizeof(reply));
  CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK") != NULL,
        "an open network submit is accepted");
  for (len = 0; len < 200 && cb_calls() < 2; len++)
    {
      usleep(10000);
    }

  CHECK(cb_calls() == 2 && g_cb_generation == 2,
        "the second save produces generation 2");
  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_load_from(g_path, &cred) == 0 &&
        strcmp(cred.ssid, "OpenNet") == 0 && cred.open_network,
        "the replacement is what is stored");

  CHECK(velasight_provisioning_stop() == 0, "the service stops after saves");
}

{"content":"# Social Cue Assistant

Read one facial-expression snapshot of the person you are talking to and hand
the wearer a short, low-key hint about how the conversation is landing.

This is VelaSight's core skill. It is a *communication aid*, not a judgement:
every output is a possibility with a confidence attached, and "I can't tell" is
a first-class answer rather than a failure.

## When to use

- The user asks how the other person is reacting: "他听懂了吗", "对方什么反应",
  "am I losing them", "how did that land".
- The user presses the analyse button (short press). The device then calls this
  skill once; it does not run continuously.

Do **not** use this skill to answer "who is this person", to guess personality,
mood history, health or intent, or to compare two people. Those are out of
scope by design — see Boundaries.

## How to use

1. `get_current_time` — the result is stamped, and a stale frame is worthless.
2. `camera_capture` — exactly one frame. If it fails, stop and say so; do not
   retry in a loop and do not fall back to a stored image.
3. Send that frame to the vision model and ask for the JSON in Output, nothing
   else. Ask for at most three cues.
4. Apply the confidence rule below. Then speak **one or two sentences**, in the
   user's language, phrased as a possibility and paired with something the user
   can actually do.
5. Discard the frame. Do not write it to a file, do not put it in memory, do
   not include it in a daily note.

## Output

The vision model must return exactly this shape:

```json
{
  "cues": [
    { "cue": "brow_furrow", "meaning": "possible confusion", "confidence": 0.72 }
  ],
  "overall_confidence": 0.72,
  "unable_to_judge": false,
  "reason": "",
  "suggestion": "slow down and check whether the last point landed"
}
```

- `cue` — an observable, not a conclusion: `brow_furrow`, `gaze_away`,
  `smile`, `lip_press`, `nod`, `head_tilt`, `eyes_widen`, `neutral`.
- `meaning` — always hedged: "possible confusion", not "confused".
- `confidence` — 0.0 to 1.0, per cue.
- `unable_to_judge` — `true` whenever the rule below says so; then `cues` may
  be empty and `reason` must be filled in.
- `reason` — why not: `no_face`, `face_too_small`, `occluded`, `side_profile`,
  `motion_blur`, `overexposed`, `underexposed`, `conflicting_cues`.
- `suggestion` — one actionable clause, or `""` when unable to judge.

## The confidence rule

| `overall_confidence` | What you say |
|---|---|
| ≥ 0.60 | The cue, hedged, plus the suggestion |
| 0.40 – 0.59 | The cue, hedged, and say the read is weak — no suggestion |
| < 0.40 | "无法判断" plus the reason, and nothing else |

Two more cases force `unable_to_judge` regardless of the number:

- **No face, or a face smaller than roughly 1/8 of the frame.** There is
  nothing to read.
- **Conflicting cues** — e.g. `smile` and `brow_furrow` both above 0.6. Say the
  signals disagree instead of picking the louder one.

Never round a low confidence up in the wording. "可能有点困惑" and "他困惑了"
are different claims, and only the first one is available to you.

## Example

User: 他听懂了吗？

```
get_current_time            → 2026-08-13T19:42+08:00
camera_capture              → 41 KB JPEG, 480x480
vision model                → {"cues":[{"cue":"brow_furrow","meaning":"possible
                               confusion","confidence":0.74}],
                               "overall_confidence":0.74,
                               "unable_to_judge":false,"reason":"",
                               "suggestion":"slow down, check the last point"}
```

Reply: 「他眉头微皱，可能没完全跟上。可以放慢一点，问一句刚才那段是否清楚。」

Same call, side profile:

```
vision model → {"cues":[],"overall_confidence":0.11,
                "unable_to_judge":true,"reason":"side_profile","suggestion":""}
```

Reply: 「这个角度看不清表情，判断不了。」— and stop there. Do not guess, and do
not ask the user to reposition the other person.

## Boundaries

These are product requirements, not style preferences:

- **No identity.** Never identify, name, or re-recognise a person; never build
  a profile or remember "this person tends to…".
- **No diagnosis.** No medical, psychiatric, neurological or personality
  claims. Autism, depression, lying, hostility are not yours to infer.
- **No history.** One call, one frame, one answer. Nothing about this analysis
  is written to `MEMORY.md` or a daily note.
- **Say the uncertainty out loud.** If the wearer asks how sure you are, give
  them the number.
- **The wearer is in charge.** Long press cancels; when cancelled, say nothing
  about the frame that was already captured, and discard it.
"}

		Percentage of CONFIG_VS_VOICE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES at which the
		running conversation is compacted (see above).  The product
		requirement this implements is stated in terms of the model's
		own maximum context (mimo-v2.5 advertises a 1M-token window);
		CONFIG_VS_VOICE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES is deliberately a much smaller,
		locally-enforced budget, because this device's own conversation
		length in one sitting never approaches a million tokens and a
		budget sized to it would make local RAM the only limit that
		exists in practice.  See vs_voice.c's chat-context module for the
		full reasoning.

1. 解析校验 JSON；2. 选一个既不在索引也不在磁盘的序号（`vs_history_choose_seq_locked()`，`738`，最多 `MAX_RECORDS+1024` 次探测，否则 `-ENOSPC`）；3. 归一化条目（`vs_history_normalize_entry()`，`769`，覆盖 record_key、截断文本、百分比 clamp 100）；4. 原子写新 body；5. 原子写含新条目的候选索引（新记录放 index 0，最旧的被淘汰）；索引写失败则 `unlink` 刚写的 body 并返回错误，**旧索引与旧 body 完好**；6. 索引成功后才更新 RAM 表并 `unlink` 被淘汰的旧 body，unlink 失败只打印日志、不把已持久化的 append 变成失败（`vs_history.c:1179-1195`）。掉电最坏结果是留下一个未被索引引用的孤儿 body。
容量为每类各 `CONFIG_VS_HISTORY_MAX_RECORDS`（默认 64，`Kconfig:126-133`），FIFO 淘汰最旧。

**其余 API**：`vs_history_open()`（`799`，先 `vs_history_wait_for_store()` 轮询 `bk7258_mmcsd_status()` 最多 70 s，`197-219`；非 `CONFIG_BK7258_SDIO` 直接 `-ENODEV`）、`vs_history_is_ready()`(906)、`vs_history_count()`(921)、`vs_history_get_index()`(936)、`vs_history_snapshot()`(956，分页、持锁一致快照)、`vs_history_open_full()`(990，key 校验 + 索引成员检查 + 持锁打开，Web 下载拿到稳定 fd)、`vs_history_read_full()`(1043，容量不足返回 `-E2BIG` 而不是截断)、`vs_history_close()`(1205)。全部由单个 `g_history_lock` 互斥（`vs_history.c:81`）。

# 2) SOCIAL 历史：硬编码并未真正被取代

**原硬编码示例数据现在就在 `vs_history.c` 里**：`g_social_seed[]`（`vs_history.c:87-107`：`R0000000 "08/18 09:20" "上午交流" "整体较平稳\n后段略有疑惑" 55/30/15`，`R0000001 "项目讨论"`，`R0000002 "日常记录"`）与对应的 `g_social_seed_body[]`（`109-151`）。仓库内除设计文档 `docs/plans/VELASIGHT_UI_DESIGN_INSTRUCTION.md:252` 之外，没有其他地方留有这批文本 —— 说明旧的 UI 层静态数组已被删除，改为"首启动把样本通过同一条原子路径写进 NAND"（`vs_history_seed_social_locked()`，`vs_history.c:667-707`；无 NAND 时退化为 RAM-only 样本，`vs_history_load_seed_memory_locked()`，`656-665` 与 `vs_history_open()` 的 `store_ret<0` 分支 `vs_history.c:845-852`）。

**UI 读取路径已改成从存储读**：`vs_snapshot()`（`vs_app.c:439-458`）用 `vs_history_get_index(VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL, runtime->index, &current)` 取当前条目，`VS_PAGE_HISTORY` 分支把 `current.title/summary/date` 填进 `content_title/content_body/content_meta`，条数用 `vs_history_count()`（`vs_app.c:494-503`）；翻页/询问也走同一 API（`vs_app.c:1259-1350`）。Web 侧只暴露 SOCIAL：列表 `vs_history_snapshot()`、下载 `vs_history_open_full()`（`vs_network.c:302-368`）。

**结论与缺口**：数据通路已经取代硬编码，但**内容仍是硬编码的假数据**——`vs_history_append(VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL, ...)` 在整个仓库中没有任何调用者，即没有真实社交会话生产者。`app/velasight/vs_social.c`、`vs_cloud.c`、`vs_web_stub.c`（以及 `include/vs_social.h`、`include/vs_cloud.h`）都是 **0 字节空文件**；`VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_STARTED / SOCIAL_ALERT / SOCIAL_RESULT` 等事件只有 `vs_app.c:1004-1090` 的消费方，没有任何 post 方，所以 `VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_STARTING/FINALIZING` 实际上永远等不到事件。另有残留：`struct vs_history_item_s`（`include/vs_types.h:107-117`）和 `snapshot->history` 指针仍在类型里，但 `vs_snapshot()` 恒置 `NULL`（`vs_app.c:454`），`vs_display.c` 也从不解引用它 —— 死结构。`calm/happy/tense` 三个百分比只有样本在写，图表/图例视图（`VS_HISTORY_CHART/LEGEND`，`vs_types.h:64-70`）在 `vs_display.c` 中查不到渲染代码。

# 3) CHAT（闲时问答）

**内存缓存 + 连续多轮：是。** `g_conv`（`struct vs_voice_conversation_s`，`vs_voice.c:223-236`，实例 `263`）由单个 voice worker 独占，注释在 `vs_voice.c:203-221`。`vs_voice_conv_start()`（`920-940`）按 `CONFIG_VS_VOICE_MAX_TURNS`（默认 20）预分配轮次数组；`vs_voice_conv_append_turn()`（`942-1006`）把 question/answer 放进一块紧凑分配（`turn->storage`），累计 `turn_storage_bytes` 受 `CONFIG_VS_VOICE_TURN_STORAGE_MAX_BYTES`（128 KB）硬约束，超限**明确拒绝该轮并以 error 结束，绝不截断**。worker 主循环（`vs_voice.c:2032-2229`）在 TTS 播完后置 `followup=true` 继续录音，重放上下文由 `vs_voice_build_record_messages()`（`1179+`，从 `g_conv.context_start` 起逐轮 replay）或 `vs_voice_build_photo_prompt()`（`~1290`）构造；照片只拍一次并全程复用（`vs_voice.c:2004-2007` 注释）。

**静音超时写 NAND：是。** 只在 followup 轮生效：`vs_voice_record_and_recognize()` 里 `followup && !vad.speech_started && elapsed >= CONFIG_VS_VOICE_SILENCE_TIMEOUT_MS`（默认 8000 ms，`Kconfig:136-150`）→ 返回 `VS_VOICE_RECORD_SILENCE`（`vs_voice.c:1466-1522`，空转写也回这个值 `1538-1541`）→ 主循环 `end_reason = VS_VOICE_END_SILENCE`（`vs_voice.c:2057-2061`）→ break。

**手动退出写 NAND：是。** `vs_voice_end_conversation()/vs_voice_cancel()`（`vs_voice.c:2413-2440`）置 `end_requested` 并 abort 采集/停止播放，循环各检查点把 `end_reason` 设为 `VS_VOICE_END_USER`（关机时 `VS_VOICE_END_SHUTDOWN`）后 break。

统一落盘点在 `finish:`（`vs_voice.c:2231-2236`）：`if (g_conv.turn_count > 0) persist_error = vs_voice_conv_persist(end_reason);` —— 即 silence / user_exit / max_turns / shutdown / error 五种结束原因**都会写**，只要有至少一轮。`vs_voice_conv_persist()`（`1825-1955`）序列化上面第 1 节的 CHAT schema，索引条目里 `date` 用开机相对时间 `"运行+H:MM:SS"`（**无 RTC，缺墙钟时间**，`vs_voice.c:1917-1921`），`title` 固定 `"记录问答"/"照片问答"`，`summary` 取压缩摘要或最后一轮答案，`incomplete` 仅在 error/shutdown 置真；`vs_history_append(VS_HISTORY_KIND_CHAT, ...)` 失败后 sleep 100 ms 重试一次（`1933-1938`），仍失败则通过 `VS_APP_EVENT_VOICE_FAILED` 上报（`2261-2265`）。

**80% 阈值压缩：`vs_voice_conv_compact_threshold()`（`vs_voice.c:1620-1654`）。** 取三者最小值再下限 2048 字节：
- 模型窗口：`VS_VOICE_MIMO_CONTEXT_TOKENS(1000000) * VS_VOICE_TOKEN_BYTES_ESTIMATE(4) * 80%`（`vs_voice.c:138-139`）
- 本地 RAM 预算：`CONFIG_VS_VOICE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES(64 KB) * 80%`
- 实际请求缓冲：`(CONFIG_VS_VOICE_PROMPT_MAX_BYTES - VS_VOICE_PROMPT_FIXED_RESERVE(4096)) * 80%`
百分比来自 `CONFIG_VS_VOICE_CONTEXT_COMPACT_PERCENT`（默认 80，`Kconfig:181-196`）。

**计量方式**：不是 token，而是 **JSON 转义后的线上字节数**。每轮入账 `vs_voice_turn_context_bytes()`（`810-869`，含 role/content 框架字节，RECORD 上下文额外加参考资料框架），新问题预估 `vs_voice_question_context_bytes()`（`871-905`）。`vs_voice_conv_needs_compact()`（`1656-1678`）= 当前 `g_conv.context_bytes` + 本轮 incoming + 已有 summary 的转义长度 + 64 字节余量 ≥ 阈值，且 `context_start < turn_count`；任何加法溢出直接判定需要压缩。

**压缩动作**：`vs_voice_conv_compact()`（`1680-1806`）把 `[PREVIOUS SUMMARY]` + `context_start..turn_count` 的逐轮文本拼成一条 user 消息，用 `VS_VOICE_COMPACT_SYSTEM_PROMPT`（`1032-1041`）调 `llm_chat()`，要求只返回 `{"summary":...}`（≤1200 字节 `VS_VOICE_COMPACT_SUMMARY_MAX`、必须合法 UTF-8，否则 `-EBADMSG`）；成功后 `free(g_conv.summary)` 换新摘要、`context_start = turn_count`、`context_bytes = 0`、`compaction_count++`。调用点两处：主循环每轮提问前的软触发（`2077-2085`，force=false），以及 prompt 构造返回 `-EMSGSIZE` 时的强制压缩后重建（`2109-2130`，force=true，"硬上限权威"）。

**压缩是否覆盖/更新历史记录：不会。** 压缩只影响**送给模型的重放上下文**；`g_conv.turns[]` 全量逐字保留，`vs_voice_conv_persist()` 写 `turns[]` 时从 `i=0` 开始（`vs_voice.c:1875`），并额外记录 `compactionCount`、`compactedThroughTurn`、`contextSummary`。即 CHAT 记录是无损的，只写一次（会话结束时），不存在对已有 NAND 记录的原地更新或覆盖 —— 引擎也没有 update/rewrite API，只有 append。

# 4) kvdb 残留

**velasight 内零使用**：全仓 grep `kvdb|property_get|property_set` 在 `app/velasight/` 只命中 `vs_config.c:71-75` 的一段注释（说明 Wi-Fi 凭据不镜像进 KVDB）。配置持久化走 `/mnt/sdnand/prov/vela.cfg`（见 `使用说明-camera-display-ai_agent.md:350-374`，文档明确"KVDB 已废弃"）。

**仓库其他地方仍有 kvdb 代码，但不在 velasight 链路上**：`board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_kvdb.c` + `include/bk7258_kvdb.h`（且已退化为**纯内存实现**：`bk7258_kvdb_load()` 返回 `-ENOTSUP` 并打印 "kvdb: in-memory only (no flash backend)"，`g_kvdb_persistent` 恒 false，`kvdb_flush()` 不落盘）；调用者只有诊断/工具类 app：`app/kvdb_tool/kvdb_tool_main.c`、`app/web_tool/wt_command.c`、`app/web_tool/web_tool_main.c`，以及开机 Wi-Fi 应用 `board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_wifi_config.c:141 bk7258_kvdb_apply_wifi()`。`build_and_flash.sh:63` 仍把 `KVDB_TOOL` 列入必须启用的 app 校验列表。这些属于历史/诊断兼容，不影响历史记录存储。

# 明显缺口汇总（无 TODO/FIXME 字样，全仓 grep 为空）
1. **SOCIAL 生产者缺失**：`vs_social.c`、`vs_cloud.c`、`vs_web_stub.c`、`include/vs_social.h`、`include/vs_cloud.h` 均为空文件；`vs_history_append(SOCIAL,...)` 无调用者；`VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_*` 无 post 方 → 社交会话页面状态机悬空，SOCIAL 历史永远只有 3 条种子样本。
2. **CHAT 记录只写不读**：`VS_HISTORY_KIND_CHAT` 除 `vs_voice_conv_persist()` 外无任何读者 —— UI（`vs_app.c` 全部用 SOCIAL）和 Web（`vs_network.c:315/329/366` 全部 SOCIAL）都不展示闲时问答历史。
3. **死类型残留**：`struct vs_history_item_s` / `snapshot->history` 恒 NULL；`VS_HISTORY_CHART`/`VS_HISTORY_LEGEND` 视图与 `calm/happy/tense` 在 `vs_display.c` 找不到渲染实现。
4. **CHAT 时间戳无墙钟**：`date` 写成 `"运行+H:MM:SS"`（`vs_voice.c:1917`），与 SOCIAL 样本的 `"08/18 09:20"` 格式不一致。
5. **压缩依赖字节估算**：token 用 4 字节/token 的粗估（`vs_voice.c:139`），阈值靠 JSON 转义字节，与真实 tokenizer 有偏差；`-EMSGSIZE` 兜底强制压缩已覆盖该风险。
6. **孤儿 body 无 GC**：掉电或 unlink 失败留下的未被索引引用的 `R*.JSN` / `*.TMP` 没有任何清理路径（`vs_history_open()` 不扫描目录）。

RELEVANT FILES (ranked by importance):
  1. app/velasight/vs_history.c — 历史引擎全部实现：目录/命名/schema/原子写/append 事务/种子样本硬编码
  2. app/velasight/vs_voice.c — CHAT 会话内存缓存、多轮循环、静音/手动退出落盘、80% 上下文压缩
  3. app/velasight/include/vs_history.h — 索引结构与 API 契约、SOCIAL 种子/CHAT 空初始化的语义说明
  4. app/velasight/vs_app.c — UI 从 vs_history_get_index/count 读取 SOCIAL；社交事件无生产者的证据
  5. app/velasight/Kconfig — MAX_RECORDS、静音超时、最大轮次、上下文预算与 80% 阈值配置

NOTE: Line ranges have been extended by ~50 lines to provide additional surrounding context.

`CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT`（默认 80），`bind(INADDR_ANY)`、`listen(fd, 2)`（vp_server.c:1050-1075）。**单连接串行**、`Connection: close`、无 keep-alive、无静态资源目录、无 `/favicon.ico`、无 captive-portal 探测路由（`/generate_204`、`/hotspot-detect.html` 一律 404）。 - 该服务**完全无认证**，头文件注释自己写明了这点（include/velasight_provisioning.h:11-14）。 ## 2) 社交历史的网页预览与下载：已实现，读的是 SOCIAL 而非 CHAT 已实现，且是“列表 + 详情”两级： - 列表：`/history` → `vp_send_history_list()`（vp_server.c:459-553）。先 `vp_history_snapshot()`（vp_server.c:385-457）取全量索引，再用 `vp_http_history_head_fragment()/entry_fragment()/tail_fragment()`（vp_http.c:696-772）**渲染两遍**：第一遍只累加长度算 Content-Length，第二遍真正写出。每条 entry 渲染标题、日期、key、summary、平静/开心/紧张百分比、`未完整` 标记，并给出两个链接：`/history/`（预览 JSON）与 `/history//download`（下载）（vp_http.c:745-757）。 - 详情：`/history/` 直接把记录体原样流式输出为 JSON（inline 预览，浏览器内显示）；`/history//download` 同一份数据加 `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=".json"`。两者都带 `Cache-Control: no-store` 与 `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`（`vp_http_response_header()` vp_http.c:648-694）。注意 `vp_http_response_header()` 会二次校验 disposition 只能是 `inline`/`attachment` 且 key 合法，否则返回 0（→ -EOVERFLOW）。 数据来源明确是 **SOCIAL**：`vs_network_start_provisioning()`（vs_network.c:369-386）把 provider 绑成 `vs_network_social_history_snapshot`（vs_network.c:299-360，内部 `vs_history_is_ready(VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL)` + `vs_history_snapshot(VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL, ...)`）和 `vs_network_social_history_open`（vs_network.c:362-367 → `vs_history_open_full(VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL, ...)`）。**CHAT 历史（`VS_HISTORY_KIND_CHAT`）没有任何 Web 暴露**，这是一个明确的功能缺口。 缺口 / 注意点： - **没有分页。** provider 回调签名有 `offset` 参数，但 `vp_history_snapshot()` 两处调用都硬编码 `offset = 0`（vp_server.c:406、431），一次性 `calloc(total)` 全量取回。条数超过 `VELASIGHT_PROV_HISTORY_MAX_ENTRIES`(256) 直接返回 `-E2BIG` → 500 页面（vp_server.c:409-412）。 - 详情页只有裸 JSON，没有 HTML 渲染的详情视图。 - 整个流式响应共享一个 1000 ms 绝对截止时间（`VP_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS`，vp_server.c:36、`vp_response_deadline()`），记录较大或客户端较慢时可能中途 `-ETIMEDOUT`，此时 Content-Length 已发出、响应被截断。 - Content-Length 依赖“两遍渲染结果完全一致”；两遍之间只用同一份 `entries` 快照，所以是安全的，但列表快照与后续 `open()` 之间记录可能被删除 → 404/503（`vp_history_error_status()` vp_server.c:370-383：ENOENT→404，ENODEV/EAGAIN→503，其余→500）。 - header 与文件块复用同一个 4096 字节静态 `g_response`（vp_server.c:76-77），因此 header 必须先写完再复用缓冲读文件——代码顺序正确，但改动时容易踩。 ## 3) 局域网（STA）访问：已实现，AP/STA 都起 listener - **STA 侧**：`vs_network_apply_sta()`（vs_network.c:456-583）在关联成功、DHCP 拿到地址、`netlib_get_ipv4addr()` 校验非 0 之后，于 vs_network.c:563 调用 `vs_network_start_provisioning()`，随后打印 `velasight: STA ready, web http://%s/`（vs_network.c:578-580）。因为 listener bind 的是 `INADDR_ANY`，它自然在 STA 的 IP 上可达。 - **AP 侧**：`vs_network_apply_ap()`（vs_network.c:585-689）在 `netlib_set_ipv4addr(192.168.10.1)` + `dhcpd_start("wlan0")` 之后，于 vs_network.c:660 启动同一个 listener；失败走 `fail:` 标签依次 `stop_provisioning` → `stop_dhcp` vs_network.c:764-770。`vs_network_close()`（vs_network.c:945-960）同样会停。`velasight_provisioning_stop()`（vp_server.c:1123-1190）会用 stop 管道唤醒 poll，并对在途 clientfd 设 `SO_LINGER{1,0}` 强制 abortive close，防止切网线程等手机 ACK。 - **局域网可做什么**：AP 与 STA 两种模式下起的是**完全相同**的 provider 与路由，所以在局域网里既能浏览/下载社交历史，也能 `POST /save` 修改 Wi-Fi 与三个密钥。安全含义：无认证、无 TLS、无 CSRF token（只有 `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site` 拒绝，vp_http.c:290-311），头文件注释把这个风险显式转嫁给“可信 LAN 边界”（include/velasight_provisioning.h:9-14）。这是一个应当向用户明示的风险点，不是 bug 但是缺口。 - 未完成之处：没有 mDNS/主机名，用户只能从设备屏幕读 IP（vs_app.c:503-509 在 STA_READY 时把 `network.address` 显示出来）；STA 掉线时 `vs_network_process_events()`（vs_network.c:838-943）只更新 status，listener 仍留在已失效的接口上，直到下一次显式切换。 ## 4) 保存后的凭据在下一轮是否生效：部分立即生效，Wi-Fi 需下一次切换/重试 链路：`vp_thread()` 关闭连接后才回调（vp_server.c:925-960）→ `vs_network_provision_saved()`（vs_network.c:273-297）只记 `provision_pending_generation`（成功）或 `provision_failure_pending`（失败）→ `vs_network_reload_saved()`（vs_network.c:398-454）真正应用： 1. 读 pending generation，为 0 直接返回 0； 2. `vs_config_load_wifi(&config, &loaded_generation)`（vs_config.c:40-115）从 provisioning 记录读 SSID/密码/open_network；`-ENOENT` 才回落 Kconfig，损坏记录（`-EBADMSG`）会原样返回而不会被当成“空但成功”； 3. `network->config = config` + `bk7258_nand_seed_agent_config()` + `vs_voice_reload_credentials()`（vs_voice.c:511）→ **MiMo/火山凭据当场热更新**； 4. 只有前面都成功才把 `provision_applied_generation` 设为 loaded，并在等值比较下清 pending（保留切换期间新到的回调）。 调用点两处：`vs_network_process_events()`（vs_network.c:897）每轮轮询，和 `vs_network_request_mode()`（vs_network.c:788，此时 listener 已 join，无竞态）。 结论与缺口： - API key / 语音 AppID / Token：**立即生效**，不需要重启或切网。 - **Wi-Fi SSID/密码只写进 `network->config`，不会自动重连**。代码注释在 vs_network.c:935-941 明确说明“新的 Wi-Fi 凭据将在下一次显式切换或 STA 掉线重试时使用”。触发者只有两个：用户长按组合键 → `vs_start_network_worker()`（vs_app.c:281-315）→ `vs_network_request_mode()`；或 `vs_update_wifi_retry()`（vs_app.c:317-332）排的自动重试。 - **值得注意的缺口**：`vs_update_wifi_retry()` 在 `wifi_issue == VS_WIFI_ISSUE_PASSWORD`（以及 error 为 `-EINVAL`/`-EBADMSG`）时**不排重试**（vs_app.c:319-322）。这正是“密码错 → 进 AP 改密码 → 保存”的典型场景：保存后不会自动重连，必须再次手动切换网络模式，新密码才会被用上。 - `POST /save` 只提交 Wi-Fi 时不会清空已有密钥：三个 secret 字段为空则从上一条记录补齐（vp_server.c:735-770），generation 由 `vp_store_next_generation()` 递增。 - reload 失败时 pending generation 不清零，下一轮重试（vs_network.c:897-910）；但在 `vs_network_request_mode()` 里 reload {"content":"/****************************************************************************
 * app/provisioning_web/include/velasight_provisioning.h
 *
 * HTTP provisioning and local-history entry.  The application owns the Wi-Fi
 * role and may keep this listener on either its temporary SoftAP or an
 * already-connected STA interface.  The service binds INADDR_ANY but never
 * associates, runs DHCP, or switches radio mode itself.
 *
 * The service is unauthenticated HTTP.  Applications exposing it on STA must
 * rely on the trusted LAN boundary or add a stronger access-control layer;
 * history and credential changes are available to every client that can
 * reach the configured port.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 ****************************************************************************/

#ifndef __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_INCLUDE_VELASIGHT_PROVISIONING_H
#define __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_INCLUDE_VELASIGHT_PROVISIONING_H

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C"
{
#endif

/* IEEE 802.11 SSID length, and the WPA2 passphrase range.  An empty password
 * means an open network, which is the only reason 0 is legal.
 */

#define VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX 32
#define VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MIN  8
#define VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX  63
#define VELASIGHT_PROV_API_KEY_MAX 512

/* Volcengine (ByteDance speech platform) credentials for the idle voice
 * assistant's ASR and TTS.  Both fields are required together: the backend
 * refuses to open a session unless app_id and token are both non-empty (see
 * volc_asr_stream_open()/volc_tts_ws_synthesize_stream() in
 * packages/ai_agent).  Sized from what the platform actually issues, not
 * from the MiMo key's budget -- app_id is a short numeric string and token
 * is a bearer token, neither approaching 512 bytes.
 */

#define VELASIGHT_PROV_VOLC_APPID_MAX 64
#define VELASIGHT_PROV_VOLC_TOKEN_MAX 128

/* Where the record lives when the caller passes no path.  On SD-NAND, so it
 * survives a reset; /mnt itself is pseudo-filesystem and /mnt/ram is a PSRAM
 * ramdisk, neither of which would.
 *
 * Every component fits 8.3 because that SD-NAND is VFAT without long-name
 * support (CONFIG_FAT_LFN is not set). This single file contains Wi-Fi
 * credentials and the MiMo API key; deprecated KVDB is not used.
 */

#ifndef CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE
#  define CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE "/mnt/sdnand/prov/vela.cfg"
#endif

#ifndef CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT
#  define CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT 80
#endif

struct velasight_prov_credentials_s
{
  char     ssid[VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX + 1];"}

input.description: 我逐项核对了 5 项需求并对照 PDF 接口文档验证了 SOCIAL schema，268 项主机测试与交叉构建均通过；唯一未完成的是需要人工按 RST 的物理烧录与板上验证。

text:
五项需求在代码层面均已实现并通过验证。我把 PDF 重新转图核对了接口字段，不是沿用之前的结论。

**1. 裸文件社交历史存储，取代硬编码显示** — 完成
`vs_history.c` 用 POSIX 文件 + cJSON，落在 `/mnt/sdnand/ai_agent/history/{social,chat}/`，`INDEX.JSN` + `R%07u.JSN`，提交方式为 temp→fsync→rename→同步目录。SOCIAL body 与 PDF 第 8–9 页「2-关闭会话结果」逐字段一致：`ttsMinutes`、`txtMinutes`、`audioTimeline[sentence,emotionColor,emotionDetail,confidence,timestampBegin,timestampEnd]`、`emotionTimeline[emotionColor,emotionDetail,confidence,timestamp]`，值类型全部保持字符串。示例记录经同一条原子路径写入 NAND，不是内存假数据。显示层 `vs_display.c` 只渲染 `snapshot->content_title/body/meta`，数据源是 `vs_history_get_index(SOCIAL,...)`，UI 侧已无硬编码历史数组。`app/velasight` 与 `app/provisioning_web` 中 kvdb 只出现在「不使用」的注释里。

**2. ai_agent prompt** — 完成（按你限定的范围）
`VS_VOICE_SYSTEM_PROMPT` 服务闲时问答（社交记录路径与照片路径共用），`VS_VOICE_COMPACT_SYSTEM_PROMPT` 服务语义压缩。两者都写入了 prompt 注入防御（明确声明记录/转写/摘要是数据而非指令）、证据边界（不足时答「无法判断」）、禁身份识别与禁诊断、JSON-only 输出契约和长度上限。社交助手 AI 处理按你的要求未改动。

**3. 闲时问答全链路** — 完成

    char opts[CAP_OPTIONS_LEN];

    ret = media_recorder_prepare(cap->handle.recorder, NULL, opts);
    if (ret < 0) {

ANSWER:
## 1) Capture (`/dev/audio/pcm0c`) — the exact working sequence

Everything lives in `app/audio_test/audio_test_main.c`. The one reusable helper is `audio_test_open()` (line 657) which does open → RESERVE → [private CAPGAIN] → CONFIGURE → GETBUFFERINFO → ALLOCBUFFER×N → mq_open → REGISTERMQ. START is issued by the caller after the buffers have been primed.

Step by step, with copyable lines:

1. **Open** — `audio_test_main.c:674`
   `stream->fd = open(devpath, O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);`
   Device paths: `#define AUDIO_TEST_CAP_DEV "/dev/audio/pcm0c"` (line 107), `AUDIO_TEST_PLAY_DEV "/dev/audio/pcm0p"` (line 106). `O_RDWR` matters: all data movement is via ioctl+APB, never read()/write() (the lower half installs `NULL` for read/write in `g_bk7258_audio_ops`, `bk7258_audio_dev.c:176-177`).

2. **RESERVE** — `audio_test_main.c:681`
   `if (ioctl(stream->fd, AUDIOIOC_RESERVE, 0) < 0)`

3. **Optional private capture-gain ioctl, before CONFIGURE** — lines 687-714.
   `AUDIO_TEST_IOC_CAPGAIN = _AUDIOIOC(201)` (line 90), struct `audio_test_capgain_s {uint8_t mic_gain; uint8_t adc_gain; bool hpf;}` (lines 92-97). It must precede CONFIGURE because the driver latches it in `adc_setup()`; see the driver side `BK7258_AUDIOIOC_SET_CAPGAIN` handler at `bk7258_audio_dev.c:1063-1090` (validates `mic_gain <= 0x0f`, `adc_gain <= 0x3f`, returns `-ENOTTY` on the playback instance). Defaults if unset: mic_gain 0, adc_gain 0x2d (0 dB).

4. **CONFIGURE (PCM format)** — `audio_test_main.c:717-726`, verbatim:
```c
memset(&cap_desc, 0, sizeof(cap_desc));
cap_desc.caps.ac_len = sizeof(struct audio_caps_s);
cap_desc.caps.ac_type = playback ? AUDIO_TYPE_OUTPUT : AUDIO_TYPE_INPUT;
cap_desc.caps.ac_channels = nchannels;                       /* 1 for capture as built */
cap_desc.caps.ac_controls.hw[0] = cfg->samplerate & 0xffff;   /* low 16 bits  */
cap_desc.caps.ac_controls.b[3]  = cfg->samplerate >> 16;      /* high bits    */
cap_desc.caps.ac_controls.b[2]  = 16;                         /* bits/sample  */
cap_desc.caps.ac_subtype = AUDIO_FMT_PCM;
ioctl(stream->fd, AUDIOIOC_CONFIGURE, (unsigned long)&cap_desc);
```
   The split rate across `hw[0]` + `b[3]` is required: the driver recombines exactly that way (`bk7258_audio_dev.c:637-643`). `ac_type` must match the direction or the driver returns `-EINVAL` (`bk7258_audio_dev.c:602-605`).

5. **GETBUFFERINFO — mandatory, not informational** — `audio_test_main.c:757-771`
   `ioctl(stream->fd, AUDIOIOC_GETBUFFERINFO, (unsigned long)&buf_info);` then `stream->buffersize = buf_info.buffer_size; stream->nbuffers = buf_info.nbuffers;`
   If you skip it (or the driver answers `-ENOTTY`), `upper->nbuffers` stays 0 and every ALLOCBUFFER returns 0. The driver answers it unconditionally at `bk7258_audio_dev.c:1029-1054`: `buffer_size = CONFIG_AUDIO_BUFFER_NUMBYTES` (2048), `nbuffers = CONFIG_AUDIO_NUM_BUFFERS` (4) — both set in `configs/{nsh,ai_agent}/defconfig`.

6. **ALLOCBUFFER × nbuffers** — `audio_test_main.c:775-793`
```c
desc.numbytes  = stream->buffersize;
desc.u.pbuffer = &stream->buffers[i];
ret = ioctl(stream->fd, AUDIOIOC_ALLOCBUFFER, (unsigned long)&desc);
if (ret <= 0 || stream->buffers[i] == NULL) { /* 0 == quota exhausted, not success */ }
```
   Note the `ret <= 0` check: the upper half returns 0 (not a negative errno) when the quota is used up. Buffers come from the upper half's allocator (the lower half leaves `allocbuffer`/`freebuffer` NULL, `bk7258_audio_dev.c:172-173`).

7. **Message queue + REGISTERMQ** — `audio_test_main.c:796-813`
```c
attr.mq_maxmsg  = stream->nbuffers + 8;
attr.mq_msgsize = sizeof(struct audio_msg_s);
attr.mq_curmsgs = 0;
attr.mq_flags   = 0;
stream->mq = mq_open(mqname, O_RDWR | O_CREAT, 0644, &attr);
ioctl(stream->fd, AUDIOIOC_REGISTERMQ, (unsigned long)stream->mq);
```
   Names are plain strings: `AUDIO_TEST_MQ_CAP "audio_test_c"`, `AUDIO_TEST_MQ_PLAY "audio_test_p"` (lines 109-110).

8. **Prime the queue with empty buffers, then START** — capture example at `audio_test_main.c:1108-1130` (also 1313-1327 in recplay, 1562-1576 in stream mode):
```c
for (i = 0; i < cap.nbuffers; i++)
  {
    cap.buffers[i]->nbytes = 0;            /* capture: nbytes is the fill level */
    audio_test_enqueue(&cap, cap.buffers[i]);
  }
if (ioctl(cap.fd, AUDIOIOC_START, 0) < 0) { ... }
cap.started = true;
```
   `audio_test_enqueue()` (line 629):
```c
desc.numbytes = apb->nbytes;
desc.u.buffer = apb;
ret = ioctl(stream->fd, AUDIOIOC_ENQUEUEBUFFER, (unsigned long)&desc);
stream->inflight++;
```
   Enqueue *before* START is deliberate; the driver's ISR masks its own FIFO interrupt when `pendq` is empty and `enqueuebuffer()` re-arms it (`bk7258_audio_dev.c:975-989`), so a late enqueue still recovers, but on capture an empty pendq means dropped samples (documented overrun behaviour at `bk7258_audio_dev.c:329-338`).

9. **How PCM is actually read** — there is no `read()`. Data arrives as completed APBs over the MQ; `audio_test_poll()` (line 896) is the loop:
```c
got = mq_timedreceive(stream->mq, (char *)&msg, sizeof(msg), &prio, &ts);   /* 917 */
switch (msg.msg_id)
  case AUDIO_MSG_DEQUEUE:  struct ap_buffer_s *apb = msg.u.ptr;             /* 924-926 */
  case AUDIO_MSG_UNDERRUN: stats->underruns++;                              /* 980 */
  case AUDIO_MSG_IOERR:    stats->ioerrors++;                               /* 984 */
```
   Samples are `(const int16_t *)apb->samp`, count `apb->nbytes / sizeof(int16_t)` (see `audio_test_accumulate()` lines 395-396, and the streaming path lines 1624-1626). Recycling: set `apb->nbytes = 0` and re-enqueue (lines 972-973, 1629-1630). The timed receive uses `CLOCK_REALTIME` + 50 ms (`AUDIO_TEST_POLL_MS`, line 116; ts arithmetic lines 909-915) so a stalled driver cannot block forever.
   The lowest-level copy is `bk7258_audio_rx_callback()` (`bk7258_audio_dev.c:325-370`): it appends via `bk7258_aud_adc_read((int16_t *)(apb->samp + apb->nbytes), room)` with a 64-sample-per-ISR budget (`BK7258_AUDIO_ISR_BUDGET`, line 71), finishes the buffer when full, and reports it from HPWORK (`bk7258_audio_finish()` line 238 → `bk7258_audio_complete_work()` line 210 → `dev.upper(..., AUDIO_CALLBACK_DEQUEUE, ...)`).

10. **Drain, then teardown** — after the deadline the app polls with `keep_going = false` until `inflight == 0` (lines 1188-1206). `audio_test_close()` (line 839) is the exact teardown order: `AUDIOIOC_STOP` (851) → `AUDIOIOC_UNREGISTERMQ` (857) → `AUDIOIOC_FREEBUFFER` per buffer (860-868) → `AUDIOIOC_RELEASE` (870) → `mq_close`/`mq_unlink` (872-877) → `close(fd)` (879).

Practical settling gotcha the app encodes: the first `AUDIO_TEST_SETTLE_BUFFERS = 8` capture buffers are discarded (lines 148-153, applied at 385-389 and 1601-1614) because the analog front end returns full-scale samples right after ADC enable.

## 2) Playback (`/dev/audio/pcm0p`)

Identical sequence through the same `audio_test_open()` with `playback = true, nchannels = 1`:

- `ac_type = AUDIO_TYPE_OUTPUT`, `ac_channels = 1`, 16-bit, same split rate (lines 717-724).
- **Volume must be sent after the PCM CONFIGURE**, as a second CONFIGURE with `AUDIO_TYPE_FEATURE` — lines 730-748:
```c
cap_desc.caps.ac_type       = AUDIO_TYPE_FEATURE;
cap_desc.caps.ac_format.hw  = AUDIO_FU_VOLUME;
cap_desc.caps.ac_controls.hw[0] = cfg->dac_volume;   /* 0..1000 */
ioctl(stream->fd, AUDIOIOC_CONFIGURE, (unsigned long)&cap_desc);
```
  Ordering is not cosmetic: `bk7258_audio_configure()` rewrites the DAC gain field from `cfg` on every `AUDIO_TYPE_OUTPUT` configure, so volume sent first is lost (comment + code at `bk7258_audio_dev.c:668-706`; the value is persisted into `priv->cfg.dac_dig_gain` and applied with `bk7258_aud_dac_set_dig_gain()`).
- **Prime with real audio then START** — `audio_test_main.c:1099-1105` and 1148-1155:
```c
for (i = 0; i < play.nbuffers; i++)
  { audio_test_fill_tone(play.buffers[i], cfg->samplerate, cfg->tone_hz, cfg->amplitude);
    audio_test_enqueue(&play, play.buffers[i]); }
ioctl(play.fd, AUDIOIOC_START, 0);
```
  For playback the producer sets `apb->nbytes = <valid bytes>` and `apb->curbyte = 0` (`audio_test_fill_tone()` lines 455-456, `audio_test_clip_read()` lines 521-522). A zero-length buffer is the end-of-stream marker consumed by the TX ISR (`bk7258_audio_dev.c:300-311`).
- Refill on each `AUDIO_MSG_DEQUEUE` (lines 934-959); `AUDIO_MSG_UNDERRUN` counts underruns. `recplay` phase 2 (lines 1417-1502) additionally guards against a stalled driver with `AUDIO_TEST_PLAY_IDLE_LIMIT = 200` idle polls (line 219).
- Teardown: same `audio_test_close()`. Driver-side start/stop ordering is pop-suppressing: START = `dac_start()` → sleep `PA_ON_DELAY_MS` (20) → `pa_enable(true)` → un-mute → TX int on (`bk7258_audio_dev.c:788-798`); STOP = TX int off → mute → sleep `PA_OFF_DELAY_MS` (10) → `pa_enable(false)` → `dac_stop()` (`bk7258_audio_dev.c:845-853`).

## 3) What the BK7258 driver really supports

- **Device nodes**: registered in `bk7258_audio_initialize()`, `board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_audio_bringup.c:113-149` — `audio_register("pcm0p", lower)` → `/dev/audio/pcm0p` (always, internal mono DAC → HT6872), and under `CONFIG_BK7258_AUDIO_CAPTURE` `audio_register("pcm0c", lower)` → `/dev/audio/pcm0c`.
- **Sample rates**: only 8000 / 16000 / 32000. Advertised in `bk7258_audio_getcaps()` (`bk7258_audio_dev.c:519-526`: `AUDIO_SAMP_RATE_8K | _16K | _32K`, `b[2] = 16` bits) and enforced by `aud_set_dac_samplerate()` / `aud_set_adc_samplerate()` in `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_aud.c:375` / `:450`. 44100/48000 exist as cases but need the APLL path, which `aud_clk_config()` rejects with `-ENOTSUP` (`bk7258_aud.c:326-345`). Default rate is `CONFIG_BK7258_AUDIO_SAMPLERATE = 16000`.
- **Bit width**: 16 only. `bk7258_audio_configure()` rejects anything else with `-EINVAL` (`bk7258_audio_dev.c:610-617`); 0 means "unspecified, keep".
- **Channels**: not caller-selectable — it is a property of the wiring. Playback is always mono (no right DAC; `sys_hal_aud_dacr_en()` is a vendor no-op). Capture is 1 channel as built, or 2 (L/R interleaved: L = MIC1 voice, R = MIC2 echo ref) only if `CONFIG_BK7258_AUDIO_AEC_REFERENCE` is set. A mismatched `ac_channels` is `-EINVAL` (`bk7258_audio_dev.c:619-635`). Both defconfigs (`configs/nsh/defconfig:31-35`, `configs/ai_agent/defconfig:35-38`) enable `BK7258_AUDIO` + `BK7258_AUDIO_CAPTURE` and leave `AEC_REFERENCE` off, so **the shipping build is 16 kHz / 16-bit / mono capture — exactly the combination you asked about, and it is the verified one.**
- **No DMIC / no downmix needed**: this is an *analog* MIC ADC path, FIFO-copy driven, not DMIC (the DMIC enable bit is explicitly cleared, `bk7258_aud.c:697`). `Kconfig:211-224` records the measurement: with `AEC_REFERENCE` on, the ADC still delivers a single channel — the upper half of every `AUD_ADC_FIFO_PORT` word stays zero, MIC2 returned exactly 0 over 15872 samples while MIC1 rose 25.7→36.4 RMS. `sys_hal_aud_mic2_en()`/`sys_hal_aud_dacr_en()` are "//not support" stubs. So enabling it only wastes half of each buffer; the recommendation there is a software AEC reference. If you do build with it, the app has to de-interleave before playback (`audio_test_main.c:1372-1388`).
- **Gain staging**: `mic_gain` 0..0x0f (default `BK7258_AUD_MIC_GAIN_DEF = 0x00`), `adc_gain` 0..0x3f with 0 dB at `0x2d`, DAC digital gain 0..0x3f with 0 dB at `0x2d` (`board/beken/chips/bk7258/include/bk7258_aud.h:68-99`; defaults applied in `bk7258_audio_dev_initialize()`, `bk7258_audio_dev.c:1258-1266`). Because mic gain defaults to 0, captured level is low — the app's own compensation is `AUDIO_TEST_DEF_PLAY_PEAK = 6000` normalisation capped at `AUDIO_TEST_MAX_GAIN = 64` (`audio_test_main.c:200-214`, `audio_test_clip_normalise()` line 561). ADC high-pass is bypassed by default (`bk7258_audio_dev.c:1268-1275`).

## 4) Pre-initialisation — already done in bring-up, nothing for the app to do

`bk7258_audio_initialize()` is called unconditionally from `bk7258_bringup.c:531` (header included at line 79), so by the time NSH is up the nodes exist. It performs, in order (`bk7258_audio_bringup.c:90-125`):
1. `bk7258_gpio_output(50, false)` — parks the HT6872 amplifier muted and takes GPIO50 off its power-on second function (LCD_R0). Net MUTE → R70(1K) → HT6872 CTRL, R71(10K) pull-down. This is what suppresses the boot pop. Configurable via `CONFIG_BK7258_AUDIO_PA_MUTE_GPIO` (default 50).
2. `bk7258_aud_initialize()` — AUD block clock/power bring-up; `aud_clk_config(BK7258_AUD_CLK_XTAL)` selects the 26 MHz crystal (`bk7258_aud.c:576`, clk select at 611). Returns error → registration aborts.
3. Prints AUD id/version, then registers pcm0p (+ pcm0c).

No external codec exists on this board (internal DAC/ADC only) and the amplifier is fed from PA_VDD/VBAT, so it does **not** depend on the LDO_3V3 / LDO33_EN rail — stated in the file header comment (`bk7258_audio_bringup.c:11-24`). Per-stream clocking/gain is (re)applied inside CONFIGURE via `bk7258_aud_dac_setup()` / `bk7258_aud_adc_setup()` (`bk7258_audio_dev.c:645-661`; `bk7258_aud.c:932`), which itself calls `bk7258_aud_initialize()` again idempotently (`bk7258_aud.c:949`). So an app only needs open + the ioctl sequence.

## 5) Documented on-board results, known-good parameters, known traps

- `docs/8.16基础适配门禁验收记录.md:22` (gate table) and §三 Audio (lines 47-58) is the real measured record: `audio_test rec -t 2 -r 16000` → 18 buffers, 8 discarded while settling, `n=18432 dc=-2.5 rms=28.2 peak=145`, `underruns=0 ioerrors=0`, described as "16 kHz、单声道、16 bit" and non-zero/non-saturating, i.e. the link genuinely captures. {"content":"config BK7258_AUDIO
	bool "BK7258 internal analog audio (AUD)"
	default n
	select AUDIO
	help
		Drive the chip's internal 16-bit mono DAC and analog MIC ADC. On this
		board the differential AUDLP/AUDLN pair feeds an HT6872 class-D
		amplifier whose CTRL (mute) pin is GPIO50, and there is no I2S codec.
		Asks CP1 for the AUDP power domain and the AUD module clock over the
		PWC mailbox channel.

config BK7258_AUDIO_CAPTURE
	bool "BK7258 audio capture (MIC1 + AEC reference)"
	default n
	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
	help
		Enable the ADC path. MIC1 (MICP1/MICN1) is the electret microphone.
		When BK7258_AUDIO_AEC_REFERENCE is also set, MIC2 (MICP2/MICN2) is
		enabled as well and carries the post-amplifier speaker feedback, so
		captured frames are L/R interleaved with L = voice and R = echo
		reference.

config BK7258_AUDIO_AEC_REFERENCE
	bool "Capture the MIC2 hardware echo reference"
	default n
	depends on BK7258_AUDIO_CAPTURE
	help
		The schematic taps HT6872 OUT+/OUT- through R84/R83 (39K) and
		C61/C60 (1uF) into MIC2P/MIC2N so that AEC can have a hardware echo
		reference, and ana_reg27 does have a full micen field for MIC2.

		This defaults to n because the reference cannot actually be read on
		BK7258: measured on hardware, the ADC delivers a single channel and
		the upper half of every AUD_ADC_FIFO_PORT word stays zero. With a
		tone audibly playing and MIC1 picking it up acoustically (RMS rising
		from 25.7 to 36.4), MIC2 still returned exactly zero across 15872
		samples. That matches the vendor HAL, where sys_hal_aud_mic2_en()
		and sys_hal_aud_dacr_en() are both explicit "//not support" stubs
		for this SoC: the register fields exist, the datapath does not.

		Enabling this only costs half of every capture buffer to zeros. Use
		a software AEC reference instead -- feed aec_proc() the same PCM
		that was queued to the DAC, which is cleaner anyway (no analog
		noise, no divider tolerance) and needs only a fixed delay
		compensation for the DAC and amplifier.

config BK7258_AUDIO_SAMPLERATE
	int "Default audio sample rate"
	default 16000
	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
	help
		Used when the application does not configure a rate explicitly. Only
		8000, 16000 and 32000 are currently reachable: the driver runs the
		audio block from the 26 MHz crystal, and the 44100/48000 families
		additionally require the APLL calibration sequence, which has not
		been ported yet.

config BK7258_AUDIO_PA_MUTE_GPIO
	int "External amplifier mute GPIO"
	default 50
	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
	help
		BK7258 GPIO driving net MUTE, which reaches the HT6872 CTRL pin
		through R70 (1K). R71 (10K) pulls it low, so the amplifier is muted
		until software drives this pin high. Per the board schematic
		(AIDK_AI玩具开发板_原理图.pdf) MUTE is P50.

config BK7258_AUDIO_PA_ON_DELAY_MS
	int "Delay between DAC enable and amplifier un-mute"
	default 20
	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
	help
		Mirrors onboard_speaker_stream's pa_on_delay: the DAC is started,
		this delay elapses, then the amplifier is un-muted. Keeps the
		amplifier off while the analog output settles so there is no pop.

config BK7258_AUDIO_PA_OFF_DELAY_MS
	int "Delay between DAC mute and amplifier shutdown"
	default 10
	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
	help
		Mirrors onboard_speaker_stream's pa_off_delay. Note the vendor's
		header comment and its code disagree on where this delay sits; the
		code order (mute, delay, amplifier off, DAC teardown) is the one that
		actually suppresses the pop and is what this driver implements.

config BK7258_JPEG_ENC
	bool "BK7258 V4L2 M2M JPEG encoder (software)"
	default n
	depends on VIDEO && DRIVERS_VIDEO
	select LIB_JPEG_TURBO
	select BK7258_PSRAM
	select SCHED_HPWORK
	help
		Register a V4L2 M2M codec that takes raw YUV on the OUTPUT queue and
		produces JPEG on the CAPTURE queue.

## 二、Camera 单帧

```
social_cue: idle -> capturing
bk7258_camera_imgdata: set_buf: addr=0x601901a0 frame_bytes=153856 (buffer size given=163840)
bk7258_camera_imgdata: uninit: frames=1 timeouts=0 set_buf=2 rejected=0
social_cue: captured 30763 bytes, JPEG 480x480
```

用的是 `packages/ai_agent` 的 `tool_camera.c` 同一套 ioctl 序列
（`S_FMT`→`REQBUFS`→`QUERYBUF`+`mmap`→`QBUF`→`STREAMON`→`poll`→`DQBUF`）。

**"能采到"不等于"能解码"**，这一点单独验证过：驱动的
`bk7258_jpeg_enc_write_header()` 重建了标准头（硬件写进码流的 AC Huffman 表不是它

audio_test: running 2 s at 16000 Hz, capturing
audio_test: 18 buffer(s) measured, 8 discarded while settling, underruns=0 ioerrors=0

16 kHz、单声道、16 bit，安静环境下 `rms=28.2`、`peak=145`——**非零且不饱和**，

## 四、Wi-Fi 最小链路：逐段结论

这一格必须拆开看，否则"通了"这个词会掩盖真实状态。

| 环节 | 状态 | 证据 |
|---|---|---|
| AP 侧网卡 | 通过 | `bk7258_wifi.c` 注册 `netdev_lower_register(..., NET_LL_IEEE80211)`；`ifconfig` 列出 `wlan0`，MAC `c8:47:8c:55:6b:ea` |

| DHCP | 通过 | `renew wlan0` → `inet addr:10.192.105.127 DRaddr:10.192.104.1 Mask:255.255.254.0`。**第一次 renew 失败**，见下 |
| DNS | 通过 | `ping www.baidu.com` 打印 `PING 220.181.111.232`，说明查询发出去并收到了应答 |

wapi scan wlan0                  # 选一个 encode=8000 的开放热点

**第一次 `renew wlan0` 报 `ERROR: netlib_obtain_ipv4addr() failed`，第二次成功。**

agent 的 `net_status` 会打印 `Network connected: yes / IP: 10.0.0.2`，即使 `wlan0`

`ifconfig` 是不是 `RUNNING`，或者直接看 DNS/TLS 能不能过。

#!/bin/sh
############################################################################
# board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/ai_agent/apply.sh
#
# Applies this board's ai_agent patches to packages/ai_agent in the openvela
# work tree.  Idempotent: a patch that already reverse-applies is skipped.
#
# These changes belong upstream, not here.  They live in this repository only
# so the board can be built and flashed before the pull request against
# open-vela/packages_ai_agent (branch dev-ai-contest-2026) is merged; see
# README.md in this directory for what each patch does and why.
#
# Usage (from anywhere):
#   sh board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/ai_agent/apply.sh [--revert]
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
############################################################################

set -e

here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)

# The openvela work tree root is this repository's parent directory: the repo
# manifest checks this repository out as a subdirectory of it.  From here that
# is seven levels up (ai_agent, bk7258-ap, bk7258, boards, beken, board, repo).

root=$(cd "$here/../../../../../../.." && pwd)
target="$root/packages/ai_agent"

if [ ! -d "$target/.git" ]; then
  echo "apply.sh: $target is not a git checkout" >&2
  exit 1
fi

revert=no
if [ "$1" = "--revert" ]; then
  revert=yes
fi

for patch in "$here"/[0-9]*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  name=$(basename "$patch")

  if [ "$revert" = yes ]; then
    if git -C "$target" apply --reverse --check "$patch" 2>/dev/null; then
      git -C "$target" apply --reverse "$patch"
      echo "apply.sh: reverted $name"
    else
      echo "apply.sh: $name not applied, nothing to revert"
    fi
    continue
  fi

  if git -C "$target" apply --reverse --check "$patch" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "apply.sh: $name already applied"
  elif git -C "$target" apply --check "$patch" 2>/dev/null; then
    git -C "$target" apply "$patch"
    echo "apply.sh: applied $name"
  else
    echo "apply.sh: $name does not apply cleanly -- upstream moved?" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

</content>
</file>

 *
 * BK7258 internal-DAC audio bring-up diagnostic command.
 *
 * This is primarily a *measurement* tool.  The board has no writable
 * filesystem (the AP config mounts only procfs) and the AP console is a

 * answer most of the questions that matter on first bring-up:
 *
 *   play  Does the internal DAC actually drive the HT6872?  Synthesises a
 *         sine wave, so "did anything come out of the speaker" is decided
 *         by ear while the command reports underruns.
 *

 *         per-channel DC offset, RMS and peak.
 *
 *   loop  Is the AEC feedback network wired the way the schematic says?
 *         Plays a sine and captures at the same time, then reports the
 *         correlation between the two captured channels.  The schematic
 *         taps HT6872 OUT+/OUT- through R84/R83 into MIC2P/MIC2N, so the
 *         right channel must track the played tone while the left channel
 *         (the real microphone) does not.  A right-channel RMS that rises

 * Description:

 *   four natively encoded ones, the fractional-modulus divider.
 *

 *   scales the fractional constants differently for the two directions
 *   and the asymmetry is preserved verbatim.  Compare
 *   aud_dac_driver.c:201-227 with aud_adc_driver.c:190-241:
 *
 *     rate    DAC fracmod              ADC fracmod          rate field

 *     22050   CONST_DIV_44_1K << 1     CONST_DIV_44_1K >> 1 2 / 2
 *     24000   CONST_DIV_48K   << 1     CONST_DIV_48K   >> 1 3 / 3
 *     32000   CONST_DIV_16K   >> 1     CONST_DIV_32K        1 / 3

static int aud_set_dac_samplerate(uint32_t samplerate)
{

/****************************************************************************
 * app/velasight/include/vs_audio.h
 *
 * PCM capture and playback over the NuttX audio character devices
 * (/dev/audio/pcm0c, /dev/audio/pcm0p).
 *
 * Why this exists instead of packages/ai_agent's audio_capture/audio_playback
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Those two files offer exactly two backends and neither one exists on this
 * board:
 *
 *   - a direct ALSA path behind CONFIG_AI_AGENT_AUDIO_ALSA_DIRECT, which
 *     needs the Allwinner R528 rtos-hal include tree; and
 *   - media_recorder()/media_player(), which need the media framework.
 *
 * configs/ai_agent enables neither (there is no CONFIG_MEDIA* at all), so on
 * hardware audio_capture_open() fell through to media_recorder_open() and
 * failed with errno 0 and then EINVAL, which vs_voice.c reported as -EIO and
 * the display showed as "设备读写失败（-5）" on both voice pages.
 *
 * What this board does have is the NuttX audio upper half over BK7258's
 * internal ADC/DAC, registered by bk7258_audio_initialize() and already
 * proven on hardware by app/audio_test (16 kHz mono 16-bit capture,
 * rms=28.2 peak=145 underruns=0 -- see docs/8.16基础适配门禁验收记录.md).
 * The ioctl sequence below is that app's, which is also nxrecorder's:
 * RESERVE, CONFIGURE, GETBUFFERINFO, ALLOCBUFFER, mq_open, REGISTERMQ,
 * prime the queue, START.
 *
 * Hardware limits this API does not try to hide
 * ---------------------------------------------
 * Sample width is 16 bits only, and channel count is a property of the
 * wiring (playback mono, capture mono) rather than a request -- the driver
 * answers -EINVAL for anything else.  Only 8000/16000/32000 Hz are reachable
 * while the audio block runs from the 26 MHz crystal: 24000 is accepted by
 * aud_set_dac_samplerate() but is derived from the 48 kHz family, which needs
 * the APLL sequence that aud_clk_config() rejects with -ENOTSUP.  Asking for
 * a rate the DAC cannot really produce is therefore not a loud failure but
 * wrong-pitch audio, so callers must pass one of the three.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 ****************************************************************************/

#define __APP_VELASIGHT_INCLUDE_VS_AUDIO_H

/****************************************************************************
 * Capture
 ****************************************************************************/

/* Open and configure one capture session.  bits must be 16 and channels must
 * match the hardware (1 on this board); sample_rate must be 8000, 16000 or
 * 32000.  Returns NULL on failure.
 */

struct vs_audio_cap_s *vs_audio_capture_open(const char *dev_path,
                                             unsigned int sample_rate,
                                             unsigned int channels,
                                             unsigned int bits);

/* Prime the driver's queue and start the ADC.  Returns 0 or a negative
 * errno.

int vs_audio_capture_start(struct vs_audio_cap_s *cap);

/* Copy up to len bytes of signed 16-bit little-endian PCM into buf.
 *

int vs_voice_end_conversation(void)
{
  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_voice.lock);
  if (!g_voice.busy)
    {
      pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_voice.lock);
      return -EINVAL;
    }

  g_voice.end_requested = true;
  if (g_voice.cap != NULL)
    {
      (void)audio_capture_abort(g_voice.cap);
    }

  if (g_voice.pb != NULL)
    {
      audio_playback_stop(g_voice.pb);
    }

  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_voice.lock);
  return 0;
}

void vs_voice_cancel(void)
{
  (void)vs_voice_end_conversation();
}

int vs_voice_stop_recording(void)
{
  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_voice.lock);
  if (g_voice.stage != VS_VOICE_STAGE_RECORDING)
    {
      pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_voice.lock);
      return -EINVAL;
    }

  g_voice.stop_recording = true;
  if (g_voice.cap != NULL)
    {
      (void)audio_capture_abort(g_voice.cap);
    }

  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_voice.lock);
  return 0;
}

int vs_voice_stop_speaking(void)
{
  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_voice.lock);
  if (g_voice.stage != VS_VOICE_STAGE_SPEAKING)
    {
      pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_voice.lock);
      return -EINVAL;
    }

  if (g_voice.pb != NULL)
    {
      audio_playback_stop(g_voice.pb);
    }

  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_voice.lock);
  return 0;
}

void vs_voice_close(void)
{
  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_voice.lock);
  g_voice.opened = false;
  g_voice.closing = true;
  g_voice.end_requested = true;
  g_voice.credentials_reload_pending = false;
  if (g_voice.cap != NULL)
    {
      (void)audio_capture_abort(g_voice.cap);
    }

  if (g_voice.pb != NULL)

      audio_playback_stop(g_voice.pb);
    }

  while (g_voice.busy || g_voice.credentials_reloading)

      pthread_cond_wait(&g_voice.idle_cond, &g_voice.lock);

 * highest rate such a board can actually reproduce.  Override it for hardware
 * that can do better.

#ifndef AGENT_TTS_WS_SAMPLE_RATE
#define AGENT_TTS_WS_SAMPLE_RATE 16000
#endif

print('edited')
